tei:div.tei:p: 'i 'ibasam gzhag ga kha dgatsho / / / /khri sems dpa'/ 4 — — ཿ /rnyi — — ’ ṅkagayo mi rigakopeskunakaunganari
bla/ dpe tshogs/
— ——————————— mek+ṣesmernye— meyi7me ——

da ra chadakar chagadagag sgrub dang dkyel yangs/na zug med pa'i bod kyi snyan ngag pa'i sde/da wa snyan ngag la dungs mkhan zhig gi sems kyi gdung 'bod/ (3)snyan ngag la rang nyid kyi go ba len stangs/ (15)snyan ngag la rdog brdzis ma gtong / (21)'phel rgyas med pa'i dpung sde/da walo rabs brgyad cu pa'i nang byung ba'i rtsom pa po skor zhig la bris pa/(29)sgrung thung〈grib gzugs khrod kyi mi tshe〉bklags pa'i myong tshor than thun/(46)brtsams sgrung gi mdun lam/da wa2006lo'i〈sbrang char〉du bkod pa'i brtsams sgrung 'ga' bklags pa'i zin bris thor bu/ (61)yag thog yag rtseg gi bod kyi dpyad brjod pa'i sde/ (77)

rngarnga ཿsa zu / :sdo/bsam gzhig dang myong rtogashes yon can dang‘‘rigs gzhung rul sungs’’ (89)rigs gzhung zhib 'jug gi gol lam dang dgra bo/da wasku zhabs rnam sras lags la springs pa'i mngon bsgrags yi ge (96)gros 'debs yang 'debs/ (113)gsar 'god pa zhig gi ngos len yi ge (123)phru gu gso spyad yag shos a ma'i 'o ma yin/ yon tan sbyong byed yag shos rang gi skad yig yin/da wamatho 'bring slob ma zhig gis bod yig la bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur las 'phros pa/ (131)‘‘dpe cha ni nga tsho'i dus rabs 'di'i tshe srog yin’’da wa'adzam gling dpe klog nyin mo bsleb la nye ba'i snga rol du/ (143)grub 'bras dang phangs sems/dus rabs shig gi lha sgrung—don grub rgyal dang khong gi mi tshe'i rin thang /da wasku zhabs don grub rgyal lags sku gshegs nas lo ngo20lon par rjes

da ra chadran du/ (155)bud med rang gi‘‘skad’’da wa〈za ma mo'i skyid sdug gangs ma char〉gyi sngon 'gro'i gtam/ (164)〈rang grol zhib 'jug〉bklags rjes kyi gtam/ (175)dpe klog zin bris sna zin spu zin/ (189)mtho 'bring slob ma zhig la springs pa'i 'phrin lan/ (203)shes yon can gyi skor gang dran ci dran/da wagrogs me lce lags la springs pa'i 'phrin yig (214)rtsom sgrig pa'i zin tho/ (225)grub 'bras dang phangs sems/da wa2006lor 'khyug tsam lta ba/ (238)nongs 'gyod dang yid ches rigs shig(mjug byang gi tshab tu) (245)
ri

zu med pa'i bod kyi sgo nga pa'i se/na zug med pa'i bod kyi snyan ngag pa'i sde/da wa snyan ngag la dungs mkhan zhig gi sems kyi gdung 'bod/dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs dgu bcu pa'i smad du mdo smad yul gyi char gtogs pa'i kan lho gtso byas pa'i 'brog khul gyi sa cha mang por sgra snyan rdung len gyi sgra thag 'beb skrun byed pa'i tsha rlabs shig drag tu 'phyur myong / de bzhin du dus rabs 'di'i dus mgo(yang na de las snga ba)nas bzung / bod kyi snyan ngag pa'i sder rang rang gi snyan deb par skrun byed ci thub bgyid pa'i tsha rlabs shig sngon ma nang bzhin 'gran sdur tshul gyis 'phyur mgo brtsams la/ tsha rlabs de'i rgyun da dung re zhig zhi 'jags su 'gro ba'i bzo lta tsam yang med par/ nad yams shig dang 'dra bar mu nas mu ru phyogs kun la khyab bzhin yod/ 'di ni bod mi byings kyi go rtogs sad cing rig gnas 'du shes je mthor song ba yin na dga' 'os pa zhig yin mod/ de ltar min par‘‘khyod kyis lwa'i gong khar sram lpags 'then na ngas ni gzig lpags 'then no’’zhes rgyu 'byor ba ngom res byed pa'i dpe bzhin snyan grags 'ba' zhig bsams pa yin tshe don snying gis stong ngo / / kho bor snang tshul 'di phyi ma'i rigs su gtogs pa'i dogs pa dang sems khur shin tu che/

rnga gaspras sgyu / :sdo/don ngo ma yang de lta yin te/ rig gnas kyi gad snyigs su gyur te gang sar khyab pa'i snyan deb dang dus deb de dag mthong ba'i mod la/bod kyi rtsom rig gi mdun ljongs la snying nye mkhan zhig yin tshe blo pham yid chad kyi shugs ring 'byin srid la/ sems khral gyi khong 'dar yang bstud mur rgyag pa gdon mi za/ de dag las mthong thub pa ni lad zlos bskyar zlos dang / brku 'bri bshu 'bri/ nad med 'khun sgra/phyi rdzig nang stong gi snyan ngag las nga tshos re zhing sgug pa'i snyan ngag ngo ma de nga tsho dang da dung rgyang thag shin tu ring ngo / /snyan ngag pa mang che shos ni nam yang rang nyid kyi dga' skyo chags sdang tsam las 'da' thub med pa dang / brjod bya'i khyab khongs gu dog la/ phyi tshul gyi rnam pa rdzig po tsam las nang gi‘‘na zug’’de brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ni mkha' yi pad mo bzhin mthong dkon/ rgyu 'bras blo mig brtsi srung byed pa dang / mi tshul do khur sogs kyi bsam blo ni de bas kyang rnyed dka' 'o/ /a ri'i‘‘9 11’’don rkyen byung ba nas hin rdu rgya mtsho 'phyur pa'i don rkyen dang / 'jigs skul ring lugs pas dbyin ji'i rgyal sa lon ton dang rgya gar sogs su 'gas gtor byas pa'i don rkyen/ 'dzam gling h+pha shi sir rgol ba'i dmag 'khrug las rnam par rgyal nas lo drug cu 'khor ba'i dus skabs de dag la/ bod kyi snyan ngag pa'i sde ru g.yo 'gul ci yang med par kha khu sim por sdod pa'i gnas tshul de la kho bo ni — 4 —

zu med pa'i bod kyi nga pa'i se/yi mug pa dang / kha skyengs pa'i tshor snang drag po zhig gis mnar te sems gting nas na zug skyes 'ongs/ snyan ngag pa zhig yin na gzhan gyi sdug bsngal la snying na ba dang / gzhan gyi khur bo rang 'gan du len pa/ don rkyen gang byung la tshor ba skyen po zhig ci nas kyang yod dgos pas/ nam yang rang gi bde sdug tsam po brjod pa ste/ dper na/‘‘nga la chang khyer shog’’ ‘‘ngas mdza' mo dran gi’’tsam gyis ga la chog nga tshos rang gi mig zung rgyang ring du bsrings te/ sems khong du‘‘'jig rten’’yod dgos la/ mang tshogs kyi mgrin tshab tu 'greng ba'i blo spobs shig cis kyang yod dgos pas/ nga tshos‘‘go dka' ba'i snyan ngag gi pho brang dang sgyu rtsal gyi gzhal yas khang’’dhi bar snang du mi bzheng bar/ snyan ngag de nam yang spyi tshogs khrod 'bab dgos la/ mang tshogs kyi sems khams sam bde sdug dang nye bar gcar dgos/ de bzhin nga tshos bde thang dang mdzes sdug la smon pa ji ltar bcangs pa bzhin de mngon du bsgyur thub pa'i nges pa med mod/ 'on kyang nga tshos phyir 'khor nas g.yo zol dang skyug bro ba'i bya dngos steng nas skad cig gi bde snang 'tshol ba ni sgyu rtsal 'tshol snyeg dang 'gal ba ltag sprod du gyur 'dug go/du ṣ+pelce'i〈gtor bshig dang bcings 'grol〉2003lo'i〈gangs rgyan me tog〉deb gnyis par gsal/— 5 —

na zu med pa'i bod kyi snyan nga pa'i se/rdol gyi skad cha ci 'dra'i dgod bro ba zhig red ang / ngas ni rang re'i‘‘snyan ngag pa’’de tsho'i snyan rtsom las de'i shul rjes tsam yang mthong ma song / de las ldog ste‘‘rang dad’’(khye7d+moza)dang sgyid lug gi rtsom 'bri'i (༈༈rkeṭ+wākhyu.oṃ) dug rlangs shig gang sa gang du 'phyur gyin 'dug‘‘sgyid lug gis rtsom 'bri ba ni skad char rdog brdzis gtong ba'i rtsom 'bri thabs kho na zhig yin’’du pas/ des nga tshor dge mtshan ldan pa'i phan nus ci yang 'don mi thub la bsam blo'i rgyags phye ru de bas kyang 'gyur mi srid/ nga tshos 'dzam gling gi rtsom 'byung lo rgyus la bltas na gsal bor mthong thub ste/ rlabs che ba'i bcoms chos dag ni mi chos ring lugs kyi bsam blos phyug pa dag yin 'dug cing / brtsams chos de dag las nga tshos mthong thub pa ni yar brtson gyi sems pa dang / gral rim gyi bkag rgya las thar cing mi gshis bcings 'grol byed par skul ma gtong la/ spyi tshogs steng gi lugs mthun min pa'i bya spyod la dgag rgyag dang 'gro mi'i bde sdug gi mtho sar 'greng nas bden dge mdzes gsum gyi bsam blo mngon par mtshon 'dug de dag dang ldog ste 'greng mkhan ni rang re'i 'thom sbrid du gyur pa'i bod kyi snyan ngag pa tsho yin la/ des bskyed pa'i mjug 'bras ni rang re'i rtsom stegs su shar du ltotshostso 〈tho dz+rakor+sā—1sgo.oṃlkolha//༈〉lharje1rki.oṃlornyeṭ+wāṃ2004stsolo2 203— 7 ge

rngarnga/thas/zu / rngorngo/pa'i gnas bab sdug po 'di yin pas/ de la na zug med pa'i bod kyi snyan ngag pa'i sde zhes mi 'bod ka med byung /rtsom rig khyab khongs su snyan ngag ni mi'i sems pa dang bar thag ches nye ba de yin na/ 'gro mi'i brtse sems dang las dbang la ches do khur byed pa de snyan ngag yin dgos la/ de'i thad myong ba ches zab pa dang tshor ba ches skyen po can yang thog mar snyan ngag pa yin dgos/nga tshor de lta bu'i snyan ngag pa med pa ni snyan ngag pa de la shes bya'i sgrig gzhi legs po med pa dang / mi rig do khur gyi 'du shes med pa/bsam blo gu dog pa/ sems khong na na zug med pa bcas kyis bzos pa'i ngan 'bras kho na red/ da ni kha g.yang sgrog pa'i dus rabs de snga mo nas mjug gril zin la/ rang snang gang shar du 'bri ba'i dus skabs kyang mjug bsdu ran 'dug lhag par du‘‘gnyid gung gi gtam bshad pa'i’’rtsom 'bri'i rnam pa cis kyang bsgyur thabs byed dgos pa red/gal srid nga tshos snyan ngag la brtsi bkur byas te/ ‘‘snyan ngag’’snyan ngag bzhin 'bri na/ nges par du lag pa brang la bzhag ste bsam blo gtong dgos la/ rang gi sems sgrar cis kyang blo rnal la phab nas nyan dgos/nga tshos nam yang rang nyid la zhib lta do snang byed dgos shing /nam yang rang nyid kyi rin thang lta tshul la dogs slong gi rnam 'gyur — 8 —

na zu med pa'i bod kyi nga pa'i se/'dzin dgos/ mdor dril na/ nga tshos rang nyid mi yin pa shes dgos pa(ma mtha' yang rang nyid la sha tsha ba/ rang nyid la 'gan khur ba)dang rang nyid la 'tsham pa'i rjod byed kyi tshig de 'tshol dgos pa(te men we'i tshig)de'o/ /cung spros na/ ‘‘rlabs chen gyi rtsom rig de rlabs chen yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sgyu rtsal mtshon stangs kyi mdzes pa lhur len pa kho na ma yin par/ kun spyod steng nas nam yang bde thang yin dgos pa dang /lhad med rnam dag cig yin dgos pa’’༷ de red/ yin na'ang nga tshos nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring gi snyan rtsom khag la 'khyug tsam bltas na/ snyan ngag mang che shos ni tshig gi rol rtsed tsam du zad la/ rkyal stong dang jag pa khram pa'i ngag las thon 'dra'i(mi la las bod kyi snyan ngag 'bri mkhan dag las mi nyung ba zhig ni rkyal stong dang chang 'thung gis grub pa red zer ba yang gnas lugs dang mi mthun pa zhig ma red 'dod)snyan ngag skor zhig byung dang 'byung gin 'dug nga tsho'i kun spyod lta tshul yin na'ang 'dra/ nga tsho'i mi tshe'i rin thang lta tshul yin na'ang 'dra/ yod tshad kyi tshad 'jal byed ci yin pa cis kyang blo la nges dgos pa red/ de ltar min na‘‘kun spyod steng gi bde thang’’dang‘‘lhad med rnam dag’’gi snyan ngag de gang du du r+hazalha 〈thra kosages+t+ra.oṃr+sā7mi/tsā〉ñtsadz+dza1rkisgralostu2004sgocho2 207— 9 —

rtsaḥ/thas/can/ ::/'tshol ang / mdun lam yod pa'i snyan ngag pa zhig yin na/ nam yang rang skyon 'tshol ba dang rang skyon rnyed rjes 'phral du de ji ltar bsgyur pa'i thad la mno bsam gtong nges pas/ nga tshos snyan ngag gi khor yug gtsang ma(sems khams gtsang ma)zhig 'tshol bar 'bad dgos/khor yug gtsang ma zhig med na bcoms chos gtsang ma zhig la re rgyu ni rus sbal gyi spu bzhin no/ /'di nas nga tshos na zug la go ba rags tsam blangs na/ snyan ngag pa'i‘‘na zug’’zer ba de‘‘nga la na zug skyes byung’’zhes pa'i tshig ngos kyi na zug de 'dra zhig la ngos bzung na gtan nas mi 'grig ste/ na zug de gdung sems chen mo dang rgyu 'bras blo mig mi tshul do khur gyi bsam blo'i mngon stangs shig tu go ba yin/ de yang mthar gtugs na/ na zug ni mi sger gyi kun spyod tshad gzhi dang 'du shes shig la rag las pa zhig yin pa dang / na zug skyed byed kyi rgyu ni dngos yod 'tsho ba dang spyi tshogs kyi 'gal 'du/ rig gnas khor yug cig gis bskyed pa'i bag chags khrod sad rtogs 'byung ba de yin/ de ltar na da gzod na zug de gson shugs rgyas pa zhig dang gdung sems kyi sa bon lta bur 'gyur nges/ de las ldog ste nad med 'khun sgra 'byin pa dang / gsog gsob tshul 'chos shig tu gyur tshe/ de ni rtsa ba rul ba'i sdong skam zhig dang 'dra bar char rlung 'gog pa'i nus pa med do/ /— 10 —

zu med pa'i bod kyi na nga pa'i se/sger tshugs kyi 'tshol snyeg(glusmen+t+ra7lko)med pa dang / mdzes sdug gi phugs bsam dben pas/ nga tsho bod kyi snyan ngag pa tshor tshugs thub kyi langs phyogs med pa dang dge sdig gi legs nyes 'byed pa'i smra lce'ang med par/ bden rdzun dang yag btsog skyon yon gyi mdun du nam yang kha khu sim por sdod pa'i‘‘dgun gyi khu byug’’tu gyur pa red/ mi'i la rgya'i 'du shes gnyom zhing / mi sger gyi lta tshul dang rang gshis 'du shes sogs stong bas/ nga tshor nam yang 'tshol dpyod byed pa'i blo spobs med cing snyan ngag legs shos de rang gi smyug khas 'dren thub kyin med pa red/snyan ngag pa zhig la mtshon na/ rang la blo sbyong dang rtogs pa mthon po zhig med par da dung rang nyid ci yin mdog gi bden kha ster ba zhig yin tshe/ de ni ngas bltas na nor 'khrul 'ba' zhig go/ nga tshor rang nyid las brgal pa'i ham sems shig yod dgos par ma zad/mi rigs kyi bde sdug la do khur byed pa dang / dus rabs kyi 'phar rtsa thig por 'dzin pa'i snying stobs kyang yod dgos pa red/ der‘‘rtsom mkhan zhig yin na mang tshogs kyi las dbang la do snang byed rgyu las/de la mthong chung gtan nas byed mi rung la/ nyam thag pa'i tshogs pa de la dus dang rnam pa kun tu do khur byed dgos pa red’’(kho li ma'i tshig)ces brjod pa ni gnad dam pa'o/ /nga tsho'i bod kyi snyan ngag pa'i sems — 11 ge

2ཿ/lhas/(5/ ::shekhong na nam yang rang nyid kho na las med pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo yang de la thug yod par snyam/ snyan ngag cig las‘‘kher rkyang gi sa srod gang mang la(ngas lhing 'jags gyon nas khyod rang bsam(bsams)(da dung(na zug khri stong sems khong la sgom bzhin(lo zla thug(mthug)po bzod bsran kho nas bris ’’zhes pa lta bur mtshon na/ don dam du 'di ni tha snyad stong ba zhig red la/ tshig ngos kyi na zug des nga tshor‘‘na zug’’gi tshor ba ci yang mi ster/ 'di nas nga tshos rgya nag gi snyan ngag pa pe ta'odulags kyi〈lan ldon pa〉zhes pa'i snyan tshig cig la blta ba'i dgos pa yod de/ ‘‘ (gal te rgya mtsho'i 'gram ngogs cis kyang brdol srid tshe(sdug gi chu phung ma lus nga'i sems khong du 'byo bar shog(gal te sa gzhi 'di nges par du dbyings su 'phags par 'gyur na('gro mir yang bskyar 'tsho gnas kyi yang rtse zhig gdam du 'jug rogs( (’’zhes pa 'di las nga tshos snyan ngag pa khong gi snying stobs rtogs thub la/snyan ngag gi stobs shugs de rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin zil shugs kyis khengs pa zhig yin pa'i nges shes kyang rnyed thub/ 'dir dgos dbang gis cung spros na/ ‘‘lhing 'jags gyon pa’’dang‘‘na zug khri stong sems khong du sgom pa'i’’‘‘sems rgya’’de ni dngos gnas mtha' yas shing blos bsgrigahri〉sosnaḍā slodu/sgokhyicha 1949—)krung go'i deng rabs kyi snyan ngag mkhan/ brtsams chos〈pe ta'o yi snyan ngag phyogs — 12 —

zu med pa'i bod kyi nga pa'i se/dpog dka' ba zhig red/ de dang bsdur na/ pe ta'o lags kyi snyan ngag 'dir kha g.yang gi shan che mod/ 'on kyang skabs de'i lo rgyus rgyab ljongs dang gzhon nu tsho'i spobs par sbyar tshe klog pa por dran rgyu dang myong rgyu zab mo yod pas mi tshad/ nga tshor‘‘kha g.yang’’nang bzhin gyi snying stobs dang na zug cig drag tu sbyin 'ong /nga tsho bod kyi snyan ngag pa dag gi rigs lam de ji lta bu zhig yin par kho bor gdeng tshod gtan nas med de/ chu mig bzhin gsal zhing dwangs la 'od 'tsher ba zhig yin nam/ yang na grong khyer gyi btsog chu bzhin snyigs ros khengs shing dri ngan 'thul ba zhig yin/gal te‘‘dwangs shing gtsang ba’’zhig yin na/ ci'i phyir rang gi snang ba ban bun tsam las 'da' mi thub pa red dam/ ‘‘rtsom mkhan ni mang tshogs kyi bus phrug yin pa las mang tshogs kyi zur gtogs tsam gyi sha thag lta bu gtan nas ma yin la/ rtsom mkhan ni mi dmangs khrod kyi khongs mi zhig yin na'ang / mi dmangs las sngon du brgal pa zhig kyang yin/ rtsom mkhan rnams la mtshon na dus rtag tu dpyod shes ldan la sad rtogs 'di 'dra nges par 'byung dgos te/ mi dmangs mtha' dpyod kyi yul du gyur pa dang gdung sems bstan yul du gyur pa'i skabs su/ da gzod rtsom mkhan gyi rtogs pa je mtho dang rtsom rig 'phel rgyas

rngarnga thas zu / ::/la sman pa'i bsam blo'i thon khungs su 'gyur srid pa red/’’④der brten/na zug med pa'i 'u cag gi snyan ngag pa'i sde ru thog mar mi rang nyid kyi gnas bab dang 'tshol snyeg ngo ma ci yin ngos zin par byas te rang gi rnam shes la tsha 'dri yang yang btang ba na/ da gzod gzur du med pa'i dus rabs kyi 'gan 'khri phrag tu len pa'i snyan ngag pa dang sems khong gi na zug drag tu mched pa'i tsha lam lam gyi snyan ngag mod po 'khrungs par nges pas/ de la kho bos re ltos snying nas byed do/ /dhi gyitsho 〈oṃṇ+ḍaṃzukā&snyekhyo〉oṃ.oṃspra4sgolornyeṭ+wāṃ2001lholo2 9—10— 14 —

nga la rang nyid kyi ba len ngas/snyan ngag la rang nyid kyi go ba len stangs/snyan ngag ni ci 'dod du bris chog pa zhig min pa 'dra la/ snyan ngag gis rang gi snang ba ban bun tsam bris pas kyang mi chog pa 'dra/snyan ngag de snyan ngag yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni snyan ngag rang steng du gzhan gang gis kyang tshab byed mi thub pa'i rin thang bla na med pa zhig yod pas red 'dod/ de yang snyan ngag gi rin thang de rgya mar 'jal ba bzhin tshad thig cig brjod du med kyang / snyan ngag legs po de'i rigs klog pa'i tshe na/ khyed la dga' skyo chags sdang sogs bsam pa'i longs spyod ci rigs shig sbyin srid pas/ de ni snyan ngag gi yon tan ci la min/de ni ngas snyan ngag la bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur yin la/ yang na nga snyan ngag la dga' zhen zab pa'i rgyu mtshan kyang yin no/ /kho bos snyan ngag tu brtsi rung min gyi snyan ngag gang mang zhig bris myong la/ de dag las mang shos klog pa po tsho'i spyan lam du bstar zin/kho bos dang thog snyan ngag la bzung ba'i lta tshul ni ci 'dra'i dgod bro ba zhig ste/ bod kyi snyan ngag cig yin na nges par‘‘rtswa thang’’dang‘‘sbra nag’’‘‘nor lug’’sogs brjod byar 'dem dgos par bsams nas/rang nyid 'tshar longs byung sa'i rong grong gi 'tsho ba rnams logs su — 15 —

rngapa thas zu / ::dobaskyur te/ thun mong gi myong snang rags mo gang der brten nas mthong ma myong ba'i‘‘rtswa thang gi dgong srod’’dang‘‘sbra nag gi kha tshub’’‘‘'bri 'jo mkhan ma'i bzho dbyangs’’sogs bris pa ni de ring bsams na byis blo 'ba' zhig go/ dran pa ru tshud pa'i rang gi 'tsho ba'i brnyan ris ngo ma bo thed la bor nas‘‘sgyu rtsal gyi bden pa’’zhig bsnyegs pa ni rta rgod g.yang la mchongs pa'i dpe ru cir mi 'gro/ de bas/ da lta kho bos gsar rtsom gyi smyug kha de nam yang rang sger gyi nyams myong zhig la gzhi bca' ba yin/nga rang gi〈nyi 'od lam lam khrod kyi lha sa/ zla 'od bsil bsil khrod kyi lha sa〉lta bur mtshon na/ nga rang gis dag zhing du sgom zhing pha yul du log 'dra'i spro snang bzung nas lha sar 'byor dus/ nor bu gling gar lbu chang rngam 'thung byed pa'i sras mo dag dang / po ta la'i thang chen du zhog khog 'tshong ba'i rgan mo tsho/ bar skor nas zas lhag la sgug pa'i mu to ba sogs de 'dra'i 'gal 'du dang do mi mnyam pa'i ngang mngon sum mig la shar pas/ kho bos mu mthud du bstod tshogs kyi me tog snyan ngag gi dbyings su ji ltar gtor ang / gtor thabs mi 'dug de bzhin du〈ding gling kher 'bud〉lta bu ni/ yul mi tsho'i skyo snang gi bar gseng nas brdol pa'i 'dzum mdangs dang / thabs chag ngang 'tsho yang da dung 'khang ra dang le bda' med par gzhas dbyangs — 16 —

na nga la rang nyid kyi ba le ngas/ngag tu gyer pa'i ngal dub 'dres ma'i spro snang / ding gling gi sbubs nas 'phyur pa'i lhad med kyi brtse dungs de dag ste yod tshad kyi yod tshad kyis kho bor snyan ngag gi tshor ba drag tu bskyed pas/ kho bos sems kyi pi wang brtse ba'i sor mos mi 'khrol rang dbang ci/snyan ngag rtsom par la shas kyis lhan skyes kyi shes rab cig mnga' dgos zer/ de ni bden kyang srid mod/ nga rang la lhan skyes kyi shes rab cig yod med de ngas gtan nas mi shes/ kha shas kyis snyan ngag ni chang btsan po rngam 'thung byas na 'ong ba red zer/ de yang bden kyang srid mod/ kho bo chang rag gis bzi ba'i tshe na snyan ngag smos ci tha na khyim gyi sgo'ang rnyed dka'/ yang la shas kyis snyan ngag ni‘‘btsir’’rgyu zhig min par rang byung du 'bab pa zhig yin zer/ de yang bden kyang srid mod/ kho bos re sgug gi mig zung ches cher bgrad kyang snyan ngag de rang byung du bab ma myong / der brten/ kho bos mno bsam yang yang btang zhing 'bad pa mang tsam bsten nas snyan ngag 'bri bzhin yod la/ snyan ngag ni bsam gzhig gi gzhung rtar thogs pa'i me tog min par me tog des bskyed pa'i 'bras rdog mngar mor rtsi bzhin yod/spyir snyan ngag ni rang rkya 'pher ba'i rtsom gyi rnam pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas/ snyan ngag gis 'di 'khur dgos dang / kan theg dgos zhes blang bya 'don mi chog na'ang thang mod/ kho bos smyu gu shog ngos su — 17 bhe

rngarnga thas zu / :sdo/btsugs pa'i skad cig ma der/ dran pa'i rtsig ldebs su 'khor 'ongs pa ni mi rigs 'di'i mdun du lhags pa'i 'jig nyen sna tshogs pa dang /snying nye 'khos chung gi yul mi tsho'i bde sdug yang na mngon sum du mthong thub pa'am mi thub pa'i tshor shes sdug mo dag yin pas/ ngas de dag sel mi thub kyang der gdung sems 'chang ba dang 'bod skul gtong ba'i 'gan de phrag la mi len rang len du gyur 'gro/ de'i phyir kho bos snyan ngag ni 'gan 'khri zhig yin ces brjod myong la/ snyan ngag ni na zug gis 'bri dgos pa'i lta tshul yang spel myong / da dung snyan ngag pa zhig yin na rgyu 'bras blo mig gsal dgos shing / drang bden gyi rgyab rtsar ka bzhin 'greng dgos pa'i re ba'ang bton myong /snyan ngag gi skad cha'i ngos nas bshad na/ snyan ngag ni skad cha'i dwangs ma yin ces pa'i bshad srol yod pas/ snyan ngag gi skad cha de khyod dang ngas dus rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod rjod kyin yod pa'i skad cha de yin mi srid/ yin na'ang snyan ngag gi skad cha de gtan tshigs kyis ma bzung ba dang / brda sprod kyis btang ba/ smyon pa'i lab rdol 'byin pa lta bu zhig ni ga la yin te ma yin no/ /lar rang re tshos‘‘snyan ngag ni shes rab can gyi longs spyod las rang ga bas ga la go'o’’dang / yang‘‘snyan ngag ni tshig gi rol rtsed tsam mo’’zhes 'ud kyis sgrog bzhin/ brjod 'dod pa'i sems tshor de khong du sbas drags nas phyi'i cha la dang dod cher byed da 18 da

nga la rang nyid kyi ba len ngas/pa'am/ tshig rgyan gyis spras drags nas brjod don ngo ma bo de rab rib tsam las mi mngon pa'i tshe na/ kho bos de ni snyan ngag legs po zhig la cis kyang rtsi bar mi byed de/ tha snyad ci 'dra'i brjid po dang yag po zhig bkol rung lhag mar mthong na/ des snyan ngag spyi la gnod pa las phan ni mi thogs so/ / yang gcig bshad na/ snyan ngag ngo ma de la‘‘skag tshos’’byugs nas yag las byed dgos don ga la yod/ de'i phyir snyan ngag de phyi smin la nang ma smin pa'i a mra lta bu zhig bris na mi legs la/ nang smin la phyi ma smin pa'i a mra lta bu zhig bris na'ang legs par mi sems te/ snyan ngag de phyi nang gnyis ka smin pa'i a mra lta bu zhig 'bri rgyu ni nga tsho su yin kyang 'bad pa byed pa'i kha phyogs su bzung na 'grigasnyan ngag gsar rtsom ni 'tshol rtog khrod nas mdun du skyod pa zhig yin/ srol rgyun gyi snyan ngag rtsom stangs kyis nga tsho'i dgos mkho yongs rdzogs skong mi thub pa de don dngos kyis ra sprod byas yod pas/ 'tshol rtog dang bral pa'i tshe na/ snyan ngag la gsar gtod med cing / snyan ngag gi mdzes pa'ang mngon thabs bral/ de yang bod kyi snyan ngag gsar pa'i thad 'tshol rtog byed na/ bod rang gi‘‘sa thog’’nas 'tshol rtog byed dgos te/ bod rang gi mdzes dpyod lta ba'i dgos mkho ltar dang / bod rang gi skad brda dang mthun pa'i snyan ngag 'tshol rtog byed — 19 —

rngabalhas/zu / :sdo/pa las/ yid brnyan sgrig stangs sogs ji ltar ya mtshan rgyus med yin na de ltar sgyu rtsal yin pa'i nges pa med la/ de bzhin nad med 'khun sgra 'don ci thub kyis de ni yid 'gyur mtshon pa yin ces na'ang su yis rlom par byed/snyan ngag gi rol dbyangs kyi cha la dang dod byed pa de yang snyan ngag legs 'grub 'byung ba'i cha rkyen gal chen zhig tu mthong ste/ snyan ngag kha shas shig bklags pa'i tshe na tshig gi 'gros la rkyong skum gyi rang bzhin med pas rol dbyangs kyi nyams de thon med/ snyan ngag la rol dbyangs kyi nyams dang ldan pa yin na snyan ngag de gyer bde zhing nyan spro ba zhig yin nges la/ snyan ngag gi mdzes pa yang sngar bas mtho ru 'phags srid snyam pas/ kho bos snyan ngag 'bri dus mtshams rer dbyangs rtar sbyar nas gsang mthor gyer pa yin/mdor na/ rang rang la rang rang gi go ba len stangs re yod pas/snyan ngag ni ji lta bu zhig yin pa de kho bos kha tshon gcod thub pa zhig min par/ khyed rnam pas nyams su myang rgyu zhig yin/ nga rang gi snyan ngag la mtshon na'ang / snyan ngag gsar rtsom gyi skabs su ji ltar mgo rtsom pa dang mjug sdud pa sogs kho bos tshod 'dzin byas chog mod/ 'on kyang dus deb dang tshags par sogs kyi steng du spel zin tshe/ snyan ngag gi bdag po ni khyed cag kyang ngo / /— 20 —

ngag la brdzis ma tong /snyan ngag la rdog brdzis ma gtong /ya mtshar bu ram sbyar ba'i sbrang gi chang / /yang yang 'thung bas mgo bo dkrugs pa la/ /rdzun gyi lan tshwa bral ba'i gtsang ma'i chu/ /nan gyis sbyin pa'i ngal ba kho bos byas/ /da dge chos/kho bos rang nyid‘‘mi rabs gsum pa'i tshogs pa'i’’khrod nas phyir bud pa'i gsal bsgrags thung ngu zhig〈bod kyi skad yig〉dra tshigs kyi dra ngos zin bris steng bkod pa na/ phyogs so so'i grogs po yongs nas dpyad gtam 'dra min sna tshogs spel te da lta‘‘don rkyen’’lta bu zhig tu gyur 'dug kho bo'i dang thog gi dmigs yul ni‘‘tsha tsha 'ur 'ur gyi mjug 'bras’’'di gtan nas min par/ rang nyid kyis snyan ngag la bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur zer kyang chog yang na ni rang gi langs phyogs tsam bstan pa tsam las ci yang min mod/ da lta bsams na 'di ni‘‘gnad 'gag’’gi skabs su byung ba'i‘‘gnad 'gag gi gnad don’’zhig tu gyur 'dug pas/ ‘‘dkrog gtam’’'di bzo mkhan kho bo yin na da lta kho bos kyang‘‘dgun gyi khu byug’’gi brtul zhugs spangs te‘‘'gan khur — 21 —

2rwasprolhas ji / ::/ba'i’’tshig ka cha re cis kyang mi bshad thabs med kyi gnas su gyar/kho bo'i 'dod tshul ltar na/ snyan ngag ni tshig gi sgyu rtsal yin pa'i cha nas tshig gi brjod pa dang don gyi snying bor brten nas gzhan la shugs rkyen bzo ba'am bag chags 'jog pa ni gnad kyi don po yin mod/rnyog chu dang rul chu gzhi gcig tu 'dres pa'i‘‘gnad 'gag’’gi dus skabs 'di lta bu'am/ yang na‘‘snyan ngag las snyan ngag pa mang ba'i’’dus skabs 'di lta bur/ nga tsho'i snyan ngag gi‘‘ngo gdong’’ngo ma de tshul 'chos dang grags skam gyis bsgribs te rab rib nas mag mog cig tu gyur dang 'gyur bzhin 'dug la/ ‘‘snyan ngag pas’’rang nyid kyi go sa rtsod pa'am‘‘nga 'di na yod’’ces kun la ngom pa'i ched du bya spyod ya ma brla zhig la brten nas snyan stegs steng 'tshang thub thub byed pa red/snang tshul 'di lta bu'i 'og tu byung ba'i snyan ngag skor zhig ni rang nyid kyi skyo sdug dang lang tsho'i ngar sems tsam por brten pa'i‘‘snyan ngag rdzus ma’’'ba' zhig yin la/ ‘‘snyan ngag pa'i’’tshor 'du de yang smyo ham dang 'dres pa'i kher bshad than thun zhig las ma 'das zhes bshad kyang mi chog pa med pa 'dra/ gnas tshul 'di ni snyan ngag pa'i skyo gar yin la snyan ngag gi skyo gar yang yin no/ /kha cig gis rgyu mtshan ma lus shes bzhin du de la bden kha ster ba dang bstod glu 'bul rkyang byed la/rang gi bsam tshul ngo ma brjod tshe‘‘rjes lus’’shig tu rlom pa'am mtshang — 22 —

sa ngag la brdzis ma tong /zhig tu 'gro bar dogs nas zob rdzu'i bzo lta sna tshogs ston pa ni ci 'dra'i mi 'os pa zhig red ang / don du gser gser dang rdo rdo yin pa'i dbye ba de sus mi shes/ skabs 'dir nga tshor‘‘rgyal pos na bza' mnab mi 'dug’’zer mkhan gyi‘‘klad med kyi byis pa’’dag ni ci 'dra'i mkho ang / yang na gtam tsha tsha re bshad na/ rtsed mo rtse na'ang rtsed srol zhig yod cing / lhag tu sgyu rtsal brtsams chos kyi grub cha gal chen te snyan ngag gsar rtsom gyi las su 'jug na ni smos ci dgos/ nang gi don la ma bltos par cha lugs sna tshogs ston pa'am ldab ldib 'khyal tshig dbyangs su gyer te ‘‘'di ni snyan ngag go’’zhes 'ud kyis sgrog pa ni/skyag chu rul chu gang yin ma bltos par‘‘'di ni rdza chu bsil ma yin’’zhes kha la 'thung ba dang khyad ci yod de med do/ /de las kyang skyo skyo ba ni mang mang gis ri bong cal 'drogs la brten wa skyes seng ger brdzu ba'am/dgod khar bltas na dgod bro ba dang ngu khar bltas na ngu bro ba'i rnam 'gyur ci yang ston par byed pa de red/snga 'dang phyi mno yang yang btang rjes bsam tshad thog dang dgos tshad lag tu mi thebs kyang / kho bos ni dkar nag khra bsdus kyi spyod tshul de mi spangs thabs med du gyur cing / snyan ngag ces pa 'di yang rtsed chas shig tu cis kyang bsgyur 'dod med la/ 'di la brten nas sprel lad byed pa'i rnam thar yang skyong 'dun ye nas med pas/ snyan — 23 —

rngarnga/lhas/zum/ ::/ngag ni 'gan 'khri rigs shig dang‘‘lag cha’’rigs shig tu brtsis te tan tan tig tig dang gzab nan gyi rnam 'gyur zhig mi bcangs ka med byung / snyan ngag 'bri mkhan zhig la mtshon na/ rang gis 'tsho ba dang bde sdug yod tshad la bcangs pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis rang gi smyug 'og gi snyan ngag de yang ji lta bu zhig yin pa dang / rin thang ga 'dra yod pa mtshon yod pas/ kho bos rang nyid la blang bya mthon po 'don pa'am yang na rang gi smyug 'og nas 'bus pa'i snyan ngag la‘‘khur bo’’lci mo re 'gel dgos byung song / de'i dbang gis snyan ngag de nam yang rang gi gshis ka yod pa zhig dang kher tshugs su 'greng ba zhig yin dgos pa'i bsam tshul skyes 'ongs pas/ dra grogs tshos brjod pa'i‘‘nges 'byung’’zer kyang chog la/ ‘‘rang tshugs med’’zer kyang chog ste/ gang ltar‘‘tshogs pa’’gang gi ming la brten nas‘‘rang gi 'khor tshogs’’bstod pa'i dbyings su spur ba'am/ gzhan dang gzhan rnams la rkang brdzis rdog brdzis byed pa'i skyo la sdug pa'i byed thabs des nyin rer bzhin kho bor sun po bzos 'ongs la/ zhib 'dang zhig brgyab tshe don du lug gi tsho rdzud lug gis shes shing / lo yag na phug ma zhar 'byung ma yin nam/la shas kyis nga tsho'i snyan ngag la 'phel rgyas chen po byung 'dug dang / nga tsho'i snyan ngag de da lta 'dzam gling rtsom rig gi gras su bslebs 'dug ces smra na'ang / phyir rtog cig byas na/ lo rabs — 24 —

nga ṭ+wāṃ5 brdzis ma tong /brgyad cu'i nang byung ba'i snyan ngag dag ni kha g.yang gi shan che zhing /tshig gi brjod pa'i cha nas thad ka thad kar du snang mod/ ma mtha' yang rabs de'i na gzhon rnams kyi snying stobs shig gong bur bsgril 'dug la/ de bzhin snyan ngag gi rgyun zhig kyang snyan ngag dang snyan ngag bar mtshams ma chad par 'phyo bzhin gda'/ de dang bsdur na‘‘mi rabs gsum pa’’zhes kyang chog la/ deng gi na gzhon a gsar can rnams kyi smyug 'og gi snyan ngag mang che ba ni gom lag 'khyol ba'i rta khyu zhig dang 'dra bar/ lam med dmigs med kyi ngang nas rang rang sar kha 'thor lung 'thor du gyur 'dug snyam pa'i tshor ba zhig sbyin 'ongs/spyir na 'di yang kho bor‘‘ma babs pa’’zhig yin kyang srid mod/ nga rang gi dran tshul tsam yig ngor bstar na 'di tsam mo/ /nga tshos ci'i phyir du snyan ngag 'bri ba yin nam/ dpe mtshon du rung ba gzhan dang gzhan rnams la bltas na/ sgyu rtsal brtsams chos gang yin kyang thog ma'i rnam pa'am nyag phra ba'i spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa zhig gi 'og tu rang kho na'i ched du 'bri ba'am rol rtsed tsam du ngos bzung mi 'dug ste/ nub gling gi rig rtsal bskyar dar dus skabs yin na'ang 'dra/ de bzhin rgya nag gi rig gnas gsar pa'i las 'gul gyi dus skabs yin na'ang 'dra/ sgyu rtsal brtsams chos de rgyal khab cig dang mi rigs shig gi bde sdug gi srog rtsar bsnyabs yod pa zhig dang / rmongs — 25 —

thapa/ཿsa :mi/ :sdo/gnyid las slong byed lta bu zhig blo yi sgo mo 'byed byed lta bu zhig nyi 'od kyi zer ma 'dren byed lta bu zhig yin 'dug go bde sla brjod byas na rang dbang dang mang gtso/ zhi bde/ 'dra mnyam/ tshan rig sogs spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dang mi bu yar thon yong bar 'bod skul gtong ba'i lag cha lta bu zhig tu gyur 'dug pa las/ rang snang gang rdol lam/ rtsed spyad dgod spyad lta bu zhig tu mi snang zhing / de'i dpe mtshon mi snar gna' deng krung phyi'i mi bo che bgrang gis mi lang ba zhig bgrangs rgyu yod pas re re'i mtshan byang dgod pa'i ngal bar bsten don med do/ /snyan ngag par dpe re blangs na'ang / mi tshe la thad kar gdong gtod pa'i spobs pa zhig dgos shing / kha yag dang ngo bstod/ me tog dang thal mo'i rdeb sgra'i khrod mgo 'khor ba'i rang dad kyi bsam blo de nges par du 'dor thabs byed dgos 'dug de dang ldog par gyur tshe mi'i mthar thug gi 'tshol snyeg bya yul te bden pa bor song ba red la/brtse ba rdzun ma dang snyan 'jebs tshig gi brjod pa/ phyi'i thabs rtsal chal chol sogs ni gnas skabs kyi‘‘thar lam’’zhig tu khas 'ches mod kyang / de'i tshad bkag gis nam zhig nga tsho su yin kyang thang la bsgyel srid do/ / de bas/ snyan ngag gis brtse sems dron mo zhig dang /mig mdangs 'jam po zhig bsnams dgos shing / mi gshis la mthong — 26 —

na nga la ga brdzis ma tong /chen dang mi chos kyi mtho tshad du 'greng ba'i snying stobs shig mnga' dgos zhes kyang brjod pa yin/ nga tsho mang mang gi kha nas sgrog pa'i bho ti leradulta bur mtshon na'ang / skyug bro ba'i bya dngos gang zhig bris kyang rung phyir mtshon pa ni mi gshis kyi mdzes pa las ma 'das/ de bzhin du dus skabs gang 'dra zhig tu bslebs kyang rung / snyan ngag de nam yang mdzes pa'i mtshon rtags shig yin na 'grig ste/ zang zing gi dngos pos mi sems nag nog tu bsgyur bzhin pa'i dus de ring yang / snyan ngag pas klog pa por sbyin 'os pa ni sngar bzhin mi sems kyi brtse ba dang /dkyel yangs/ rtsis thang sogs yin pa las/ rang sems kyi nag nog gis klog pa por sbag bslad kyi kha dbugs shig 'don sprod byed pa de gtan nas min no/ / des na nga tshor ci byung ba red/ nga tsho'i snyan ngag pa rnams la ci byung ba red/kho bo ni bsam gzhig dang sems khral gyis kun nas skul te gnyid kyi bde bar rol thabs mi 'dug la/ rang mgo rang gis g.yog na dga' krog krog gi yun thung spro bar yang rol 'dod ye nas med pas/snyan ngag ni na zug gis 'bri dgos dang / snyan ngag ni 'gan 'khri brtsamahri chos༈ṭ+wāṃg tānā/ me tosgot+tatāpyatā 'iḍā5sku'u/8ṣākhu ṣ+ṭha.oṃlkolo 1821—1867)h+pha ran si'i snyan ngag mkhan/

rngapa/tha /can/ ::rdozhig yin ces ngag nas yang yang mi zlo thu med byung /kye/ snyan ngag la rdog brdzis mi gtong rogs/snyan ngag de snyan ngag la sprod rogs/snyan ngag de klog pa por sprod rogs/(bdag gi gsal bsgrags thung ngu des ring nas 'dris shing ma 'dris pa'i grogs po skor zhig la phog thug 'dra bzos yod na/ ched du dgongs dag zhus pa yin la/ nan gyis bshad dgos pa zhig ni/ de ni su dang gang zhig la bsnyon btsugs pa min la rang nyid ci zhig yin khul gyis ngom so byas pa'ang min par/nga rang gis snyan ngag la bzung ba'i spyir btang gi rnam 'gyur zhig las ma 'das/gal te 'di'ang‘‘don rkyen’’zhig tu brtsis chog tshe/ nga rang la kha ming sna ming 'dogs pa'am snyad rko gseg 'dri ci byas kyang de ni gtso bo ma yin par/ dra grogs re 'gas bshad pa ltar/ 'di las ring du 'phros te snyan ngag gsar pa'i mdun lam mam 'dzugs skrun thad nas bgro gleng rgya cher spel te rngo phran tsam thogs na ni dge ba'i rgyu'o/ /)

'phel rgyas med pa'i dalung gle/'phel rgyas med pa'i dpung sde/da lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i nang byung ba'i rang re'i bod kyi rtsom pa po skor zhig la bris pa/lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i nang gangs can bod yul du shes yon gyis phyug cing spobs sems kyis khengs pa'i na gzhon skor zhig byung nas rang re'i bod kyi rig gnas pa'i sde la mkha' dbugs gsar pa zhig rngub pa'i go skabs bstsal/ de yang mdor dril na/ kho tshos rtsom rig la brten nas gnyid du yur ba'i mi rigs shig la 'bod skul btang ba de'o/ /skabs der sku zhabs don grub rgyal phud da dung gcod pa don grub dang /reb gong rdo rje mkhar/ rnam sras/ sgo me rdo rje rin chen/ chab 'gag rdo rje tshe ring sogs sha dar khrag dar gyi na gzhon skor zhig gis〈brtse dung gi mig chu〉dang〈ca ne〉〈mi rabs gsum gyi phrug lwa〉〈a ma'i sems〉〈chab cha rtswa thang gi bkra shis glu sgra〉(lhug rtsom)sogs brtsams chos gang mang klog pa po'i mig gi dga' ston du drangs nas bsam blo'i rgyags phye rab dang rim pa bskrun cing lo rabs de'i gzhon skyes rnams la shugs rkyen chen po bzhag yod pa red/ kho tsho'i sne khrid 'og nga tsho'i rtsom rig gsar pa zhes pa'i myu gu 'di yang med pa nas yod pa dang yod pa nas da 29 da

rngarnga//sa sgyu / ::rdogason shugs rgyas par byas/ nga tshos rang re'i bod kyi deng rabs rtsom 'byung lo rgyus la phyir lta byed dus kho tsho ni rgyu skar dbus kyi zla ba bzhin lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i mkha' dbyings su 'od du 'tsher bas/ nga tshos(nga rang gis)khong rnam pas bzhag pa'i byas rjes la nam yang yi rang 'bul zhing gus 'dud zhus pa yin/da lta stong lo gsar pa zhig gi dbu tshugs nas kyang lo ngo kha shas 'gor 'dug ste/ de ring nga tshos bod kyi rtsom rig gsar pa'i 'phel rgyas dang de'i mdun sar lhags pa'i nyen kha'i skor la bsam gzhig gtong dus/ kho tsho'i byas rjes dran pa'i zhor la kho tshor yang‘‘ma nyes kha g.yog’’gi nyes pa zhig mi 'gel thu med byung / kho tsho'i nyes ming ni‘‘'phel rgyas med pa'i dpung sde’’zhes pa de red/ kho tsho ni‘‘phar lta tshur lta’’byed rgyur dga' ba las‘‘yar lta mar lta’’byed par mi dga' ba'i rtsom pa po skor zhig red la/ kho tshos mig mdun mthong ba las rgyang ring mi mthong ba'i dbang gis thod rgal gyi brtsams chos shig ston rgyu med par gyur cing / dpyod shes kyi blo mig ldongs pas‘‘na gzhon gyi ngar(tshor 'du)’’yal rjes‘‘rgan rabs kyi bsam blo’’mtshon pa'i brtsams chos rnal ma zhig 'bri ma thub par phyi bshol byed dgos byung song ba red/ de bas nga tshos da lta kho tshor lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i mig mdangs spyad nas bltas na gtan nas mi 'grig ste/ nga tshos kho tshor re ba gsar pa — 30 —

'phel rgyas med pa'i daphung r+ṣa/'don dgos la/ nga tshos kho tshor gdeng 'jog gsar du byed dgos/nga tshos kho tshor rang steng gi nad rnying rnyed du 'jug dgos la/ nga tshos kho tshor rang nyid las lhag pa'i dpung sde gsar pa zhig nga rgyal ngang 'ong bzhin pa'ang mthong du 'jug dgos so/ /spyir na gzhan gyi grub 'bras la bstod pa byas nas khyod bzang nga bzang byed pa'i‘‘kun mthun gyi srol rgyun bzang bo’’zhig nga tsho'i rgyud du snum gyis gos zin pa bzhin chags yod pas/ gang zhig la phog thug gtong ba'am skyon brjod byed rgyu de sus 'gan du blangs tshe der mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur 'dzin mkhan yod pa gdon mi za mod/ ‘‘kho bo ni bstod smad kyi 'ben du gyur kyang rung gis tshe 'dir mi de dag gi ldog zlar mtha' gcig tu langs rtsis yod’’(don grub rgyal gyi tshig)pas/ gzu bo'i gtam gyis rang gi lta tshul tsam brjod na nongs pa ci mchis/1bod kyi rtsom rig gsar pa ni‘‘ri bong cal 'drogs’’kyi tshul du‘‘thun min gyi dus rabs’’shig gi nang du glo bur du‘‘sa lding gnam lding’’dang‘‘tsha tsha 'ur 'ur’’ngang lam du chas/ lo ngo nyi shu tsam gyi ring la‘‘dngos yod ring lugs’’dang‘‘dngos brgal ring lugs’’‘‘sgyu 'phrul dngos yod ring lugs’’‘‘deng rabs ring lugs’’dang‘‘deng rabs phyi

rngarnga/ཿsa/zu / ::/ma'i ring lugs’’sogs rtsom rig gi grub mtha' ji snyed cig brgyud tshar zhes rjod mkhan yang mang du 'dug yin na yang nga tshos phyir rang re'i rtsom pa po tsho'i smyug 'og gi brtsams chos dag la bskyar du gdeng 'jog tsam byed bsam dus nga tshos 'di yang 'khyongs med la de yang grub med snyam pa'i sems khral zhig kho bor rgyun du 'byung bas/ thog mar kho tsho'i brtsams chos re gnyis la dpyad pa phran tsam gtong ba'i dgos pa yod de/dper na/ rnam sras kyi〈mi rabs gsum gyi phrug lwa〉lta bur mtshon na/khong gi brtsams sgrung gzhan pa〈rang 'thag kha〉dang〈'bru skyi ba〉dang khong gi sgrung 'bring〈kyag kyog tu 'bab pa'i lung chu〉sogs gang la bltas kyang klog pa po'i khrod go gnas gal chen zhig zin 'dug brtsams sgrung de ni1987lo'i〈sbrang char〉deb gsum pa'i steng bkod 'dug la/ de'i nang‘‘a khu lhun grub tshang gi phrug lwa khungs sne gtso bo byas te u tshugs kyi bsam blo dang 'tsho ba gsar pa/ bsam blo gsar pa'i bar gyi 'gal ba rnams brjod bya byas te rang re'i mi rigs kyi rjes lus dang u tshugs kyi sems khams phyir dmar rjen du bton pa dang 'tsho ba'i lta ba rnying par 'phya dmod byas’’rjo yod pas/ ‘‘brtsams sgrung de rigs ni dus skabs sa/sar pa'i bod kyi rtsom pa po rnams kyis rang re'i mi rigs kyi rang rigs sdope zlosna /ngas / kyisnrochi pyisash+lau sprashārā rmildi bo/da kyi sgrung gtam la dpyad pa blo gsar dgyes pa'i dga' ston 215mi — 32 ge

'phel rgyas med pa'i dpung se/bzhin/ bsam blo/ sems khams bcas la zhib 'jug byas pa'i mtshon rtags dang grub 'bras yin’’dhi zhes gsal bor bstan yod mod/'on kyang〈mi rabs gsum gyi phrug lwar〉'or lta zhig byed dus/ ‘‘phyi shun’’gyi zhib 'jug tsam las mi rigs kyi rang bzhin dang bsam blo/sems khams bcas dang da dung kha thag ring ba'i snang ba zhig bcos min du sbyin 'ongs/ spyir btang gi‘‘gtam rgyud’’tsam la brten nas mi rabs gsar rnying gnyis kyi 'gal 'du gleng ba de brjod byar bdams yod kyang / gtam dpe re gnyis dang kha brda thung thung zhig gis 'gal 'du de sgyu rtsal gyi mtho sar bzhengs thub med pas brtsams sgrung gi sgrig gzhi de ha cang chig rkyang gi tshul du mngon 'dug la/ a khu lhun grub yin na'ang 'dra/ bu tshe ring yin na'ang 'dra/ rtsom pa pos mi sna'i rang gshis dang sems khams zhib 'bri byas pa mi 'dang bas klog pa por bag chags zab mo zhig 'jog mi thub la/ mi sna dang brjod bya gang yin kyang nga tsho'i‘‘phugs 'dun gyi steng gi brtsams sgrung’’(bdud lha rgyal gyi tshig)gi khyab khongs su bsleb thub med par snang tshul rigs shig la 'grel ba rags mo tsam brgyab pa yin pas/ sgyu rtsal brtsams chos kyi tshad gzhi ltar gdeng 'jog bya thabs bral zhing / ‘‘rang rigs kyi lta stangs dang chibyezlo ༵ kho/sdo 2༵ /sa ñtshagar+shas sdiṭ+wālda wiswā kā pānā shādā m+bi snat+na shātasna tāspyadā byarjo spyut+yā /sa nyu zlok+ta k+ṣiṃ spro/ma glezlo9 me+e1losh+lauṭ+wā

2pa/lhas/carngo/ :sdo/khyad chos/ spyi tshogs kyi 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes ltar gson nyams ldan zhing gzugs snang yod pa'i sgo nas dga' skyo chags sdang gsal zhing sha khrag gdos bcas kyi mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba mtshon’’dumed pas/ klog pa po rnams kyi yid kyi dang ba 'dren mi thub la/ bsam blo'i steng gi longs spyod ni de bas kyang 'don sprod byed mi thub/gang lags she na/ brtsams sgrung zhig yin tshe/ mi sna'i nang sems kyi myong ba dang 'brel ba'i zur gang rung zhig brgyud de brjod bya'i 'gan du babs pa'i don rkyen de zhib 'bri byed dgos pa dang / tshags dam pa'i sgrig gzhi(lhag par du sgrung thung)dang 'os 'tsham gyi spros brjod/mi sems 'gul bar byed pa'i nang gnas kyi stobs shugs(kheṣ+ṭhameṣ+ṭha)bcas cis kyang yod dgos la/ ‘‘brtsams sgrung legs shos shig yin tshe kho'i bsam blo'i bstan don de nyid 'tsho ba'i mthil du phyin yod pa zhig dang / snang tshul gyi smug sprin brtol nas rtsa ba'i rang bzhin la bsnyabs yod pa zhig dang / mi sna'i rnam shes la reg yod pa zhig yin dgos’’ du pas so/ /de bzhin reb gong rdo rje mkhar gyi〈ca ne〉la zhib lta zhig bgyis tshe gong gi lta tshul de la gom gang mdun spos kyis ra sprod byas yod de/ 〈ca skrun khahā / sa~Xsdu /sna'i skyabyusru t+yāzlosdo/ kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs sngon 'gro'i gtam23mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe du bdud lha rgyal rju'atshol rtog snying stobs223yun nan mi rigs dpe skun khang / 2004lo'i zla6pa'i par/

'phel rgyas med pa'i dpung se/ne〉ni rtsom pa po'i 'thus tshab bcoms chos yin min brjod dka' rung /bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs khrod kyi〈gtsang bo'i pha rol〉dang〈sbrang char〉gyi lo 'khor nyi shu'i dpe tshogs khrod kyi〈sgrung gtam rlabs kyi gzegs ma〉(stod cha) gnyis kyi nang bdams yod par gzhigs na/‘‘brjod bya rjod byed gnyis kyi cha nas legs shos bdams pa yin’’pa dang‘‘dus skabs de'i brtsams chos gras kyi legs shos su bgrang 'os’’① pa gsal bor rtogs thub/ rtsom 'di〈sbrang char〉du 'khod dus ni spyi lo1986lor khel 'dug cing / 〈mi rabs gsum gyi phrug lwa〉las lo gcig gis snga/(spyir na brtsams sgrung 'di gnyis la brtsams sgrung gi tshad gzhi ltar gdeng 'jog byed rin med na'ang / rang re'i nyag phra ba'i rtsom rig gi dmigs bsal khyab khongs nang bzhag tshe go gnas gal chen re zin yod kyang srid)brtsams sgrung 'di yang gong dang mtshungs par srol rgyun gyi 'du shes rnying par dgag rgyag dang sun 'byin byed pa de rtsom gyi mgo rnga bar gsum du mngon 'dug na'ang / mi sna'i gshis ka 'bri bzhengs dang gtam rgyud kyi byung rim bcas la dang dod byas pa mi 'dang la/ tshig gi brjod pa de mi sna'i‘‘'gro 'dug spyod’’gsum bcas bye brag pa'i steng du 'bab thub med pas go bde'i brtsams sgrung(74ci7/smikālko)ngam gtam rgyud tsam las 2001:khro zlo6nādā : sdo/nga rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam2 295mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

thaḥbarmis zum/ ::she'ada' thub med cing / ‘‘nang gnas kyi stobs shugs’’dang sgyu rtsal gyi mtshon stangs lhur len pa sogs la lhag tu mnyam 'jog cang gnang mi 'dug par/ ‘‘sun 'byin’’gyi ched du sun 'byin byed pa dang‘‘spro snang gis rtsom rig la 'jug pa’’las gzab nan gyi rnam 'gyur bzung med pa dngos shugs gang rung nas shes thub/ der brten/ kho tshos‘‘spyi tshogs dang dus rabs kyi 'byung rtsa ther 'don byed thub med pa dang klog pa por shes rtogs dang bag chags zab mo ster mi thub pas/ rtsom yig de dag la skye 'phel gyi nus shugs ha cang chung ba'am yang na med ces brjod kyang chog’’rjo pas/ ‘‘mi tshul do khur’’dang‘‘mi chos ring lugs’’‘‘gdung sems 'du shes’’sogs ldan pa'i brtsams chos shig lo rabs brgyad cu pa dang 'phrad pa'i las 'phro med song ba red la/ de bzhin nga tsho'i dus rabs nyer gcig gi rtsom rig brtsams chos dag dang yang ci 'dra'i bar thag ring bo zhig yod pa ṭ+wāṃd ang /gong nas rtsom pa po rnam sras dang reb gong rdo rje mkhar gnyis kyi brtsams chos kyis mtshon par byas nas rabs de'i rtsom pa pos bris pa'i /rte chababrag yo t+yā taklo rgya mazloṭ+wāsdod kyi sgrung gtabh+yo k+tasaṭ+wāṃ dzom skorā gyi gnad don 'ga'alorngosbrang chatra lo 'khor20da gas dpyad ma ngas pa ga sa259ma na gas da skrun khang / 2001 'a zla6pa' par/— 36 —

'phel rgyas med pa'i dprang sde/brtsams sgrung gi zhan cha'am mi 'dang sa rags mo tsam brjod khul byas mod(spyi yongs nas tshab byed thub pa'i nges pa med na yang / zur zhig cis kyang mtshon thub par kho bor yid ches mnga')zhib tu bsams na skyon cha de dag la rtsom pa po kho tshos kyang snga mo nas nges shes 'drongs los yod snyam pa'i bsam tshul zhig kyang skyes 'ongs/ gal te nges shes de 'dra 'drongs yod pa'i dbang du btang na/ ‘‘'phel rgyas med pa'i dpung sde’’zhes pa de kho tsho'i steng du sbyar na lhag tu 'grig snyam pa'i mod la kho bo'i sems pa 'khyag sib sib tu gyur/rang re'i bod kyi rtsom pa po gcod pa don grub dang sgo me rdo rje rin chen/ reb gong rdo rje mkhar sogs ni‘‘dkar nag go ldog’’gi dus skabs dang‘‘drug cu tham pa lo'i mu ge’’sogs dka' sdug dang nyen khas gang ba'i lo rabs de dag brgyud myong mkhan tag tag yin pas/ (skabs de'i gnas tshul mdor tsam rnam sras kyis‘‘brtsams’’pa'i〈dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi sgrung gtam la dpyad pa blo gsar dgyes pa'i dga' ston〉gyi le'u brgyad pa'i sa bcad dang por gsal) kho tshor dka' sdug gi 'du shes(sgotsāwaṃzlokāṣā)shig cis kyang yod na 'grig mod/ 'on kyang kho tsho ni de las ldog ste mang tshogs kyi bde sdug‘‘mig gis mthong’’ba las‘‘sems kyis mi mthong’’bas/kho tsho'i smyu gus sdug bsngal de dag dang du len pa'am nyams su myong ba'i spobs pa zhum pa red/ 'di yang mi rigs shig gi rig gnas khor yug — 37 —

rngarngasprolhas zu / 1rngo/khrod bzhag nas gleng tshe/ rang re'i gangs can pa rnams la mi'i rtsis thang 'du shes dang rang gshis 'du shes sogs med pas lan pa e yin snyam/ rgya nag gi rtsom 'byung lo rgyus la bltas na lu'u zhunadudang pa cinadusogs la mi rigs kyi 'gan 'khri 'du shes drag po zhig yod pa shes thub la/ dka' sdug gi 'du shes de yang sgyu rtsal gyi mtho tshad cig tu slar mtshon byas nas tshul min gyi bya spyod la dgag rgyag dang sun 'byin/mang tshogs kyi bde sdug la do khur dang gdung sems bcas bcangs yod pa red/ nga tsho'i rtsom pa po tshos bsam pa'i thon khungs( rnyetsāṣ+kam)de bed spyod thub med pa(yang na bed spyad pa mi 'dang)ma zad lo rgyus la phyir rtog dang rang nyid la 'gan mi khur pa dang / mun nag nang lag snyob tsam byed pa las 'od snang 'dren pa'i blo gros dang rgyu 'bras blo mig mi ldan pas/ phul du byung ba'i brtsams chos ni gtan nas 'byung thub pa ma red/ rtsom rig ni mi rigs shig gi mig zung dang mtshungs pas/mi rigs shig gi mig rgyang ring min dang des ci zhig mthong gin yod pa thag bcad yodadupa bden par rlom tshe/ nga tshos rang nyid la dri ba 'di 'dra zhig bton chog ste/ nga tsho'i mig rgyang ring tshad ga 'dra red/ nga yigatahā rgyuspyowi lhazlo 'a/dusgokhyu7 1881—1936)krung go'i rtsom rig mkhan dang bsam blo mkhan/ brtsams chos abartsamanywa chosapahāshā/sowaṃ bloḍā 1904—2005)krung go'i deng rabs kyi brtsams sgrung mkhan dang / rtsom mkhan/⑦ smo/zaṣ+pe ziri 〈 spratshi+owokhrilha6/1〈7lome 〈spratshilko 2005 12 1lko2lo— 38 —

'phel rgyas med pa'i dpyang se/tsho'i mig zung gis ci zhig mthong gin 'dugagasar rtsom gyi smyug khar rang nyid kyi tshe srog bzhin gces skyong mi byed pa'i rtsom pa po zhig la mtshon na/ ‘‘mang tshogs la 'gan khur pa’’dang‘‘mang tshogs kyi mgrin tshab tu 'greng rgyu’’zer ba de ni gnam la skas 'dzugs pa lta bu red/ de'i rkyen gyis nga tshos rtsom rig la 'bod skul gtong ba de yang mthar gtugs na rtsom pa po'i rgyu 'bras blo mig la 'bod skul gtong ba dang gdung sems la 'bod skul gtong ba rang red/rtsom rig gis ma gzhi nas mi la do khur byed pa dang / de ni rtsom rig rang steng du gnas pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen lta bu red/ 'on kyang nga tsho bod kyi rtsom pa po tsho'i brtsams chos las cha rkyen de rigs mthong mi thub pa dang / brtsams chos mang shos shig gi mgo bklags ma thag mjug ni klog pa pos blo bzo byas na tshegs med du‘‘mkhyen’’thub la/ brtsams chos de rigs kyi brjod bya dang sgyu rtsal mtshon stangs sogs kyang phal cher rigs 'gre bas skom pa chu dang ltogs pa zas bzhin klog 'dod kyi spro ba rgyas mi thub bo/ /'dzam gling gi rtsom 'byung lo rgyus la bltas na/ rlabs che ba'i brtsams chos de dag gis 'gro mi'i las dbang la mthar thug gi do khur(phroṃṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha/rko)mdzad yod pa ma zad/ de rtsom rig brtsams chos kyi zhib 'bri dang zung 'brel gang legs byas yod pas/ brtsams chos de — 39 —

rngapa/pes/zum/ :sdo/rigs thengs brgyar bklags kyang mi ngoms shing / brtsams chos de rigs las nga tshos sgyu rtsal gyi bden pa nyams su myong thub la/ brtsams chos de rigs kyis nga tsho'i yid sems 'gul bar byed cing / nga tsho'i 'jig rten lta tshul dang mi tshe'i rin thang mngon 'gyur byed par yang ram 'degs thob srid pas/ sgyu rtsal brtsams chos ni drang bden min mod/'on kyang drang bden dang nye bar btud byed kyi thabs lam gtso bo zhig yin ces smra bar yang rgyu mtshan med pa ga la yin/ yin na yang phyir 'khor nas rang re'i rtsom pa po de dag gi smyug 'og nas thon pa'i‘‘phul byung brtsams chos’’dag la blta dus tag tag gong du brjod pa gang de'i ldog phyogs kyi ra sprod du 'grengs 'dugang tshos kho tsho'i bcoms chos la re re bzhin(lag la chud tshad)zhib mor bklags tshe/ bdag gi brtsams chos las khyod kyi rnam shes mthong thub la/ khyod kyi brtsams chos las kho bo'i grib gzugs mthong thub pa'i nyams snang zhig rgyun du ster/ de las shes thub pa ni nga tsho'i brtsams chos dag ni rnam pa dang sgrig gzhi dang nang don sogs kyang phal cher 'dra mtshungs yin pas red/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni rang re'i rtsom pa po dag gi bsam blo'i khyab rgya chung ba dang so sor rang gshis rnal ma zhig chags med pa dang / shes bya'i sgrig gzhi dang 'tsho ba'i myong goms sogs kyang rdog kha gcig 'khyol du gyur 'dug pas red snyam/— 40 —

'phel rgyas med pa'i dalung se/3rtsom yig 'di bris nas mtshams 'dir bslebs rjes/ kho bos rang gis ci bris la phyir lta zhig byas na/ lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i rtsom pa po tshor‘‘phog thug chen po zhig btang song’’snyam pa'i skrag snang zhig skyes pa'i mod la/ kho tsho'i skyon cha mi nyung ba zhig da dung brjod ma thub par lus 'dug snyam pa'i nongs 'gyod cig kyang skyes 'ongs/ 'on kyang phyir 'dang zhig brgyab tshe 'di tsam gyis mi chog pa yang med de/rgyu mtshan ni ma gzhi nas kho tsho'i brtsams chos kyis 'di las lhag pa'i‘‘phog thug’’cig theg thabs ga la yod/ rtsom pa po tsho'i rtsom rig gi blo sbyong yin na'ang 'dra/ skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur yin na'ang 'dra/ yod tshad 'go brtsams ma thag pa'i dus skabs de lta bu zhig gi nang du kho tshor re ba nan mo 'di 'dra bzung tshe thal drags bzhag yin na yang gnas lugs ni de ltar yin yang rung gis gu yangs gtong ba ni thabs rdug gi las kho na zhig ma yin nam/ chu dkrogs pas mar mi thon pa'i dpe bzhin lo rabs brgyad cu pa 'das zin la/ kho tsho'i brtsams chos la'ang phyir bzo bcos bya rgyu zer na ha cang dgod bro ba'i gnas shig tu 'khums pas/ da ni kho tshor re ba gsar pa 'don rgyu de ni gnad dam pa'o/ /

2pa/thas/25/ :sdo/des na rang ngo rang gis zin nam mi zin dang / rang gi brtsams chos la rang gis 'gan khur ram mi khur/ klog pa po la don dam gyi bsam pa'i longs spyod cig sbyin nam mi sbyin/ dri ba 'di dag ni kho tsho'i mdun sar lhags pa'i gnad don gtso bo yin la/ nga tsho'i rtsom pa po yongs nas bsam blo gtong yul zhig kyang yin pas rang rang sa nas bsam gzhig btang na 'grig go/gcig rtsom pa po zhig yin phyin rang gis rang ngo zin dgos te/nga tshos thog mar rang nyid su yi‘‘bu phrug’’yin pa shes dgos/ 'di ni rang gi rtsa lam du bzhur ba'i khrag rgyun su yis bstsal par ngos 'dzin zab mo thob pa'i go rim zhig kyang yin/ go rtogs 'di 'dra yod tshe nga tsho rang mi rigs dang mang tshogs kyi bde sdug gi mtho sar 'greng thub la/kho tsho'i rgyud du a 'thas su yod pa'i bag 'khum dang rnying zhen gyi 'du shes la go ba len thub/ de min da dung kho tsho'i sems kyi sgra dbyangs thos thub pa dang kho tsho'i sdug bsngal dang kho tsho'i 'dod blo'ang shes thub pas/ rgyu cha de dag sgyu rtsal gyi bden pa dang bsres sbyor gang legs byed thub pa byung na/ rang gi sger tshugs kyi bsam blo bzhengs skrun byed pa'i go skabs ches yag shos de yang dam 'dzin byed thub song ba red/gnyis/ rang gis rang gi brtsams chos la 'gan khur dgos te/brtsams chos la 'gan khur min de mthar gtugs na mi rang nyid la — 42 —

'phel rgyas med pa'i dpung se/'gan khur min dang 'brel ba dam zab yod/ de la dpe zhig drangs nas brjod na rgya nag gi rtsom mkhan pe tshungadhilags kyis sgrung ring〈zhe sdang〉zhes pa bris tshar rjes kho'i grogs po yus cerjolags nas 'di ltar brjod yod de/ ngas pe tshung gis bris pa'i sgrung ring〈zhe sdang〉bklags tshar rjes/ kho'i grogs po zhig yin pa'i cha nas kho'i lus phung la sems khral mi skye thu med byung zhes brjod yod par gzhigs na/ rtsom pa po'i gsar rtsom gyi go rim de‘‘klad pas mno bsam gtong ba’’dang‘‘lag pas yi ge 'bri ba’’tsam ma yin par/ sems kyi mnar gcod drag po zhig yin pa gdon mi za ste/ brtsams chos khrod kyi mi sna ngus tshe rang nyid la skyo snang 'byung ba dang / rang gi smyug 'og gi mi sna mi yul dang bral tshe rang gi gnyen nye bral ba nang bzhin gyi sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i dpe mtshon mang du 'dren rgyu yod pa las shes thub/ nga tshor 'di 'dra'i rtsom mkhan ga tshod yod ang /gsum/ klog pa por don dam gyi bsam pa'i longs spyod cig sbyin dgos te/ brtsams chos ni rtsom pa po'i nang sems nas bzhur pa'i khrag rgyun yin la/ sems khong nas 'phros pa'i nyi 'od kyang yin pas/ brtsams chos legs shos de rigs bklags tshe klog pa po'i brtsamaṭī chosaṭ+wāṃhūm̐sdo ga//ta~X( sh+lau phyisdotram̐gāngh+rusna spya spyi ṭ+wāṃ dzhai ṭ+wāṃ sh+lau twok+ṣiṃsbe lhi smut+t+waṃ/dā/dā /zlo/snrulda choj-in sdispyod+ngha sbokyālda kāsnyoldi/

rngapa /sa zum/ ::shesems kyi rma kha sos par 'gyur la/ sems kyi nyin srib kun la drod khol 'khyil 'ongs pa red/ de las ldog tshe bsam pa'i steng gi longs spyod lta ci snag shog brlag pa dang klog pa po'i dus tshod chud zos su btang ba kho na yin no/ /de bas rtsom pa po zhig yin na‘‘par len 'phrul chas’’kyi nus pa tsam thon pas mi chog par phyi shun phyis nas nang srog la bsnyabs dgos pa red/ des na thog mar blo sems rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas gsar rtsom dang smyug 'og gi mi sna la brtsi bkur dang 'don spel gang legs byed dgos so/ /spyir na da dung phyogs mang po nas 'dren rgyu yod kyang 'di tsam gyis 'thus par bya/rtsom yig 'di mjug rdzogs la nye skabs sku zhabs rnam sras lags nas/ reb gong rdo rje mkhar lags kyis brtsams pa'i sgrung ring〈rkyal ba'i 'jig rten nyul ba'i gtam rgyud〉la‘‘rtsom mkhan gyis mi rigs 'dir myong tshor dang shes rtogs byas pa'i stobs dang / dus dang rnam pa kun tu kho tsho'i bde sdug gi 'tsho ba dngos de rang steng du blangs pa'i nyams myong dag gis mi rigs 'di'i lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i ring gi tshe srog gi bden pa'i ngo bo bri thub pa byung ba yin’’zhes gdeng 'jog mthon po zhig byas 'dug la/ kho bos tshig dum 'di gzhan gang la mdzad pa'i gdeng 'jog nas 'di lta bu'i rtsom yig legs po mi 'gyangs par kho tsho'i smyug rtse nas 'khrungs pa'i re smon du bsgyur nas rabs de'i rtsom mkhan da 44 da
yongs la 'phel rgyas 'byung ba'i re bzhag nan gyis bcangs pa yin no/ /2005 12 10nyin zi ling du/

rngarnga//sa/sgyu / :sdo/ sgrung thung〈grib gzugs khrod kyi mi che〉bklags pa'i myong tshor than thun/〈sbrang char〉'don thengs brgya pa'i steng kho bor brtsams sgrung cung legs po zhig klog pa'i go skabs byung zhing byung nas kyang spro ba ches cher 'phel/ brtsams sgrung de'i kha byang la〈grib gzugs khrod kyi mi tshe〉zer la/ rtsom pa po ni na gzhon brtsams sgrung pa lha byams rgyal lags te/khos nye ba'i lo 'di dag gi ring la〈rong grong gi 'grul bzhud〉dang〈sgrol ma'i rmi lam〉sogs brtsams sgrung skor zhig bris pa dang / lhag par du〈sgrol ma'i rmi lam〉nas bzung kho'i brtsams sgrung la 'gyur ldog cung chen po 'byung 'go tshugs shing / thengs 'di'i〈grib gzugs khrod kyi mi tshe〉las snang tshul de'i rigs gom gang mdun spos kyis ra sprod byung 'dugalha byams rgyal gyi brtsams sgrung la rnam pa'i cha nas khor yug rgyas 'bri(spyir na khor yug rgyas 'bri byed pa sogs kyang brtsams sgrung 'grub pa'i rgyu ru grub mod/ sgrung thung rtsom par rgyas 'bri byed drags na brtsams sgrung gi sgrig gzhi sogs la gnod pa red)byed pa sogs cung nyung la/ nyan spro zhing ya mtshan pa'i gtam rgyud kyi byung rim brjod pa lhur blangs med mod/'on kyang kho'i brtsams sgrung de go bde zhing bltas ma thag 'di 'di bshad — 46 —

〈grib zugs khrod kyi mi che〉bkla sa pa'i myong chor/'dug dang gan gan bshad 'dug ces sdom tshig 'god dka'/ des na kho'i brtsams sgrung ni non cha bsam blo'i lci med par rnam pa'i thad nas gsar pa zhig red ces pa gtan nas min te/ kho'i brtsams sgrung gi khyad chos sam yon tan de gang du mngon yod ce na/ mi gshis kyi gting sar yibs pa'i mi mngon pa'i 'jig nyen zhig gam yang na na zug cig ston ci thub byas yod pa ma zad/ kho'i brtsams sgrung gi mdzes pa de lhug brjod kyi cha nas kyang gsal bor mthong thub/ der ma zad kho'i brtsams sgrung〈sgrol ma'i rmi lam〉dang〈grib gzugs khrod kyi mi tshe〉las gdong len gyi cha(ṣ+kaṣ+ṭha cho)zhig kyang thog mtha' bar gsum du mngon yod/'di'i thad nas lha byams rgyal dang pad ma tshe brtan gnyis kyi gsar rtsom thad mtshungs chos yod pa red/ kho gnyis gang yin kyang rang re'i‘‘gtam rgyud rol myong la goms pa'i klog pa po’’yongs la brtsams sgrung klog 'don gyi re ba gsar pa bton dang 'don mus su yod pas/ rtsom pa po dang klog pa po'i bar la phan tshun skul 'ded(༅7)kyi nus pa bzang bo zhig thon yod snyam/ 'on kyang mi mtshungs sa ni/ pad ma tshe brtan gyi〈gangs〉dang〈yul gyar rdung len pa zhig gi rmi lam〉〈chos sgron dang mo'i bu blo ldan〉sogs brtsams sgrung mang shos shig la rtog bzo'i shed che ba dang 'tsho ba'i myong goms dngos las ring du 'gongs 'dug lha byams rgyal gyi brtsams chos ni de las ldog ste dngos yod la gzhol pa'am — 47 —

rngabathas/zum/ :sdo/yang na dran reg tu tshud pa zhig red/1'dir gleng bar bya ba'i sgrung thung〈grib gzugs khrod kyi mi tshe〉ni mi sna gtso bo bkra shis kyi slob ma'i dus skabs nas rgyal khab kyi las byed par gyur pa'i bar dang / ‘‘mtho sgang gi ltebs khugs’’shig nas grong khyer chen po zhig tu bslebs pa'i bar gyi mi gshis kyi gtsub brdar dang rgyal pham sogs gtam rgyud kyi mu tig de tshig gi dar la brgyus nas klog pa po'i mig lam du bstar yod pa dang / yang na mi zhig rang gi grib gzugs khrod nas 'tshos shing / de nas rang gi grib gzugs bor zhing gzhan gyi grib gzugs su tshud pa'i go rim ste/ rang gshis can gyi mi zhig spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i gtsub brdar brgyud de 'jam rdo gor ma lta bu zhig tu gyur pa'i brgyud rim bris yod par snyam la/ yang na 'di tsam kho na'ang min no/ /bkra shis kyi 'gyur ldog de gtso bo phyir dran gyi rnam pa du ma gung bsgrigs nas mtshon par byas yod de/ dper na/‘‘de ni bkra shis lo na chung ba'i dus red/ de dus kho go la 'di'i ches mtho sa'i sa ste nyi ma dang bar thag ches nye sa'i mtho sgang gi ltebs khugs shig tu bde legs ngang 'tshar longs 'byung bzhin pa'i — 48 —

〈grib zu sa da kyi mi che〉bklags pa'i myong tshor/sgang red/ de dus khor rtsed chas mang po med/ 'on kyang nyi 'od rdzogs med cig yod/ rim gyis bkra shis nyi 'od rtse mo rtse bar goms shing / de yang thog mar nyi 'od khrod rang gi lus po'i yan lag dang nying lag gi grib gzugs sna tshogs phab nas gad mo yang yang dgod’’ces nga tsho'i mig lam du mi gshis kyi sbags lhad ma thebs pa'i yul ljongs shig gam gzhan dbang du ma tshud pa'i dwangs gtsang gi khor yug cig bzhengs pa dang / de ru‘‘rang gi lus po'i yan lag dang nying lag gi grib gzugs’’ci 'dod du phab chog cing / bkra shis kyi sems ngo yang de bzhin rnam par dag pa zhig yin pas‘‘bkra shis kyis 'khrab ston pa dang ltad mo pa'i thad la mi tshe dang sbyar nas bsam blo gtan nas gtong mi srid pa’’red/ zang zing gi dngos pos mi'i bsam pa'i kun spyod kyi 'jig rten brlag nyes su 'gro ba'i dus da lta dang / mi dang mi'i bar gyi brtse ba je srab nas je srab yin pa'i grong khyer gyi 'tsho ba dang bsdur na de ni ci 'dra'i mdzes sdug gi 'jig rten zhig ang /‘‘bkra shis la thog dang por grib gzugs mthong mi thub pa'i dngangs skrag byung’’dus ni‘‘'gro mi'i spyi lo1997lo’’yin te/ lo der kho'i‘‘pha rgan nad las ma thar par tshe las 'das’’pa ni bkra shis la mtshon na rang gi 'tsho ba'i rgyab ri nyil ba yin pas/ pha rgan 'das pa ni chung chung gi kho la‘‘rang gi grib gzugs yal ba'in pa'i’’snang ba byin/— 49 ge

rngapa/spras/25/ 1 /dngos gnas‘‘mi zhig la grib gzugs med pa ni ci 'dra'i 'jigs su rung ba zhig red ang /’’ yin na'ang‘‘mig chu 'don thengs des bkra shis smin thag chod par byas song’’ba ni mi sna gtso bo'i mi tshe'i 'grul bzhud lam gyi dkyogs mtshams lta bu zhig tu 'khums la/ bkra shis kyi bsam gzhig sna tshogs pa'i mgo yang de nas bzung bslangs pa yin no/ /brtsams sgrung gi mgo mjug bar gsum du‘‘grib gzugs batrel nas bsdad’’dang / ‘‘grib gzugs mi 'dug’’‘‘grib gzugs mthong mi thub’’‘‘grib gzugs bor’’sogs grib gzugs dang 'brel ba'i tshig 'bru mang bo bkod pa de dag gis ci zhig mtshon yod zer na/ bkra shis ni thog mtha' bar gsum du‘‘gnyid’’nas yod pa zhig min par‘‘sad’’nas yod pa zhig red/ khos rang nyid la grib gzugs yod med dang grib gzugs ni mi zhig la mtshon na ha cang gal che ba sogs rtogs pa ma zad/‘‘rang gshis shin tu gsal ba'i’’thar rdo'i steng nas‘‘sems la dran pa de bshad phod sgrub phod pa'i snying stobs shig’’kyang rgyud 'dzin byas/ lo du ma'i rjes su da dung sems khong du thar rdor gus pa dang yid smon gyis khengs yod/ yin na'ang grong khyer gyi zang zing dang mgo khrid kyi‘‘grib gzugs’’kyis rim bzhin kho'i za zur rnams bcom pa red/ de ni nub kha'i nyi 'od kyis 'jig rten sgrib pa bzhin phan tshun gyi ngo gdong dang yid ches tha na rang nyid kyang mthong dka' ba zhig tu bzos/ bkra — 50 —

〈grib zu sa khrod kyi mi che〉bklags pa'i myong chor/shis kyis de ni 'jigs nyen zhig tu mthong nas‘‘mi 'gyangs par las khungs kyi mgo khrid ‘bkra shis kha che’yi mnga' 'og nas phyir bud de mtho sgang la 'gro rgyu de red/’’ de ni kho rang‘‘grib gzugs chen po zhig gi grib mdangs khrod nas phyi la bud de/ rang gi grib gzugs 'tshol ba'i’’thabs ches yag shos yin mod/ bar skabs shig la bkra shis kyang gtos che ba'i mun pa de'i khrod du 'dzul nas rang gis rang nyid la mnar gcod btang /brtsams sgrung gi mjug tu bkra shis kyi bsam gzhig dang chos sgron gyi rmi lam gnyis bsdur te/ nga tshor‘‘yul ljongs’’mi 'dra ba gnyis bzhengs yod de/ bkra shis kyis‘‘nyi 'od kyis legs skyes su phul ba'i bu mo 'di su yin nam/ bu mo 'di ma gzhi nas grib gzugs chen po zhig ma yin nam’’zhes nam yang‘‘grib gzugs’’skor la yang yang bsam gzhig byed na'ang / chos spron ni de las ldog ste rmi lam skyid pos khugs shing / ‘‘rmi lam du rgyas shom dod pa'i khang ba dang / khra khra rig rig gi tshong khang’’sogs kho na las yod pa ma red/ de gnyis zhib bsdur byas pa brgyud/ 'jig nyen sna tshogs kyi mdun du kher rkyang du lus pa'i gzhon nu zhig gi skyo snang dang 'gal 'du sogs kyis bzos pa'i sems khams mthong thub la/ de bzhin du 'gan 'khri dang phugs bsam sogs kyis bor ba'i grogs po mang shos kyi gnas bab kyang mtshon — 51 bhe

rngarnga spras/com/ rngo rdoyod/ 'dis da dung kho bor na gzhon snyan ngag pa 'brong lags kyis bris pa'i snyan ngag‘‘ngas mtshan mo 'di'i lhing 'jags gyon nas(tsha lam lam gyi('khyag sob sob kyi(tha snyad sna tshogs brang la sbyar tedzebasam blo btang( kho mo'i rmi lam ha cang zhim nges(nyi 'od dang rtswa ljang('o zholu gu ci yang 'dzoms( ’’(〈chung ma gnyid zin/ ngas snyan ngag 'bri bzhin yod〉)zhes pa de'ang dran du bcug song /rtsom 'bri ba de mi zhig la mtshon na dngos yod la g.yol ba'i sbrid sman lta bu zhig min par/ spobs pa cher bdog gi sgo nas 'tsho bar gdong gtod pa'i mtshon cha lta bu zhig yin/ der brten/ rtsom pa pos thar rdo dang bkra shis kha che lta bu'i mi gshis kyi zur gnyis mtshon pa'i mi sna gnyis bkod sgrig byas te bkra shis kyi mi gshis dang kun spyod la 'gyur ldog byung ba dang / deng gi dus 'di'i rnyog 'dzing che ba'i gnas bab ra sprad pa red/ mi gshis sna tshogs kyi gdong gtug bar nas nga tshos bkra shis ni smra bsam brjod spobs dang dbang shed kyi mdun nas mgo sgur mkhan zhig min pa dang / skyon dang 'phrad na ngos len zhu spobs pa'i thar rdo lta bu zhig 'khyongs mi srid pa shes na'ang / de ni kho rang steng gi gnad don 'ba' zhig min par 'tsho ba'i dka' sdug dang spyi tshogs kyi rgyu rkyen sna tshogs pas grub pa yin pas kho la gdung sems zhig kyang ngang gis shor 'gro/— 52 —

〈grib zu sa khrod kyi mi che〉bkla sa pa'i myong chor/bkra shis ni grong khyer du 'tsho na'ang kho'i bsam pa'i ngos thad nas bshad na/ kho rang gi lus steng gi‘‘zhing pa'i rjes shul’’de 'dag thub yod pa ma red/ khos rang nyid ji ltar 'tshar longs byung ba dang 'tshar longs byung sa'i khor yug brjed mi srid la/ de bzhin ma 'ongs pa'i bgrod lam ring mo'i khrod du'ang khur bo lta bu'i dran pa de dag 'dor thabs yod mi srid/ brtse dungs dang khe phan sogs kyi mdun du kho'i bsam blo 'gal ba can du gyur cing / tha na sdug bsngal dang blo 'gyod sogs skyes myong na'ang mthar thug rang gi grib gzugs las phyir 'bud dgos byung song / phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad na/ 'di ni dus rabs kyi rba rlabs drag po'i khrod g.yo 'khyom gang mang thebs rjes kyi myong rtog rnal ma yin la/ phyogs che sa nas bshad na/ brtsams sgrung 'dis deng gi sgyid lug gam yang na drang bden gyis stong ba'i spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa zhig dang rnam pa de'i 'og gi mi gshis kyi 'gyur ba dngos de mtshon 'dug2'di nas dmigs bsal du bshad rgyu zhig la/ gal te nga tshoru/ lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i tshad gzhi'am myong rol gyi nyams myong ltar de ring gi rtsom pa po'i brtsams chos la tshad gzhal tshe/ de ring gi brtsams chos kyi — 53 —

rngabathas/zum/ :sdo/rin thang rnyed mi thub pas/ nga tshos bskyar du brtsams sgrung la go ba len dgos shing / bskyar du rang nyid kyi klog 'don gyi mthong sne gsar pa zhig cis kyang 'tshol dgos so/ /de'i phyogs nas lha byams rgyal gyis rabs 'di'i gzhon skyes bcoms sgrung 'bri mkhan yongs la dpe ston gyi nus pa gal chen zhig thon yod snyam/ mi rabs re la mi rabs re'i rtsom pa po yod pas/ lha byams rgyal ni nga tsho'i mi rabs 'di'i rtsom pa po'i khrod rang gshis mngon par gsal zhing / lhug brjod la dang dod cher byed pa/ sngon skyod rang bzhin la snyeg pa/ thabs rtsal la'ang byang cha nges can ldan pa'i rtsom pa po zhig red/ de ni kho bo lha byams rgyal gyi brtsams sgrung la dga' ba'i rgyu mtshan yang yin/gzhan yang brtsams sgrung zhig yin gshis klog pa por bsam gzhig gi bar stong zhig bskyur na legs te/ de ltar min par yod tshad gsal thag chod pa'i sgo nas rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi‘‘ngag’’las sgor phyungs tshe/ klog pa po ni rtsom pa po gnyis pa yin ces pa'i dbang cha de yang yongs su 'phrog pa red la/ yang gcig bshad na de ni brtsams sgrung dang gtam rgyud kyi bar khyad kyang yin par 'dod/ lha byams rgyal gyi〈〈grib gzugs khrod kyi mi tshe〉bklags pa'i tshe na gnad don de rigs thag gcod cung 'os 'tsham byas 'dug par snyam/lha byams rgyal ni dus rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod mi'i lus kyi nyams 'gyur — 54 —

〈grib zu sa da kyi mi che〉bkla sa pa'i myong chor/sogs bye brag gi cha la do snang ngam mnyam 'jog cung zhib mo gnang mkhan zhig yin pa shes thub/ khos rang gi myong ba de dag sgyu rtsal brtsams chos khrod bkod pa legs pas/ des khos mi sna slong skrun byed par dge mtshan mang du bsnan 'dug cing / mi sna zhib 'bri'i nus pa 'don spel legs po byed par rmang gzhi brtan po btings/ gsar rtsom la 'jug mkhan zhig yin gshis der do snang dang de'i phyogs la smyug kha mang du bsgyur pa yin na klog pa por mnyam 'ur slong thub pa ma zad bag chags zab mo bzhag ste brtsams sgrung legs 'grub 'byung bar rngo thogs pa red/ nga tshos lha byams rgyal gyi brtsams sgrung la bltas na/kho'i brtsams sgrung snga gras〈rong grong gi 'grul bzhud〉las kyang 'di 'dra'i gson nyams kyis phyug pa'i zhib 'bri mthong thub ste/‘‘khyod kyis nyi 'od bsegs nas 'phros pa'i zhogs pa der sgang kha de ru zhing rmo bzhin 'dug ba lang gi lkog shal lhab lhub tu g.yo/ zhing rlung gis rmon phyugs kyi kha nas nar nar du 'dzar pa'i 'od lam lam gyi kha chu sgul bzhin mchi/ khyod kyis glang lcag mkha' ru 'phyar ba'i ngang tshul des nga'i phyir dran khrod kyi grogs po'i snang brnyan la phog thug btang byung / kha tshur 'khor tsam gyis khyod kyi mig zur du nya'i mjug rdzi'u yi dbyibs babs 'dug cing / ngas phar bsrings pa'i lag par 'tsher snang gis 'ju tsam byas/

rngababasdosbub thaka 2do‘‘zhing gi rnang mar bsnyes nas khyod kyis tshos mdangs nyams pa'i stod gos de'i khug ma yud tsam bsngogs rjes/ tshags par gyi shog bu shur mo zhig blangs shing / de nas dud khug nag po'i nang nas lo ma nyung tsam mthe bong dang gong mdzub/ dkyil mdzub kyi bar la btsir te smin mtshams su gnyer ma zab mo brgyab nas ha cang sems chung ngang nga'i skad char nyan/’’lha byams rgyal gyi zhib 'bri 'di dag ni kho rang 'tshar longs byung sa'i khor yug dang kho rang gi nyams myong dngos las byung ba sha stag yin pas/ khyod rang rong grong gi 'tsho bar cha rgyus yod mkhan zhig yin tshe ri mo bzhin mig lam du shar 'ongs srid la/ pha yul gyi chung byis pa'i dus kyi slob grogs 'ga' re'i snang brnyan dam dum yang dran du 'jug srid/ kho'i brtsams sgrung bklags pa'i tshe na nga tshor blo bskyed 'di 'dra yang sbyin te/ ci zhig la rtsom rig zer zhe na/ rtsom rig ni rang gi nyams myong yi ger 'god pa'i rnam pa zhig la zer/rjode ni rtsom rig gi ma mtha'i cha rkyen du 'dod pas/ nga tshos rang gi nyams myong bskyur nas gzhan gang zhig 'bri 'dod pa ni gser gyi phor ba bzung nas zas slong ba'i dpe ru 'gro'o/ /du rjosprar+sha 〈thoṭha4'ithospratshizotshasgoྈlho.oṃ.oṃ.oṃ 〉zla snyaltalornyeṭ+wāṃ2005ñtsa5(loji 84— 56 —

〈grib gzu sa khrod kyi mi che〉bklags pa'i myong chor/brtsams sgrung zhig yin phyin gtam rgyud ci zhig brjod kyang rung /yang na thabs rtsal la ci 'drar byang cha yod kyang rung / gtso bo mi sna'i rang mtshan pa'i gshis ka 'bri bzhengs dang bya byed mtshon pa'i steng na yod pas/ mi sna slong skrun byed pa ni brtsams sgrung gi co ba'i khyad chos yin la/ de'i phyir mi sna'i 'gul skyod dang mi sna'i gshis ka'i 'phel rim la bstun pa las rtsom pa pos thad kar mi snar gdeng 'jog gam tshod 'dzin byas na brtsams sgrung legs 'grub 'byung bar gnod pa red/lha byams rgyal gyi sgrung gtam las gnad don de'i rigs thag bcad pa ha cang legs te/ thengs 'dir gleng bar bya ba'i sgrung thung〈grib gzugs khrod kyi mi tshe〉zhes pa mgo brtsams ma thag 'di ltar bris yod de/ ‘‘nyi thig cig yar sngon dang mtshungs par bag phebs pa'i ngang 'jam cag ger sge'u khung gi shel sgo brtol nas bkra shis kyi mdun cog la 'phros yong / bkra shis kyis ga ler dbyin yig gi tshig mdzod mthug po de'i kha bsums shing / mdzub bar la btsir ba'i lcags smyug de logs su bzhag mtha' mar gdong la bzar ba'i shel mig de yar la thengs shig ded rjes/ gzhi nas lag pa gnyis ka ga ler nyi thig gi khrod du bsrings/ de ma thag bkra shis kyi cog tse ru lag pa'i grib gzugs 'phos byung / de nas khos mdzub mo res mos su brkyangs te bzo lta sna tshogs btod cing / cog tse ru'ang de dang bstun nas grib gzugs kyi — 57 —

jibapes/can/ ::rdobazo lta sna tshogs shig babs byung / de na mche ba gtsig pa'i khyi dang /skad gsang sgrog pa'i bya pho/ da dung phag pa/ ba lang / lug rta sogs sems can sna mang 'gul bzhin 'dug ’’nga tsho'i 'tsho ba rol stangs dang nga tsho'i 'gro 'dug spyod gsum sogs gzhan dang mi mthun pa de dag gsar rtsom khrod bkod tshe/ bod rang gi thun min khyad chos mnga' ba'i brtsams chos kyang 'byung srid snyam/brtsams sgrung gi mdzes pa de gtso bo zhib 'bri dang tshig gi lhug brjod kyi cha nas kyang mtshon dgos pas rang re'i brtsams sgrung pa rnams kyis de la dang dod byas pa mi 'dang la/ des bskyed pa'i mjug 'bras ni kho tsho'i smyug 'og gi mi sna phal mo che ni mtshon mdog gcig gis bris pa'i ri mo bzhin chig rkyang gi rnam par grub 'dug lha byams rgyal gyi lhug brjod kyi nus pa ni ltos bcas kyis ha cang tshad mthon por bslebs 'dug la/des zhib 'bri bya yul gang de gson nyams ldan pa'i ngang mtshon thabs byas yod pas/ 'tsho ba'i bden pa'i rang bzhin zhes pa'ang kho'i brtsams chos las mthong thub/'phros don/nga tsho'i rtsom pa po tshos brtsams sgrung la bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur dang langs phyogs ni ci 'dra ba zhig yin pa kho bor mi gsal mod/ kho bos bltas na brtsams sgrung gi do khur bya yul gtso bo ni mi'i mthar thug gi — 58 —

〈grib gzu sa da kyi mi che〉bkla sa pa'i myong chor/bde sdug la gdung sems 'chang ba dang mi gshis bcings 'grol byed par skul ba/ legs nyes kyi rnam dbye 'byed pa/ skyug bro ba'i bya dngos la sun 'byin pa/ kun spyod phyogs nas bde thang can du bsnyegs pa sogs so/ / brtsams sgrung sgyu rtsal zhes pa yang don du tshig ngos kyi rab rib kyi brjod pa dang / snang ba 'khrul par byed pa'i gtam rgyud kyi byung rim chal chol tsam zhig la go dgos tshe dngos gnas dgod bro ba'i gnas su 'khums/ ngas go ba len stangs ltar na rtsom rig gi dmangs byings kyi rang bzhin zer ba yang mang tshogs khri ma 'bum gyi bde sdug dang nye bar bcar yod med cig la brjod pa yin shas che/rgyu mtshan ni dmangs dang bral ba'i brtsams chos shig 'byung mi srid la dmangs ni phul du byung ba'i brtsams chos kyi pho brang snyeg byed kyi rkang stegs lta bu yin/ sgyu rtsal gyi bden pa zer ba yang snang ba ban bun tsam dang gtam rgyud kyi logs su bkar ba'i tshig gi rol rtsed kyi thabs rtsal kho na tsam la brjod pa yin na der 'tshol snyeg gi rin thang ci zhig yod/ med de/ deng gi rang re'i brtsams chos kha shas bklags pa'i tshe na gtam rgyud 'os mo zhig kyang 'khyongs med pas/ brtsams chos de rigs la klog 'don gyi rin thang ci yang med/ gtam rgyud ni brtsams sgrung gi rmang gzhi yin la/ brtsams sgrung gi rta la gtam rgyud kyi bang 'gros ma bslab na brtsams sgrung des skabs thog tsam zhig la tshor ba — 59 —

gsar rkyang zhig sbyin srid kyang / nam zhig rig gnas gad snyigs su mi tshud pa'i nges pa ci yang med pas/ ma 'ongs pa na lha byams rgyal lags kyi smyug 'og tu bsam blo'i dpang mtho ba/ mang tshogs kyi bde sdug mtshon pa/ spyi tshogs kyi rgyab ljongs chen por gzhi bca' ba bcas kyi brtsams sgrung spus dag gang mang 'khrungs pa'i re 'dun zhus pa lags/

brtsams nga ma 'i ma/brtsams sgrung gi mdun lam/da wa2006lo'i〈sbrang char〉du bkod pa'i brtsams sgrung 'ga' bklags pa'i zin bris thor bu/gleng slong ba/1981lor〈sbrang char〉dus deb gsar du bton pa nas da lta'i bar du lo ngo nyi shu lhag 'gor song / de'i ring la〈〈sbrang char〉dus deb kyis bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig thad thon pa'i nus pa dang bzhag pa'i byas rjes ni bla na mtho zhing kun gyis mig mthong lag zin du gyur yod/don grub rgyal gyi〈'brong stag thang〉gis dbu 'khyud de 'tsho ba gsar pa mtshon pa'i brtsams sgrung mi nyung ba zhig dus deb de nyid brgyud nas klog pa po tsho'i spyan lam du bstar cing kun la bag chags zab mo bzhag pa ma zad/ rtsom pa po gang mang gi thog ma'i gsar rtsom gyi mgo yang de nas brtsams pa yin pas/ nga tshos blo zhib mos〈sbrang char〉deb re re bzhin bklags tshe bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi kyag kyog bgrod lam gyi dpe ris ngo ma bo dang 'phel 'gyur rab dang rim pa ji bzhin du mthong thub la/ dus deb de nyid kyi rtsom sgrig pa tsho'i sngon med gsar gtod kyi snying stobs dang 'tshol rtog gi spobs sems kyang gsal bor rtogs thub/— 61 —

rngarwa thas/(5/ ::rdolhag par du nye ba'i lo 'di 'ga'i ring bkod pa'i brtsams sgrung skor zhig gis nga tshor yid ches de rigs gom gang mdun spos kyis ra sprod byung bas/ kho bos gsham du2006lo'i〈sbrang char〉du bkod pa'i brtsams sgrung 'ga' las 'phros te rang gi lta tshul phran tsam zhu 'dod/2006lor〈sbrang char〉du brtsams sgrung 'bring thung bsdoms pas15bkod 'dug la/ de'i khrod du bdag gis ches legs par mthong ba'i brtsams sgrung4yod pa dang / de dag ni〈grib gzugs khrod kyi mi tshe〉dang〈hā pa gsos pa'i zin bris〉〈〈sdom pa srung ba〉〈gna' grong〉bcas yin/ brtsams sgrung de dag gang la bltas kyang thog ma'i‘‘gtam rgyud’’nas‘‘brtsams sgrung’’gi chu tshad dang nye zhing / rtsom pa po'i‘‘kun mkhyen gyi mthong sne’’nas mi sna'i 'phel rim la bstun ci thub kyi rnam pa mngon pa/ drang ldog gi mi sna kho na las sna mang sne 'dzing gi mi sna bzhengs skrun byung ba/ da dung bsam blo'i zab rgya/ sgrig gzhi/zhib 'bri/ lhug brjod byed thabs sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad nas 'phel rgyas chen po byung yod pa'i nyams snang sbyin la/ nga tsho'i brtsams sgrung gi mdun lam ni re bas khengs shing 'od stong 'bar ba zhig yin pa'i yid ches kyang ngang gis rgyas yong /rtsom bklags myong chor/

brtsams nga mdu lam/1 〈grib gzugs khrod kyi mi tshe〉ni na gzhon brtsams sgrung pa lha byams rgyal gyis bris pa red la/ brtsams sgrung de las nga tshos rabs gsar pa'i brtsams sgrung pa zhig gi 'tshol snyeg dang gsar rtsom gyi rnam 'gyur mthong thub ste/ sgrig gzhi tshags dam zhing dgos med kyi zhib 'bri spangs te sgrung thung gi cha rkyen dang bstun ci thub kyis kho rang gi rtsom 'bri'i yon tan mtshon par byas 'dug la/ bklags pa'i tshe na mi'i rgyud du rang chags su yod pa'i 'dod blo dang mi gshis kyi nyam nyes bstan 'dug pa ma zad/ dus kyi 'gyur bag rgod po'i 'og gi mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba dang gzhan dbang gis thebs pa'i mi gshis kyi 'khyog bsgyur ni ya nga zhing yid skyo ba zhig tu mthong / ‘‘nus med 'khos chung gi mi sna bkra shis’’kyis drang bden dang rgyu 'bras blo mig srung ba'i‘‘blo 'dun brtan po’’de yang dbang cha dang 'tsho ba'i dka' sdug khrod sgo nga rdo la brdab pa bzhin rang shugs su chag grum byung zhing / gtsub brdar rab dang rim pa brgyud mthar pham kha mi myong thabs med kyi gnas bab dngos kyis nga tshor 'jigs rung gi kha phyogs shig bstan pa'am dus rabs kyi skyo gar zhig 'khrab ston byas yod/ 'di ni nga tsho su yin kyang brgyud dang brgyud bzhin pa'i 'tsho ba'i rang mdangs ngo ma bo yin pas yid la tsag shed gcig min du rgyug srid kyang / don dam du nga tsho'i mtha' 'khor du snang tshul de dag ldog thub mkhan gyi mi bu ga tshod yod — 63 —

rngapa//sa/can/ ::she.ang /kho bo lha byams rgyal gyis bris pa'i na ning do tshigs kyi brtsams sgrung dag la ha cang dga' ba'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di la thug yod/ khos bcoms sgrung gi brjod byar bdams pa'i nang don gang yin kyang mi gshis kyi gting sar yibs pa'i 'dod ham dang chags sred/ pham nyes/ skyo sdug sogs sngog 'don byed ci thub kyis nga tshor gsal 'debs rigs shig byas dang byed bzhin 'dug la/ yang na de dag la dgag rgyag dang sun 'byin gyi lta bas ther 'don byed bzhin 'duga'adi ni de snga'i brtsams sgrung dang 'dra bar byung rim rags mo tsam brgyud de dgag sgrub kyi ched du dgag sgrub byed pa dang / sun 'byin gyi ched du sun 'byin byed pa de tsam las ring du 'gongs yod snyam/ 'di las rtsom rig gi thog ma'i dus skabs bzhin khyed la ngar shugs stsol ba dang legs nyes 'byed pa sogs gtso bo min par/ nga tshor rang nyid ci 'dra ba yin pa de 'dra bar shes rtogs 'byung du bcug yod par ma zad/rtsom rig gi byed nus ni tshad bkag gis zin pa zhig yin pa yang ra sprad yod do/ /kho'i brtsams chos las mthong ba'i yon tan 'di dag ni bdag gis re ltos byed pa'i bcoms sgrung yin pa dang yang na bdag gis re ltos byed pa'i brtsams sgrung dang bar thag nye tsam yod pas kho bo 'di la mi dga' gang la dga' ang /— 64 —

brtsams nga ma lam/2 〈hā pa gsos pa'i zin bris〉kyi rtsom pa po na gzhon brtsams sgrung pa stag 'bum rgyal ni nga tsho su la mtshon na'ang rgyus med cig gtan nas yin mi srid/ khos lo 'di 'ga'i ring gi 'bad pa dang 'bad pa'i 'bras rtags ni bltas bltas rig rig la snga ma dang bsdur na phyi ma las shes thub la/ grangs spus nyis cha nas gzhan gang gis kyang tshab byed mi thub pa'i tshad la bslebs yod pa ni kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar lags/khos bris pa'i brtsams sgrung〈sdug gi lo ma chang gis bangs pa min〉dang〈sde dpon〉〉〈khyi dang bdag po/ da dung gnyen tshan dag〉sogs ni bod kyi deng rabs brtsams sgrung khrod kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i le tshan re re red/ de lta na'ang / cung yid phangs pa zhig la dpyad brjod pa'i sde nas kho'i brtsams sgrung snang med du bskyur 'dug pa'i bsam tshul zhig kho bor dus rgyun skyes yong / 'di ni nga tsho'i las kar 'thus shor byung ba dang ngo tsha zhig ci la min ang /reb 'di'i gleng byar babs pa'i〈hā pa gsos pa'i zin bris〉ni rtsom pa pos nye ba'i char bris pa'i khrod thod brgal gsar pa zhig tu 'dod de/ srid 'dzin sde khag dag na mngon sum mig gis mthong rgyu yod pa'i skyug bro ba'i dpe mtshon gyi snang tshul zhig gtam/ rgyud kyi srad bur brgyus 'dug des mgo khrid mthong na 'dzum dmul dmul dang ldag la khad byed cing / rang rang gi thob thang dang‘‘mdun lam’’gyi — 65 —
