rngapa/spras/zu / :sdo/ched du rtsis thang dang rang bkur gyi 'du shes yod tshad lud pa bzhin thal dong du 'dor pa'i‘‘hā pa’’lta bu'i skyes bo tha shal skor zhig dran du 'jug la/ kho tsho'i bya spyod las‘‘khyi gshis kyi phyed ka mi gshis yin’’la/‘‘mi gshis kyi phyed ka khyi gshis yin pa'ang’’gzhi nas shes thub/ de lta na'ang rtsom pa po'i brjod don ngo ma ni nga tshor hā pa byed par skul ba'am hā par bsngags brjod byas pa min par de las ldog ste/ stag khyi gzig khyi lta bu'i 'phar spyang la 'thab pa'i rtsal dang jag rkun 'gog pa'i spobs pa mkho ba'i 'bod skul btang ba yin no/ /rtsom rig gi mthar thug gi brjod don ni bden dge mdzes gsum yin la/ mi'i mthar thug gi 'tshol snyeg bya yul yang de bzhin bden dge mdzes gsum yin/ de mngon du 'gyur min ni rang gi mi gshis la rag las/ yang mi gshis brlag pa'i gshed ma ni mi'i gnyug gshis su grub pa'i 'dod ham de yin la/ 'dod ham de las yongs su ma thar tshe nga tsho su yin kyang hā pa lta bu zhig tu 'gyur srid pa kho thag yin/ de bas nga tshos rang nyid la do dam dang lta skul/ bsgyur bcos gang legs byas te mi'i rang gshis kyi phyed ka zin pa'i‘‘khyi gshis’’de med par bzo dgos so/ /

brtsams nga ma na lam/brtsams sgrung 'di'i mtshon byed kyi thad nas kha h+phi kha yidu〈〈gzugs 'gyur zin tho〉〉(〈sme༅snyezu〉)dang 'dra sa cung zad yod na'ang / mtha' gcig tu lad zlos byas pa dang mi 'dra bas/ rang gi sa zhing slog cing sa bon btab nas smin pa'i 'bras rdog cig tu brtsi rung la/ lhug brjod kyi thad nas kho'i brtsams chos sngon ma dag dang 'dra bar thabs rtsal la byang ba dang brtse dungs tshod 'dzin byas pa legs shing / byung rim gyi cha nas klog mkhan gyi yid dbang 'dren pa'i nus pa'ang ldan 'dug pas/ nga tsho su yin kyang lta rin klog rin yod pa zhig dang myong rgyu dran rgyu yod pa zhig tu kho bos 'dod do/ /brtsams sgrung 'di bklags tshar dus kho bor yang rtsom pa po dang 'dra bar myong tshor zhig sbyin pa ni/ ‘‘lam sgron gyi 'od kyis ma khyab pa'i mkhar grong 'di'i phyogs bzhi'i mun klong du hā pa mang bo'i zug skad 'ur chil ler 'dug pas/ ngas rang dbang med par pha yul gyi mtshan mo'i dus skabs de dran byung / mtshan mo'i smag rum khrod du 'phar spyang dang srog bsdos kyis dmar 'dzing byed kyin yod pa'i stag khyi gzig khyi rnam dag de tsho dran byung /’’3 〈sdom pa srung ba〉zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung de ni co ne yum tshe ring 〈mkhani rdzongak+tañtsāgatrī/ 'dusgoṣ+ṭa smo'(smotha oṃrke.oṃ 1883—1924)o si khru ri rmi 'i brtsams sgrung mkhan/ brtsams chos

rngabalha'i can/ ::/gis brtsams pa red la/ kho rang brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom gyi las la zhugs nas lo mang po 'gor med/ dus yun thung ngu 'di'i ring la grub 'bras chen po zhig blangs yod ces bshad dka' na'ang / khor mnyam 'jog byed mkhan zhig yin phyin brtsams sgrung thog ma〈med gsum skyabs〉sogs dang bsdur tshe mngon gsal gyis 'phel rgyas chen po byung 'dug pa rtogs thub pa ma zad/ gzhon skyes brtsams sgrung pa dag las ltos bcas kyis 'bur du thon bzhin pa'ang shes srid/ gsham du de 'brel gyi gtam thung ngu zhig brjod par bya ste/spyir na rtsom pa pos gsar rtsom gyi lta bar bkod pa ltar/brtsams chos de'i yang snying ci zhig mtshon yod dam zhe na/ de ni lan 'debs dka' mo zhig yin kyang srid mod/ 'on kyang rtsom mkhan dang klog mkhan gnyis bar mtha' gcig tu go brda 'phrod dgos pa'i nges pa med la/ yang gcig bshad na rtsom rig brtsams chos kyi mtshon don la ni rang rang gi go ba len stangs ltar 'grel mi chog pa'ang med pas/kho bo'i go ba len stangs yin na/ brtsams sgrung de ni bros byol la yong ba'i grwa pa skal bzang grags pa grong chog tu song ba'i gtam rgyud cig ste/tshe ring lha mo dang kho gnyis bar gyi 'jig rten snang bas ma zin pa'i‘‘brtse dung gi myu gu’’de gung du bsgrigs pa zhig red/ des dam tshig gi sdom pa srung ba'i grwa pa zhig yin kyang rang rgyud kyi 'dod pa der bkag sdom byas — 68 —

brtsams nga ma na lam/pa tsam las 'dor dka' ba gsal bshad byas yod par bsams la/dam tshig kho nas phyi'i spyod pa gcun pa ma gtogs nang sems kyi 'gyur ba la ni tshod 'dzin byed mi thub pa'ang shes thub/ 'di ni nga rang la thog mar byin pa'i myong tshor rags rim tsam yin/ yin na yang brtsams sgrung der bkod pa'i mi sna skal bzang grags pa yin rung chog la tshe ring lha mo yin rung chog kho gnyis ka‘‘drang phyogs’’kyi mi sna gnyis yin la/ kun spyod dang mi chos kyi ngos thad nas bshad na skyon gyis ma bslad pa'i‘‘mi gshis gtsang ma’’zhig mjug bar du srung 'dzin byas pas kyang gong bkur gyi sems 'dun ngang gis skyes yong /dge chos kyis‘‘bud med mi dga' skyes pa su zhig mchis/ /skyes pa mi 'dod bud med su zhig yod/ /phyi rol rdzu yi khyad par ma gtogs pa/ / thams cad kun kyang 'di la dga' bar nges’’zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ gal te mi sna gtso bo de gnyis kyis kyang dam tshig ni g.yugakun spyod ni bskyur/ 'dod pa'i las la ni zhugs pa yin na brtsams sgrung 'di'i mjug kyang da lta dang gtan nas mi 'dra la/ klog mkhan gyi myong ba'ang 'di min par gzhan zhig yin srid mod/ 'on kyang mthu btsan pa'i 'jig rten snang ba'i mdun nas kho bos kho gnyis su yin kyang‘‘gu yangs’’mi gtong thabs med yin/gleng ri ba gzhan zhig ni/ brtsams sgrung der bkod pa'i mi sna tshe ge 69 ge

jiḥ/thas/can/ 2sdo/ring lha mo'i gzhung drang dang spyod gtsang gi gshis rgyud de las bod mo phal ba zhig gis 'jig rten dang mi tshe la bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur gsal bor mthong thub la/ mthong bas kyang mo la brtsi 'jog byed 'dod kyi 'dun pa bslangs 'ongs/ nga tshos phyir rang nyid kyi pha yul la phyir lta zhig byas tshe/ skyes pa skor zhig ni phyi rol tu tshong las gnyer bar kha g.yar te rgyan po 'byed pa dang / 'chal spyod la rol ba sogs rnam g.yeng gi las la mtha' gcig tu gzhol ba mthong rgyu ha cang mang de lta na'ang gzhung drang gi chung ma rnams kyi lang tsho'i me tog de byis pa snyor ba dang khyim las sna tshogs byed pa/ kher rkyang dang dran gdung gi tshor ba drag po bcas kyi khrod nas rnyid pa red/ brtsams sgrung des do mi mnyam pa'i gnas bab de dag brgyud nas rlabs chen gyi skyes ma rnams la gdeng 'jog dang bstod bsngags byas 'dug 'di ni rtsom pa pos ched du‘‘bod rigs bud med dag gi gshis rgyud la yi rang dang gus pa byas pa’’zhig kyang yin srid do/ /de bzhin du btsun pa zhig gis rnam kun tu skyabs bslu med dkon mchog gsum la skyabs bcol ba'i 'gyur med dad sems brtan po yang mtshon 'dug la/ ‘‘kho'i lus steng nas byung ba'i rgyun ldan ma yin pa'i 'gyur ldog de dang de yi mjug 'bras thad/ khos mi tshe gcig la 'gyod bshags byas kyang byed chog chog tu gyur yod’’lta bu dang / ‘‘kho ni nyes — 70 —

brtsams nga ma na lam/pa ngang gis bsags pa'i btson ma zhig dang 'dra bar/ lam phran gyi bzhi mdo ru mgo bo gzan gyis btums nas gan rkyal du log 'dug’’lta bu sogs las rang gi‘‘byas nyes’’kyi rin dod du sems kyi mnar gcod gang mang myong bzhin pa'i grwa btsun dag gi sems khams ngo ma bo yang shes rtogs 'byung ba ma zad/ rtsom pa po'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i myong goms dang bsam blo'i zab rgya sogs la'ang nges shes zab gsal rnyed thub bo/ /4 〈gna' grong〉zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung de ni na gzhon brtsams sgrung pa rig ldan rgya mtsho'i smyug rtse nas 'khrungs pa'i bsam blo'i shed che ba'i brtsams sgrung gal chen zhig red la/ chung sa nas bshad na gna' grong gi gnas bab skyo bo dang / che sa nas bshad na bod mi rigs spyi'i bsdus gzugs shig yin par 'dod/gna' grong ni bsdus brjod cig yin la/ gna' grong gi yod tshad kyi yod tshad kyang bsdus brjod cig yin pa red/ gna' grong gi logs su 'bab pa'i‘‘gtsang bo’’de yang gtsang bo zhig ma yin la/ de bzhin du gna' grong gi grong mi thams cad kyang nga tshos dus rgyun mthong thub pa'i grong mi dag dang gtan nas mi 'dra/ rtsom pa po'i smyug 'og gi gna' grong ni sgyid lug dang thabs chag gi 'tsho ba 'ba' zhig la brten cing / gsar gtod dang 'thab 'dzing sogs kyi 'du shes ye — 71 —

rdopa/lhas/25/ 15/nas med pa skor zhig gis grub pa'i grong tsho zhig tu 'bri bzhengs byas 'dug ‘‘khyod kyi skyes dman la rkub chen po zhig gda'’’‘‘khyod kyi skyes dman gyi rkub mi che yang ldem myur che mdog red’’sogs lab gleng gi nang don dang / skabs de'i rnam pa gang la gzhigs kyang gna' grong gi ya nga ba'i gnas bab shes thub/ yin na'ang gna' grong ni snga mo nas da lta'i rnam pa de lta bu zhig rgyud 'dzin byas nas yong ba zhig ma yin te/de ni‘‘'das pa'i dus nam zhig yin pa mi shes kyang / gna' grong gi khor yug tu lo tog btab myong ba 'dra ste/ sa rgod du gyur pa'i sa ngos su rnang zhing gi rjes shul rab rib mthong thub’’pa dang / ‘‘rgan pa rnams kyi ngag las rnang zhing de dag gi steng nas lo tog ci 'dra'i mod po bsdus myong tshul gyi gtam rgyud bshad rgyu yod’’pa las shes thub/ des na gna' grong gi da lta'i gnas bab 'di ji ltar byung ba yin nam/gna' grong gi mi rnams kyis chu'i rin thang ma shes pa yin nam zhe na/ de yang ma yin te/ ‘‘mo sman tshos gtsang bo'i 'gram nas chu len skabs su/ chu drin can 'dis nga tsho 'chi ru ma bcug par bsdad yod ces shes rgya che mdog gis smra zhing / byis pa tshos kyang chu kham gang 'thung na rig pa gsal zhes glu ru len/’’ de bas/ ‘‘gna' grong gi mi su yin rung chu'i rin thang mi shes mkhan gcig kyang yod pa ma red/’’ gtso bo ni kho tshor chu 'dren pa'i blo spobs med pa dang / kho tshos nam yang chu — 72 —

brtsams nga ma na lam/chu ru shes rtogs byung med pa'am shes mi 'dod pa de red/brtsams sgrung 'di'i mi sna gtso bo ste smag rum gyi khrod nas yong zhing smag rum gyi khrod nas phyir cha pa'i1zung zla ba ni phyi yong rig gnas sam sngon thon pa'i mtshon rtags red la/ yang na gna' grong rjes lus dang rmongs gnyid las slong mkhan yang red/ gson nyams kyis stong zhing tshe srog gi rang mdangs dben pa'i gna' grong du/ sbrag khang dang sman khang / slob grwa tshong khang / brnyan 'phrin sogs dus rabs gsar pa'i mtshon rtags ci yang med pa mthong rjes/ kho rang nyid kyi las 'gan ni‘‘lo rgyus rab rib yin pa'i lcags ri’’de tsam la zhib 'jug byed pa kho na tsam ma yin pa rtogs nas/ ljang mdog mkho ba'i gna' grong la chu 'dren 'khor lo bzo ba'i 'char gzhi bzos shing lag len dngos la zhugs/ red ya/ chu yod na ljang mdog yod cing / ljang mdog yod na tshe srog yod pa dang / tshe srog yod tshe da gzod re ba yod pa ma yin nam/ 'char gzhi de'i ched du khos rang shugs yod tshad phul kyang skya ldang sogs kyis 'gal rkyen gang mang bzos pa dang rgyu rkyen gang mang gi dbang gis mjug mthar don thog tu ma 'khyol/ 'di las ci zhig rtogs thub zer na/ gna' grong la mtshon na gnas skabs su chu 'dren 'khor lo bzo rgyu de gtso bo min par grong mi re re'i bsam blor 'gyur ldog 'byung rgyu de yin/ bsam blor 'gyur ldog ma byung tshe bya — 73 —

rngab/sa/zu / :sdo/dngos gsar pa zhig gis gna' grong skyob mi thub na mi rigs shig lhag tu skyob ga la thub/ des na gna' grong la gtan nas re ba med dam zhe na/ de'ang ma yin te dper na/ a stag dang bzod pa ngo lug gnyis gtso byas te sngags rgan 'phrin las dang / a khu bsam gtan bcas kyi steng nas re ba'i me son tsam mthong thub la/1zung zla bas rmo mo tshang nas lus song ba'i‘‘glog sgron’’gyis kyang gna' grong la‘‘'od snang’’phran tsam sbyin srid/gong du kho bos che sa nas bshad na bod mi rigs spyi'i bsdus gzugs red zer don yang / gna' grong dang bod mi rigs gnyis kyi bar mthun chos ha cang mang po zhig yod de/ sgyid lug gi nyams dang ldan pa dang / phyi yong rig gnas(rig gnas gsar pa)la rgyang bkyed pa/bsam blo rjes lus yin pa sogs mang bo mang bo zhig ci 'dra'i cha 'dra ang / ‘‘gna' grong gi chag 'jig 'di nas mjug rdzogs na bzang /da mjug rdzogs ran yang red/’’da wa nga tsho mi rigs 'di'i chag 'jig kyang de bzhin no/ /mjug gi gtam/gong gi brtsams sgrung 'di bzhi bo ni nga rang nyid kyis2006lo'i brtsams sgrung ches legs gras su rtsi bzhin yod la/ brtsams sgrung 'di — 74 —

brtsams nga ma lam/dag bklags pas kho bos mig snga'i brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom la bcangs pa'i phyogs lhung gi bsam tshul la 'gyur ldog byung zhing / ma 'ongs pa'i brtsams sgrung gi mdun lam thad yid ches je brtan du gyur/ mi rigs shig la rtsom rig dar yod med de brtsams sgrung dar yod med dang /brtsams sgrung gi chu tshad mtho dmas tshad 'jal ba yin zer/ denu/ na rang re la ni brtsams sgrung rgya cher dar 'dug ces brjod mi spobs na'ang / gsar rtsom pa rnams kyi smyu gu'i 'degs 'jog bsgyur pa'i gnas bab la bltas na nyams dga' ba'i tshor ba zhig ngang ngam shugs kyis byin 'ongs pas/ kho tshor re ltos byed rin yod ces pa ni kho bo'i skabs 'di'i bsam tshul zhig kyang ngo / /brtsams sgrung dang sgyu rtsal brtsams chos gang yin kyang dus rabs kyi 'gan 'khri rlabs po che phrag tu bzhes pa yin na/ skad cig gi ring la rgyug che ba'i glu gzhas lta bu tsam min par yun nas yun du gnas srid pa ni 'dzam gling gi brtsams chos grags chen skor zhig la mjal bas kyang shes thub/ gnas skabs su nga tshor de lta bu'i brtsams chos chen po byung med kyang / yid pham dang blo chad dor nas mtha' gcig tu 'bad pa byas tshe/ ma 'ongs pa na rtsom rig gi gar stegs spyi la dbang sgyur pa'i rtsom pa po 'byung mi srid ces su zhig gis smra thub/ tshad nges can zhig nas brtsams chos legs 'grub 'byung min de gtso bo rtsom pa po'i rnam — 75 —

thabathagazum/ :sdo/'gyur la rag las pas/ rnam 'gyur drang zhing brtse dungs yod pa/'gan khur pa bcas kyi sgo nas gsar rtsom gyi lam du 'bad pas zhugs tshe/ da gzod brtse sems kyis khengs shing yar skul gyi bsam blo mngon pa/ mi chos ring lugs kyi bro bas phyug pa sogs don ngo ma'i steng gi brtsams chos kyang 'khrungs srid snyam/ der brten rtsom pa po re res rang steng nas mgo brtsams te rtsom rig gi blo spyong je mthor gtong ba dang / spyi tshogs kyi nyams myong gsog 'jog byed pa/ mig rgyang je ring du gtong ba/ shes bya'i sgrig gzhi 'thus tshang du gtong ba sogs la brtson te rang re'i bod kyi brtsams sgrung gi mdun lam khod yangs dang rgya cher spel bar brtson pa ma lhod cig ces kyang zhu'o/ /mjug mthar〈sbrang char〉gyis mu mthud du bod rtsom gsar pa'i 'phel rgyas thad byas rjes sngar bas chen po 'jog pa'i zol med re 'dun snying nas bcangs pa yin/

yag thog yag rtse gi bodakli dpyad brjod pa'i sde/yag thog yag rtseg gi bod kyi dpyad brjod pa'i sde/da wabod kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyi gnas bab la gzhigs pa/rtsom rig dpyad brjod ni gal che zhing dka' tshegs kyis khengs pa'i bya gzhag cig yin/ drang mo drang gzhag gi rtsom rig dpyad brjod des mi gzhan la go 'dzol thebs su 'jug pa ma zad tha na sdang sems kyang bskyed srid/ 'on kyang /dpyad brjod mkhan ngo ma zhig byed 'dod tshe rtsom pa po'i sdang sems dang / tha na gnod pa bskyal yang dang len byed pa'i blo spobs mnga' dgos/ rgyu mtshan ni rtsom pa pos khyed nyid dgra ru 'dzin mkhan ji ltar mang na de ltar dpyad brjod mkhan ngo ma zhig yin pa ra sprod thub la/ mthar thug gi bstod bsngags longs su spyod pa'i skal ba'ang ldan pa red/da li can cun gyi〈rtsom rig dang dus rabs kyi dgra bo〉las drangs/rang re'i bod la rtsom rig gsar pa'i lus 'di rgya khyab tu dar nas lo ngo mang po zhig 'gor med pas phul du byung ba'i brtsams chos grags chen 'di yin ces kun la ngom ri ba zhig 'dren dgos tshe dngos gnas khag po yin la/ de bzhin du rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyi thad nas grub 'bras mngon gsal blangs yod mkhan ni 'di yin ces bgrang dgos tshe lhag tu dka' tshod du gda'/ rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyi las la 'jug mkhan re 'ga' yod pa de dag gis kyang rtsom rig dpyad brjod de rang — 77 —

rngarnga /sa/zu / ::/gi bya gzhag cig tu brtsis nas 'bad dungs dungs byed mkhan ha cang nyung bar‘‘ma rmos lo tog mthong ba na sil kwa g.yug 'gro ba’’dang‘‘ri bong mthong ba na ma rmos lo tog bskyur 'gro bas’’rtsom rig brtsams chos kyi sne 'dren thub kyin med/ mang shos ni grogs por brtse 'dang che ba dang‘‘kha yag ngo bstod la dga' ba'i dpyad brjod pa’’tag tag yin pas/rang gi grogs por bstod ci thub dang rang gi dge rgan sogs sha nye 'brel la bstod pa 'then rkyang byed pa red/ snang tshul de dag mthong thengs rer rang re'i rtsom rig 'di yar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro ba dang rtsom rig dpyad brjod 'di gnad du things shing don du smin pa zhig yong dka' 'o snyam pa'i sems khral zhig rgyun du mi 'dod bzhin du skyes 'ongs pas/ kho bos rang re'i mig snga'i bod kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod pa'i sde 'di la btsog bshad byas na‘‘rul sungs skyug bro'i bod kyi dpyad brjod pa'i sde’’dang / cung yag bshad byas na‘‘yag thog yag rtseg gi bod kyi dpyad brjod pa'i sde’’zhes 'bod pa las 'os med do/ /dpe deb khag la blta tsam byas na nga tshos yod tshad shes thub te/dper na/ ‘‘〈nyi ma dang nyi ma'i lug khyu〉〉zhes pa 'di ni mdo dbus mtho sgang gi 'brog pa rnams kyi dka' spyad sdug rus kyi snying stobs dang /las dbang / mdun lam bcas sgyu rtsal gyi thabs lam nas mtshon pa'i snyan ngag cig yin pa'i khar/ de'i brjod bya'i don zab cing brtse — 78 —

yag thog yag rtseg gi bodakli dpyad brjod pa'i sde/dung dri ma med pas phyug pa/ snyan ngag gi nyams rtsol med du thon pa/sbas don thon pa/ 'char snang phun sum tshogs pa/ mtshon nus chen po yod pa bcas kyi khyad chos yongs su rdzogs pas/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur ldan pa red’’dulta bu dang / ‘‘nga tshos sgrung ring 'di(〈srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa〉)la lta klog byas na/ bod mi'i dad pa'i stobs shugs dang tshe srog gi rin thang lta ba dag dpung du bsdebs nas klog mkhan gyi sems la gtses par byed pa ma zad/ rdo pha bong chen po gnyis bar btsir ba'i snang ba ster ba'i brjod don zab mo de rim bzhin sems kyis myangs thub’’du sogs 'di lta bu'i tshad las brgal ba'i bstod bsngags kyi dpyad gtam ga sa gang du khyab yod pa red/yag la yag rtseg pa de dngos gnas legs mod kyang mi yag bzhin du yag bstod byed pa ni 'gan ma khur ba'i dpyad brjod cig dang /gzhan la gnod bskyal ba'i bya spyod ngan pa zhig kyang yin pas nga tsho‘‘bstod tshogs’’dang ring du 'bral ci thub bya dgos/ de dang 'bral ma thub tshe nga tsho bod kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod de nam yang shing gi seng ge zhig dang 'dra bar 'jigs 'jigs 'dra yang snying bo ci yang med do/ /kho bo'i bsam tshul ltar na/ spyir btang du rtsom rig dpyad skrun khaX / ṭ+wāṃñtshadzī ṣ+ṭṛ spyi // kyā kyu/n+da khyo /sgruji /rtermi ṭī sdispyalda nā rmi rmi ldit+na /gyes skyimāṃ dzināsnya rnosnyi paṭ+wāṃ3/0mi rigs dpe

rngapa/thas/zum/ :sdo/brjod kyi mdung kha de gtso bo brtsams chos gang de'i mi 'dang sa dang zhan char gtad na 'grig ste/ rgyu mtshan ni rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyi byed nus gtso bo ni mthar gtugs na rtsom rig brtsams chos de je rgyas je legs su gtong bar sne khrid rgyu de las ma 'das so/ /nga tsho bod kyi rtsom rig brtsams chos la spyi'i cha nas gtam rgyud rdzun bzo dang /thabs rtsal 'tshol ba/ rnam pa gtsigs su 'dzin pa bcas kyi gnad don gang mang yod pa ni dpyad brjod pa'i khrod du yag thog la yag rtseg pa las skyon cha la mdzub mo ker mkhan med pas lan pa red la/dpyad brjod par gzhung lugs kyi rgyab rten gnyom zhing dgag sgrub kyi snying stobs zhan pas kyang red/nga tsho'i dpyad brjod pa la shas kyis nub phyogs kyi gzhung lugs gang mang zhig la bltas med kyang / rna thos go thos dang deb gzhan gyi steng du lung drangs 'dug pa de ji bzhin bshus nas rang gis dngos su bltas myong khul byed pa dang / mkhas chen dag gi ming bkol te nyams ston pa/ brjod gzhir babs pa'i bye brag gi brtsams chos de'i skyon yon ring du dor nas 'brel med don gzhan skor zhig(thad kar 'brel ba med pa) gleng ste rang gi‘‘lta rgya mthong rgya’’ngom so byed pa/ yang na/phan tshun bar dma' 'beb dang khyad gsod byas te kha ming sna ming 'dogs pa dang / mtshang gi ched du mtshang 'dru ba sogs ngan pa rul — 80 —

yag thog yag rtseg gi bodakli dpyad brjod pa'i sde/sungs kyi dpyad brjod spel bar mgo 'khor 'dug pas/ nga tsho'i dpyad brjod kyi gnas bab ha cang sdug la gom kha shin tu dal ba'i snang tshul ya nga ba 'di byung ba red/snang tshul gzhan zhig ni kha sang de ring kha pho kho nar brten nas gzhan rnams bsgyel 'dod kyi dpyad brjod spel mkhan yang kha shas byung dang 'byung bzhin yod de/ dper na/ pe cin nas yin pa'i ming la 'khyug 'od zer ba zhig gis/ de snga sku zhabs bdud lha rgyal gyis snyan ngag pa ljang bur bris pa'i dpyad thung〈khyod kyis kher rkyang gi sdug bsngal bzod thub kyang nga tshos snyan rtsom gyi bslu brid ldog dka'〉zhes par bltas rjes/ de ni sku zhabs bdud lha rgyal gyis snyan ngag pa ljang bu snyan ngag gi stegs bu nas rgyang phud gtong rtsis byed pa red ces dkrog gtam bzo ba dang / der mthud nas‘‘lo ngo 'di 'dra'i ring la rtsom rig dpyad mol gyi las ka gnyer cing bod kyi rtsom stegs sger gcod byed par 'dod pa'i slob dpon khyed rang gis snyan ngag dang skad cha'i bar gyi dbye ba yang rtogs med dam/ snyan ngag la 'grel bshad rgyag mi rung la 'grel na snyan ngag tu mi 'gro ba'i gnas lugs spyir btang ba 'di yang mi rtogs sam’’du zhes khungs med kyi kha pho mthon po sgrog ste snyan ngag ni rjo mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur/2006lo'i zla9pa'i tshes10nyin gyi par ngos ba'i par gsal/— 81 —

2pa lhas/zum/ :sdo/'grel du mi rung ba dang 'grel du rung na snyan ngag tu mi 'gro tshul sogs skad cha‘‘ya ma brla’’bshad 'dug pa ma zad/ yang‘‘phran chung nga yis mthong ba la khyed nyid brtsams sgrung la dpyad pa spel bar mkhas po 'dug la/ de mu mthud du rgyun legs po zhig bskyangs na chog par snyam mod/da dung snyan ngag yang dbang du bsgyur 'dod na lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉dang de'i rjes kyi〈'khor ba'i snying bo〉sogs las mar la mi yong ba zhu’’dhisogs brtag pa'i gtam mi smra bar gtam cha ma cha log gang byung du 'chad pa ni rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyi lam gyi bkag rdo lta bur mthong zhes kho bos brjod 'dod cing / de dang chabs cig dri ba 'di 'dra yang mi 'don thabs med yin te/ rang re'i rig gnas kyi zhing sa dog mo 'dir dgag sgrub dang / dogs slong / 'tshol rtog bcas kyi sa bon zhig gdab dgos tshe der myu gu 'bus shing 'dab lag rgyas sa'i khor yug cig mi bskrun pa 'di ci yin nam/ 'di ni dngos gnas ha go thabs mi 'dug cing yid phangs sa ches che ba yang yin no/ /des na/ don dam du rtsom rig dpyad brjod ni ji lta bu zhig yin dgos zhe na/ gcig mthun gyi lta tshul zhig nam yang 'byung dka' mod/'on kyang / ngas bltas na ka bar 'jags ma'i lhan pa glan pa dang /() 〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉2006lo'i zla9pa'i tshes10nyin gyi par ngos bzhi par gsal/

yag thog yag rtseg gi bodat+pa dpyad brdzod pa'i sde/bka' dris sngon por zhu lan ljang khu brjod pa lta bu zhig ma yin la/dgod khar bltas na dgod bro ba dang / ngu khar bltas na ngu bro ba lta bu zhig kyang ma yin/ lhag tu kha shas kyis dpyad brjod dang dpyad brjod spel yu/la gnyis so sor gyes te lung rigs skam po gang mang mi 'os bzhin du btsan gyis drangs nas brjod byar babs pa'i brtsams chos gang de'i skyon yon sgrib pa'am khral khrul du bzo ba zhig de bas kyang ma yin/dpyad brjod ngo ma de ni sems dang sems pa'i bar gyi bgro gleng dang / rnag thog khab gtsag dang nad thog sman ster lta bu zhig yin dgos la/ dpyad brjod ngo ma de ni phan tshun dkyel yangs dang brtsi bkur byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng nas byung ba'i rtsod gleng dang dgos nges kyi skyon brjod cig yin pas/ dgag sgrub dang ther 'don med pa'i dpyad brjod de ni nam yang dpyad brjod ngo mar 'gyur mi srid/ nga tsho'i rtsom rig brtsams chos de nad pa cig yin pa'i dbang du btang na/da ni der gshag bcos byed spyad kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod ces pa'i gri chung de bed spyod chen po ma byas gong nas rdugs to zhig tu gyur 'dug pas/ de la rno ngar zhig cis kyang gsar du snon thabs ma byas na phan thogs ci yang mi 'byung ba'i tshod du gda' 'o/ /‘‘dpyad brjod pa ngo ma zhig yin na/ rtsom pa po'i nor 'khrul sna — 83 —

rngarnga/zlas can/ ::/tshogs rtogs mkhan zhig dang bsdu nyar byed mkhan zhig yin no’’zhes pa ltar/ nga tshos rnam kun tu rtsom pa po'i brtsams chos la zhib klog byed pa dang brtsams chos khrod kyi skyon char nyams zhib gang mang byed dgos/'di ni dpyad brjod pa zhig la nges par du tshang dgos pa'i cha rkyen yin la/ dpyad brjod pa zhig gis dpyad brjod la bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur yang de las shes thub pa yin/ rtsom rig dpyad brjod ni brtsams chos zhib klog gi rmang gzhi'i steng nas 'byung dgos kyi rang snang gang rdol gyi gtam yan zhig min pas/ nga tsho'i dpyad brjod pa kha shas kyis rtsom pa po'i brtsams chos la bam klog tsam byas rjes spyi 'gros lta bu'i dpyad brjod spel thub thub byed pa ni dpya khral sprod thabs tsam las ci yang min/ der brten/ rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyis thon dgos pa'i nus pa ste rtsom pa po dang dpyad brjod pa'i bar phan tshun skul 'ded byed thub med pa red/lhag tu na ning do tshigs dra ba dang dgon grong dus deb sna tshogs char shul gyi sha mo brdol ba bzhin byung bas/ rtsom yig gang mang zhig klog mkhan gyi spyan lam du dus ltar bstar ba'i go skabs smin na yang /sgyid lug gi rtsom 'bri'i rnam pas khengs shing / kun spyod dang mi chos yod tshad rdog brdzis su gtong ba'i‘‘lbu sob can’’gyi bcoms chos je mang nas je mang yin pas/ dpyad brjod pa zhig yin na rang gi gzhung — 84 ge

yag thog yag rtseg gi bodashra dpyad brjod pa'i sde/lugs kyi rmang gzhi sra brtan du gtong ci thub dang / rang gi rgyu 'bras blo mig la brten nas dpyad brjod spel ba'i spobs sems bdog dgos la/ de lta bu'i 'gan 'khri yang yod do/ /rang rer dpe re blangs na/ nga tshor〈〈〈snasems nadaze༄las byung ba'i sems nad〉〉rjo lta bu'i rtsom rig dpyad brjod dgos la/ 〈sgo 'gram gyi 'grul pa gtol med pa〉dhi lta bu dang / 〈'ud shob dang rdzun bzo 'di su'i red〉rjo lta bu'i rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyang dgos/nga tshor 'di las lhag pa'i drang gtam brjod par spobs pa'i rtsom rig dpyad brjod de bas kyang dgos pas/ kho bos de lta bu'i rtsom rig dpyad brjod gang mang rang re'i dpyad brjod kyi las la 'jug mkhan rnams kyi smyug rtse nas 'khrungs par sgug yod la/ yid ches kyang chen po bcangs yod de/ rgyu mtshan ni/ rtsom rig dpyad brjod legs po zhig yin tshe/ des rtsom rig brtsams chos gong du spel bar skul 'ded gtong thub la/ de ni deng rabs rig gnas gong du spel ba'i dgos mkho yang yin no/ /2006lo'i zla10pa'i tshes11nyin gyi mtshan mor zi ling du/n+ti snitram̐ hūṃ sdi ñtsā rno/ rto//ṭāṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃtwes saṭ+wāṃ /ldaṭā /h+phi na/ nan mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 2004lo'i zla6pa'i par/

shes yon can dang‘‘ri sa nga rul sungs’’shes yon can dang‘‘rigs gzhung rul sungs’’las grogs shig gi kha nas dge rganakhogyis bod kyi dus skabs gsar pa'i brtsams sgrung skor gyi dpyad brjod deb cig par skrun gnang 'dug pa go rjes/ kho bo spro snang dang bcas zi ling gi rlangs 'khor sa tshigs nye 'dabs kyi bod yig dpe khang yod sar thengs gcig mi 'gro ka med byung / dpe khang dang po'i nang phyin te sbyin bdag la dge rganasagyis brtsams pa'i dpe deb de yod med skor dris par/ kha sang so ma btsongs tshar song / khyod rang dpe khang gzhan du song la ltos dang phal cher yod kyi red zer/ dpe khang gnyis pa'i sbyin bdag la dris par/btsongs tshar song / nyin 'ga'i rjes su shog dang yod zer/ rlangs 'khor sa tshigs kyi nye 'dabs su bod yig dpe khang mang po yod pas nyin 'gar sgug don med snyam nas dpe khang gsum par song ba na stabs legs pa zhig la da dung dpe deb gcig lhag 'dug de las dge rganakhogyi dpe deb 'di nyo mkhan mang ba'ang shes thub pas/ kho bor sngar bas kyang klog 'dod kyi 'dun pa zhig drag tu skyes/dpe deb de'i ming la〈dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi sgrung gtam la dpyad pa blo gsar dgyes pa'i dga' ston〉zer zhi/nga / de klog pa'i — 89 —

rngabathagazugi khab 2dogo rim khrod rtsom 'di 'dra zhig yar sngon dpe deb cig gi steng nas mthong myong ba 'dra ba'i tshor snang zhig sbyin 'ongs pas/ dge rganasagyis gzhan gyi brtsams chos bshu 'bri 'dra byas pa e yin snyam pa'i dogs pa tsha bo zhig skyes pa'i mod la/ rang gi bsam tshul ya ma brla 'di ni mi dkar po'i mgo la zhwa nag po skon pa'i dpe ru 'gro bar dogs pas khengs/ dge rganasani slob chen ga ge mo'i dge rgan chen mo zhig yin pa ma zad/ bod yul du skad grags che ba'i rtsom pa po zhig kyang yin pas de 'dra dpe mi srid snyam/ yin na yang ngas rang gi dogs slong gi mgo bo cis kyang gnon thabs bral bas de 'brel gyi dpe deb skor zhig bskyar du mi klog ka med byung /dpe deb dang po ni〈sbrang char〉gyi lo ngo nyi shu'i dpe tshogs las〈dpyad rtsom tshangs pa'i thig ris〉dang / dpe deb gnyis pa ni〈bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs〉las〈rtsom dpyad gtam tshogs〉yin/dpe deb 'di gnyis bklags pa'i go rim khrod nga rang ha las shing hang sangs par gyur pa ni dge rganakhogyis bod kyi dus skabs gsar pa'i brtsams sgrung skor la zhib 'jug gnang ba'i deb de'i gleng gzhi'i phyed ka ni〈bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs〉kyi〈sngon 'gro'i gtam〉las ji bzhin bshus 'dug de las kyang tshabs che ba ni sa bcad gnyis pa dang gsum pa/ bzhi pa/ lnga pa bcas ni go po lin zer bas bris pa'i— 90 —

rngab/sa/zum/ :sdo/'jug gi grub 'bras red zer na ngo mas yid sems skyo bar 'gyur/rgyu mtshan ga re red zer na/ khong gi rtsom yig der sku zhabs pad ma 'bum gyi〈mi rabs gsar pa'i snying khams kyi 'phar lding〉zhes pa las tshan pa tshan pa byas te bshus 'dug la/ de min lung 'dren dus lung khungs gnyis pa ni pad ma 'bum gyi〈mi rabs gsar pa'i snying khams kyi 'phar lding〉las drangs pa yin na'ang / yi dam tshe ring lags kyi〈snyan ngag gi bla srog bshad pa〉zhes pa las drangs par bshad 'dug pas/dpyad rtsom 'bri dus gzab nan gyi rnam 'gyur bzung mi 'dug pa rtogs thub/ gzhan yang shog ngos dgu tsam gyis grub pa'i rtsom 'di las pad ma 'bum gyis bris pa rnams blangs shing / de nas lung gzhan pa rnams logs su bkar tshe dge rganakhorang nyid kyis bris pa shul du nyung shas las lhag mi 'dug pas/ dngos gnas dge rganasalags ni rigs gzhung zhib 'jug byed mkhan rul sungs pa zhig yin pa gsal bor shes pa'i mod la/ khong gi rtsom yig de dag bklags pas klog pa po bdag la mgo skor btang song snyam pa'i khong khro zhig kyang skyes byung ba dang /dus deb dang dpe skrun khang de dag gi rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa rnams kyi lta rgya mthong rgyar dogs pa za zhing 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes gnyom pa'ang zhar du rtogs byung /don rkyen 'di gzhir bzung nas kho bos brjod 'dod pa ni/— 92 —

sa yon can dang‘‘ri sa nga rul sungs’’brku 'bri bshu 'bri byed pa de da lta'i rigs gzhung zhib 'jug gi khyab khongs nang cung‘‘rgyun 'byams’’su song yod phyir/ dge rganakholags gcig pu'i byas nyes su brtsis na khong gis mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur 'dzin srid la/ lhag par du kho bo ha las shing hangs sangs zhes bshad na/ mi mang po zhig gis kho bor khrel dgod byed pa yang gdon mi za mod/ nga tshos bsam gzhig zhib tu btang tshe/ gnas tshul de ni rang re'i shes yon can re re nas dogs zon dang mnyam 'jog bya yul zhig yin pa ma zad/ 'dis bzos pa'i ngan 'bras ni ri rab las kyang lci la mtsho mo las kyang zab bo /‘‘mkhas brgya 'gran gleng’’dang‘‘me tog mnyam bzhad’’ni dus rabs kyis nga tsho rig gnas pa'i sde la bton pa'i blang bya yin la/rtsom rig sgyu rtsal dang rigs gzhung zhib 'jug sogs phyogs sgo mo nas 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i thabs lam gtso bo zhig kyang yin pas/ 'gran gleng med na 'phel rgyas med zer ba yang gnad dam pa'o/ /yin na'ang mkhas brgya 'gran gleng gi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen ni gzu bor gnas pa dang /brtag pa'i gtam smra ba/ rang gi lta tshul dang rang gi langs phyogs gtsigs su 'dzin pa las/ rang nyid kyi lag tu 'tshal ba'i gzhan gyi grub 'bras dang gzhan gyi bsam blo ci dgar bshu 'bri dang brku 'bri byed pa ni/ rigs gzhung kun spyod steng nas bltas na'ang 'dra/ rgyu — 93 —

rngabathas/zum/ :sdo/'bras blo mig steng nas bshad kyang chog rigs gzhung zhib 'jug gi khor yug gtsang ma zhig chags pa dang mu mthud du 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i dgra bo nyid do/ / de bas me stag chung dus nas gsod pa'i dpe bzhin nga tshos sngon 'gog byed pa las mthong yang ma mthong khul byed pa ni gtan nas mi rung ba yin/ gal te sngon 'gog ma byas tshe des bskyed pa'i mjug 'bras ni nad yams bzhin phyogs so sor khyab srid la/lhag par du phyi rabs pa yongs la shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs shing gol lam du 'dzol bar sne khrid nges pas cis kyang rang rang sa nas bsam blo zhib mo btang ste gzab gzab byed dgos pa'i mi tshad/ skyon gyis nongs pa la nongs par rtogs te phyin chad de ltar mi bya ba'i dam tshig yang dag par 'dzin rgyu ha cang gal che'o/ /yang gcig bshad na/ kho bos rtsom 'di 'bri ba'i dmigs yul yang de tsam las mtshang gi ched du mtshang 'dru ba min pas dge rganakhol phog thug 'dra bzos song snyam na khong the ba'i khong gi rjes 'brangs pa yongs nas dkyel yangs gnang rogs/zhar byung /rtsom thung 'di bris tshar rjes kyi nyin zhig la kho bo rlangs 'khor sa tshigs kyi dpe tshong khang zhig tu phyin pa na/ de gar〈rgya bod tshan rtsal gzhung lugs kyi rnam bshad〉 ces pa'i dpe cha zhig mthong ba dang /— 94 —

sa yo can dang‘‘ri sa nga rul sungs’’bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la de ru brku bshu byas pa'i gnas tshul 'di 'dra zhig kyang rnyed/ dpe cha de'i shog ngos95nas119bar tshig gcig kyang ma lus par gzhan rtsom bshus 'dug gzhan rtsom de'i ming la〈brda chad tshad ldan dang lo tsā'i 'brel ba ji ltar bed spyod tshul〉zer zhing / 2002lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas par du bskrun pa'i〈brda chad rig pa'i gzhung lugs mdor bsdus〉zhes par 'khod la/gong gi 〈 rgya bod tshan rtsal gzhung lugs kyi rnam bshad〉 ces pa ni2005lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa yin pas su yis gang nas bshus pa ma bshad rang shes red/rigs gzhung zhib 'jug kyang‘‘rul sungs’’yin pa'i gnas tshul skyo bo 'di la gzhigs te/ kho bos rgyal khab kyi〈〈rtsom dbang bca' khrims〉 thengs gcig bklags pa na/ de'i tshan pa gnyis par/gzhan rtsom lung du 'dren pa'am bed spyod gtong na nges par du rtsom pa po gang de'i ming dang brtsams chos kyi ming gsal bor 'bri ba las gang dgar bshus mi chog la/ de lta ma yin tshe khrims chad phog pa'i gnas lugs gsal bor bsgrags 'dug pas/ 'dir‘‘mkhas pa’’de'i rigs la gsal 'debs byas pa tsam mo /2006 5 10nyin zi ling du/— 95 —

2rwa rmis/zu / ::sherigs gzhung zhib 'jug gi gol lam dang dgra bo/da wasku zhabs rnam sras lags la springs pa'i mngon bsgrags yi gegus par 'os pa'i skya zhabs rnam sras lags/bde bar bzhugs lags sam/nga ni khyed kyi klog pa po dkyus ma zhig ste/ snga mo nas nyid kyi gsung rtsom gsar pa zhig dpar du btab yod pa'i skor gyi gtam thos na'ang / lo gsar gyi snga gzhug tu gzhung don la brel ba dang rang gi bya ba tsag tsig la mgo 'khor nas da bar du lus song / khe nyin 'grul pa zhig skyel ba'i zhor du rlangs 'khor 'bab tshigs su thengs gcig phyin par khyed kyi gsung rtsom〈deng rabs bod kyi snyan ngag gsar pa la dpyad pa blo gsar dgyes pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so〉(gsham nas〈blo gsar dgyes pa'i dga' ston〉zhes bsdu rgyu yin)zhes pa de blu ba'i go skabs byung zhing / deb kyi kha byang mthong ba'i mod la kho bor sngar med kyi spro snang chen po zhig kyang cig car du bstsal song / gcig na rang rer de'i skor gyi gzhung lugs kyi deb nyung ba dang / gnyis na rang nyid kyang na gzhon rtsom dga' zhig yin pas dpe cha de rigs la lta rgyu byung na rang nyid kyi bsam pa'i rgyags phye gya nom pa zhig tu rtsi bzhin yod/yin na'ang spro snang de nyid kyi gsung rtsom dngos su tshar gcig bklags — 96 —

ri sa nga ba 'ju la lam dang dgra bo/pas me tog sad kyis bcom pa bzhin yongs su zhi bar gyur/ rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ khyed kyi gzhan rtsom bshu 'dren byed pa'i‘‘nad rnying’’de la drag skyed cung tsam yang byung med pa ma zad sngar las kyang tshabs chen du 'gyur bzhin 'dug pas so/ /yar sngon kho bos khyed kyi brtsams deb〈dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi sgrung gtam la dpyad pa blo gsar dgyes pa'i dga' ston〉dang dpyad rtsom〈bod kyi snyan ngag gsar pa'i skor cung zad gleng ba〉sogs brtsams chos 'ga' la mjal rjes/ 〈shes yon can dang‘‘rigs gzhung rul sungs’’〉〉zhes pa'i rtsom thung zhig bris te gzhan rtsom bshu 'dren byed pa de ni rul sungs kyi rigs gzhung zhib 'jug byed thabs shig dang / de min〈rtsom dbang bca' khrims〉la'ang 'gal 'dug pa'i skor nas lta tshul phran tsam brjod myong mod/ yid skyo ba zhig la da thengs yang gnas tshul de 'drar 'phrad pas yang bskyar khyed la 'o brgyal mi bzo ka med byung / khyed ni skal ldan slob bu rnams kyi gong du mar 'khor nas sdod mkhan zhig yin pas/ na tshod gnyom la shes rgya chung ba'i blo dman bdag 'dras gnas lugs brjod pa ni 'bu bse bos 'brong la rwa g.yug pa'i zla bor cis mi 'gyur/ de bas bdag gis lag tu bzung ba'i smyu gu 'di thengs mang logs su bskyur nas khyed la‘‘gu yangs’’gtong 'dod kyi bsam pa gcig min du skyes na'ang / 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes drag po — 97 —

rngabaspras/zum/ :sdo/zhig gam rgyu 'bras blo mig gi mig gnyis kyis kho bor cer rer bltas yod pas the tshom dang bcas 'phrin pa 'di 'bri ba'i ngal ba mi 'dod bzhin du phrag la len dgos byung / 'di nas ched du sku nyid la gsal bshad byed dgos pa zhig ni/ nga ni na gzhon rtsom dga' zhig las deng rabs snyan ngag sogs la nang byan chud pa'i mkhas pa ni min la/ khyed la bsam gzas nas don med snyad dkri ba sogs kyi kun slong ngan pa yang ci yang med pa ma zad/ nged gnyis bar la rtsod pa dang 'khon 'dzing sogs lhag tu cang med pa khyed kyis kyang shes gsal ltar lags/des na yang yang khyed la skyon brjod byed don ni ga re yin zer na/yod tshad kyi yod tshad da ci gong du smras pa'i khyed rang gi‘‘nad rnying’’de la rag las pa yin/ gsham nas brjod don dngos la 'jug par bya ste/drang po drang gzhag gi sgo nas bshad na/ nyid kyi gsung rtsom de ni brtsams pa zhig ga la yin te ma red do/ /brtsams pa'i tshad gzhi ltar lta dgos tshe kho bor dgod rgyu dang ngu rgyu gnyis ka dus mnyam du skyes yong /la btus lung btus dang brku 'dren bshu 'dren gyis grub pa'i deb cig kyang brtsams pa yin zer na/ 'jig rten du deb rtsom pa dang mkhas par 'gyur rgyu las sla mo zhig gang du yod/ khyed kyis〈'go brjod〉du‘‘dpe cha 'di 'bri ba'i dus tshod thung ba'i khar slob khrid sogs las ka'i brel ba che zhing / gzhan du na snyan ngag pa so sor 'brel gtug dang kha — 98 —

ri sa nga ba 'ju la lam dang dgra bo/brda bya rgyu'i go skabs shin tu phra bar gyur khar/ khong tsho'i brtse dung gi 'jig rten du zhugs ma thub pa bcas ni rgyu rkyen de yi lan du song bas dpyad pa gnad du khel zhing zab tshad yod pa zhig tu ma 'khyongs par phangs sems skyes bzhin 'dug’’ces brjod pa ni don dngos yin kyang srid mod/ 'on kyang kho bo'i bsam tshul ltar na rgyu rkyen de dag ni kha g.yar sa tsam las gtso bo nyid kyis rigs gzhung zhib 'jug la bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur mi drang ba de yin par 'dod/ bya ba ci zhig sgrub kyang rnam 'gyur legs po min tshe‘‘gnad du khel zhing zab tshad yod pa’’zhig ga la 'khyongs/ de ni dpe mi srid zhig ma yin nam/ klog mkhan rnams kyis bltas na de 'dra e red/deb der bkod pa'i rtsom yig mang che shos ni rtsom pa po rang gis bsam gzhig btang zhing zhib 'jug byas pa min par brku 'dren bshu 'dren byas pa red ce na/ rtsom mkhan the ba'i klog mkhan rnams kyis khas mi len zhing / ma rtsom dang nyid kyi‘‘brtsams chos’’gnyis go bsdur te bklags ma myong mkhan rnams kyis kho bos khungs med 'chal gtam smra ba dang / khyi rgyags pas nam mkha'i skar mar zug pa red ces kyang smra na/ ma rtsom dang bshus rtsom gnyis bsdur nas gang bden gang rdzun thang ma bzhin brdal nas gsal bar byed pa la/sa 1ma rtsom/

rngarwa/zlas/(5/ ::/‘‘ deng dus yongs grags kyi bshad tshul ltar na/ srol rgyun gyi ngos na mdzes dpyod dang lta ba rnam pa gnyis grub yod zer/ gcig ni nub gling pa'i ‘slar mtshon’gyi mdzes dpyod dang / cig shos ni rgya nag gi gna' srol gyi6snyan ngag gi khams’kyi mdzes dpyod lta ba'o/ /snga ma nub gling par mtshon na/ kho tsho'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyab khongs thams cad na ches gsal ba'i 'tsho ba'i brnyan ris kyis khyab ste yod la/ snyan ngag kyang de dang de mtshungs yin par 'dod/ phyi ma rgya'i gna' srol snyan ngag la mtshon na/ 'tsho ba'i brnyan ris gsal zhing dngos don ji bzhin mtshon pa rtsom rig gi ngo bor ma grub par/ go sa gtso bor bzung zhing brgyud gcig tu 'brel zhing khyab pa ni snyan ngag gi khams 'di yin/ de ltar du bshad na/ bod kyi snyan ngag gi mdzes chos de tshig mdzes par byed pa'i tshig rgyan gyi steng na yod ces bshad chog gtso bo ni gzugs rgyan dpe rgyan sogs kyis brjod par bya ba gang de ches mtshar bo'am 'ud kyis brjod par bya ba zhig yin/‘‘ljang bu'i snyan rtsom la bltas na kho'i snga ma'i dus kyi snyan rtsom la slar mtshon gyi shas che/ 〈rtswa thang gi mgyogs bris〉〈chu rtsed kyi glu〉〈nga rang sbar chog〉〈'brog pa〉〈zhogs glu〉〈dgun gyi bu mos dpyid kyi na chung sbrum〉〈g.ya' shing gi lo ma〉〈lam brtse dung〉〈rta rgyug gi nyin mo〉sogs phyi rol yul la gzhol nas ji bzhin 'bri ba lhur blangs yod/da 100 da

ri sa nga rkeb 'jug gi gol lam dang dgra bo/'di dag la mtshon na nga tsho dang kho'i snyan ngag bar la thun mong gi goms gshis yod/ phyi rol bya dngos steng nas don ldan gyi bstan don gang zhig mngon par byas pa yin/ ’’da wabadud lha rgyal gyi〈'tshol rtog snying stobs〉 yun nan mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi2004lo'i zla6pa'i par/ 2 129—130sa 2 bshus rtsom/‘‘ deng dus yongs grags kyi bshad tshul ltar na/ srol rgyun gyi ngos na mdzes dpyod lta ba rnam pa gnyis grub yod zer/ gcig ni nub gling ba'i 6slar mtshon’gyi mdzes dpyod lta ba dang / cig shos ni rgya nag gna' srol gyi ‘snyan ngag gi yid khams’ kyi mdzes dpyod lta ba'o/ /snga ma nub gling bar mtshon na/ kho tsho'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyab khongs thams cad na ches gsal ba'i 'tsho ba'i brnyan ris kyis khyab ste yod la/snyan ngag kyang de dang de mtshungs yin par 'dod/ phyi ma rgya'i gna' srol snyan ngag la mtshon na/ 'tsho ba'i brnyan ris gsal zhing dngos don ji bzhin mtshon pa rtsom rig gi ngo bor ma grub par/ go sa gtso bor bzung zhing brgyud gcig tu 'brel zhing khyab pa ni snyan ngag gi khams 'di yin/ bod kyi snyan ngag gi mdzes chos de tshig mdzes par byed pa'i tshig rgyan la 'bad pa'i srol yod/ gtso bo ni gzugs rgyan dpe rgyan sogs kyis brjod par bya ba gang de ches mtshar bo'am 'ud kyis brjod — 101 —

rngapa/thas zu / ::/par bya ba zhig tu snang /‘‘nga tshos ljang bu'i snyan rtsom la bltas tshe/ kho'i snga ma'i dus kyi snyan rtsom la slar mtshon gyi shas che/ 〈rtswa thang gi mgyogs bris〉dang / 〈chu rtsed kyi glu〉〈nga rang sbar chog〉〈〈zhogs glu〉〈dgun gyi bu mos dpyid kyi na chung sbrum〉〉〈g.ya' shing gi lo ma〉〉〈lam gyi brtse dung〉〉〈rta rgyug gi nyi ma〉sogs phyi rol yul la gzhol nas ji bzhin 'bri bar lhur blangs yod/ 'di dag la mtshon na nga tsho dang kho'i snyan ngag bar la thun mong gi goms gshis yod/ phyi rol bya dngos steng nas don ldan gyi bstan don gang zhig mngon par bya ba yin/ ’’da warnam sras kyi〈snyan ngag gsar pa la dpyad pa blo gsar dgyes pa'i dga' ston〉mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi2006lo'i zla9pa'i par/ 2 112da 1132 1 ma sgyu1ma/‘‘ de lta bu'i mun nag gi spyi tshogs shig ther 'don byed pa la/mang mang zhig gis thad kar du spyi tshogs kyi phyi tshul gyi gnas bab re ston pa dang lhan du rang sems kyi khong khro de'ang kha g.yang tsam du sgrog par dga' ba bcas kyis brjod bya 'di rigs ston pa'i snyan rtsom mang shos shig rang dbang med par spyi 'gros 'ba' zhig gi 'dam du mi bying rang bying du gyur phyir/ skabs de'i brjod bya'am spyi bam pa tsam dang tshul 'chos kyi nyams snang 'byung sla ba yin/ snyan rtsom 'dis skyon 'di dag ge 102 —

ri sa nga ba 'jug gol lam dang dgra bo/sel slad/ rtsom mkhan rang gi tshor 'du de phyi yul gyi 'phel 'gyur dang snang tshul sogs 'o chu bzhin du sbyar pas lhad med kyi myong snang ster bar ma zad/ shugs kyi rtsom mkhan rang gi sems byung ci rigs kyang gtan chags kyi dngos po'am yang na yul dus bar thag las bcal ba ring thung dang / grangs ka'i mang nyung ci rigs kyis tshad 'jal mi dgos par klog mkhan rang rang gi myong rol du ngal med lhun grub tu rdzogs par byas 'dug ’’da watshe grub kyi〈so lta dang gzab nyan〉 mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi2005lo'i zla6pa'i par/ 2 862 2 bshus rtsom/‘‘ de lta bu'i mun nag gi spyi tshogs shig ther 'don byed pa la/mang mang zhig gis thad kar du spyi tshogs kyi phyi tshul gyi gnas bab re ston pa dang lhan du rang sems kyi khong khro de'ang kha g.yang tsam du sgrog par dga' ba bcas kyis brjod bya 'di rigs ston pa'i snyan rtsom mang shos shig rang dbang med par spyi 'gros 'ba' zhig gi 'dam du mi bying rang bying du gyur phyir/ skabs de'i brjod bya'ang spyi spam pa tsam dang tshul 'chos kyi nyams snang 'byung sla ba yin/ snyan rtsom 'dis skyon de dag sel slad/ rtsom mkhan rang gi tshor 'du de phyi yul gyi 'phel 'gyur dang snang tshul sogs 'o chu bzhin du sbyar pas lhad med kyi myong snang ster bar — 103 —

2pa/spras/::/ :sbyo/ma zad/ shugs kyi rtsom mkhan rang gi sems byung ci rigs kyang gtan chags kyi dngos po'am yang na yul dus bar thag las bcal ba ring thung dang / grangs ka'i mang nyung ci rigs kyis tshad 'jal mi dgos par klog mkhan rang rang gi myong tshor du ngal med lhun grub tu rdzogs par byas 'dug ’’da warnam sras kyi〈snyan ngag gsar pa la dpyad pa blo gsar dgyes pa'i dga' ston〉mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi2006lo'i zla9pa'i par/ 2 136—137bu 1 ma rtsom/‘‘ snyan ngag gi deb tu mi rigs shig gis dpa' ngar zhum pa med par 'tsho gnas byed pa'i slad du 'thab rtsod don du gnyer ba'i lo rgyus de sgyu rtsal kun dril gyi byed las ldan pa'i sgo nas mtshon pa'i snyan ngag mang po zhig bkod yod de/ dper na〈nyi ma dang nyi ma'i lug khyu〉lta bu yin la/ rtsom de'i sgrig tshul ni ngo mtshar zhing 'brel chags pa/'char sgo myur zhing phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin pas/ de bklags na klog mkhan la dga' sdug chags sdang gi snang ba zhig 'gog med du ster ba red/ rtswa thang gi 'brog pa'i lo rgyus ni dka' spyad sdug rus byas pa'i lo rgyus shig ste/‘kha ba leb mo gcig thog gnyis(nyis)rtseg gis/nor 'dzin stobs shugs che yang ljid kyis mnan/da 104 da

rigs nga ba 'ju gol lam dang dgra bo/rtswa thang gi sbra nag tshogs ni/shog dkar ngos kyi nag thig 'dra/nyi ma re re nyi mar 'tshub cha langs/nyi ma'i lhas rar nyin rer bam ro 'phel’zhes pa lta bu zhig yin/char rlung drag 'tshub dang kha ba bu yug gi mtshon cha ga sa kun tu bsgrengs shing mdun lam ni nges pa don gyi dka' nyen 'phro 'du 'tshub pa'i gnas su yod mod/ 'on kyang 'brog pa rnams kyis rang dbang dang bde skyid don du gnyer bar brtson pa ni/‘skya rengs dang mnyam du nyi mas lug khyu ded/dbyar dgun ston dpyid/dus bzhi brje res/yod tshad lug khyu dang mnyam du rlung la bskur’zhes bris pa lta bu yin/ 'brog pa zhig yin na kho tsho'i bde sdug ni phyugs rigs dkar nag rnams 'phel du 'jug pa'i slad du kho tsho'i lus kyi lang tsho/ rnam dpyod dang blo gros/ stobs shugs dang brtse dung sogs phangs med du 'bul ba'i las la rtse gcig yid kyis gzhol bzhin yod pas/ ’’da wa reb gong rdo rje mkhar gyi〈snyan deb〈kha ba dkar po〉bklags pa〉〈nags klong khu byug 'du gnas〉zhes par bsdus yod/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi2006lo'i zla6pa'i par/ 2 149

rngabathagazub dran 2dobu 2 bshus rtsom/‘‘ snyan deb der mi rigs shig gis dpa' ngar zhum pa med par 'tsho gnas byed pa'i slad du 'thab rtsod don du gnyer ba'i lo rgyus de sgyu rtsal kun dril gyi byed las ldan pa'i sgo nas mtshon pa'i snyan ngag mang po zhig bkod yod de/ dper na〈nyi ma dang nyi ma'i lug khyu〉〉lta bu yin la/ rtsom de'i sgrig tshul ni ngo mtshar yang lugs dang mthun pa/'char sgo myur zhing phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin pas/ klog mkhan la skyo sdug gi tshor ba zhig 'gog med sbyin par byed/ rtswa thang gi 'brog pa'i lo rgyus ni dka' spyad sdug rus byas pa'i lo rgyus shig ste/‘kha ba leb mo gcig thog nyis rtseg gis/nor 'dzin stobs shugs che yang ljid kyis mnan/rtswa thang gi sbra nag tshogs ni/shog dkar ngos kyi na thig 'dra/nyi ma re re bzhin nyi mar 'tshub cha langs/nyi ma'i lhas rar nyin rer bam ro 'phel’ zhes pa lta bu zhig yin/char rlung drag 'tshub dang kha ba bu yug gi mtshon cha ga sa kun tu bsgrengs shing mdun lam ni nges pa don gyi dka' nyen 'phro 'du 'tshub pa'i gnas su yod mod/ 'on kyang 'brog pa rnams kyis rang dbang dang bde skyid don du gnyer bar brtson pa ni/— 106 —

ri sa nga ba 'ju gol lam dang dgra bo/‘skya rengs dang mnyam du nyi mas lug khyu ded/dbyar dgun ston dpyid/dus bzhi brje res/yod tshad lug khyu dang mnyam du rlung la bskur’ zhes pa dang /'brog pa zhig yin na kho tsho'i bde sdug ni phyugs rigs dkar nag gi 'phel rgud la brten nas 'byung bzhin yod cing / phyugs rigs dkar nag rnams 'phel du 'jug pa'i slad du kho tsho'i lus kyi lang tsho/rnam dpyod dang blo gros/ stobs shugs dang brtse dung / tha na rang gi tshe srog kyang phangs med du 'bul ba'i las la brtse gcig yid kyis gzhol bzhin yod pas ’’da wa rnam sras kyi〈snyan ngag gsar pa la dpyad pa blo gsar dgyes pa'i dga' ston〉mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi2006lo'i zla9pa'i par/ 2 177—178gong du tshig tshogs la ma 'dzems par ma rtsom dang bshus rtsom gnyis ka go bsdur gyis 'dren don ni kun gyis dogs pa sel ba'i ched du yin la/ rang re'i bod kyi kha dper‘‘thos pa brgya las mthong ba gcig bzang’’zhes pa ltar/ da ni zhib 'jug pa rul sungs shig gi ngo gdong gsal bor mthong bas na klog mkhan rnams kyis sems la ci zhig dran yong / kho bos ni dngos gnas bzod sgom byed thabs bral lo/ /〈blo gsar dgyes pa'i dga' ston〉zhes par spyi khyab nas bltas na/— 107 —

rngapa//sa rtu / rngorngo/gtso bo〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉steng bkod pa'i rtsom pa po'i ched bsgrigs le tshan dang / tshe grub kyi〈so lta dang gzab nyan〉 bdud lha rgyal gyi〈'tshol rtog snying stobs〉 pad ma 'bum gyi〈mi rabs gsar pa'i snying khams kyi 'phar lding〉 da dung〈gangs rgyan me tog〉dang〈sbrang char〉sogs tshags par dang dus deb kyi steng nas bshus pa yin 'dug la/ kun gyis bsdur bde ba'i ched du gong du dper bkod pa'i ma rtsom dang bshus rtsom du yig nor 'ga' re yod pa dang sgrig gzhi sogs kyang ma nor bar ji bzhin du sor bzhag byas yod/ deb de'i byed pos gzhan rtsom bshu dus‘‘khyad chos’’shig yod pa ni ma rtsom de 'phrul chas shig yin pa'i dbang du btang na lhu lag rnams so so gtor te mgo rnga bar gsum nyog par byas yod la/ mtshams mtshams su ma rtsom du‘‘nyams snang ster’’zhes bkod yod na/ bshus rtsom du‘‘myong snang ster’’zhes bca' ba'am/ yang na‘‘'char sgo myur zhing phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin pas/ de bklags na klog mkhan la dga' sdug chags sdang gi snang ba zhig 'gog med du ster ba red’’ces pa lta bu ni/ ‘‘'char sgo myur zhing phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin pas/ klog mkhan la skyo sdug gi tshor ba zhig 'gog med sbyin par byed’’ces tshig ngos nas cung zad tsam bcos yod na'ang nang don ji bzhin du bkod yod pa red/ gal te de dag ni lung drangs pa yin zer na/ 'dren rtags med pa dang gsal — 108 —

rigs nga ba 'ju gi la lam dang dgra bo/bshad kyang ci yang byas med par ma zad/ gzhan gyi tshig rang 'dod du bzo bcos byas 'dug pa las kyang gsal bor shes thub/ 'dren rtags bkod pa dag kyang gzhan gyi rtsom las tshan po ring bo zhig drangs yod na'ang khos tshig thung ngu tsam la 'dren rtags bkod pa ma gtogs yongs la 'dren rtags bkod mi 'dugaspyir na gzhan gyi rtsom la dpyad pa gtong na rtsom gang de zhib par bklags nas go ba bskon rgyu ni sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin mod/ gzhung 'di'i sa bcad drug pa'i〈snyan 'jebs ngag gi 'gyur khugs rdzogs pa'i dus rabs kyi glu ba lha rgyal tshe ring〉zhes par/ ‘‘lha rgyal tshe ring gi〈skya rengs lha mo'i 'bod brda〉zhes pa'i snyan rtsom de mig sngar bar du phran gyis klog ma btub pa ni shin tu phangs de snga〈sbrang char〉sogs kyi steng du spel pa'i snyan rtsom skor zhig lag tu 'byor ba las gzhan/dpyad gtam pa bdud lha rgyal sogs kyis〈〈skya rengs lha mo'i 'bod brda〉la gnang ba'i dpyad gtam rtsom yig kyang mig gi dga' ston du shar bsasnyan deb de la sgro 'dogs dang bshad pa cung zad spel pa'i spobs pa ngang ngam shugs kyis skyes’’zhes brjod 'dug 'di ni ci 'dra'i dgod bro ba zhig red ang / gzhan gyi snyan deb la ma bltas par‘‘sgro 'dogs dang bshad pa’’spel pa ni mun nag nang lag snyob byed pa ma yin nam/ gzhung 'di'i byed pos gtam ni de ltar ngag nas shor na'ang — 109 —

jibaspras/:sta/ cadoganas lugs ni khos kyang shes yod de/ ‘‘sgro 'dogs dang bshad pa’’lhag ma cang ma spel par sngar bzhin bdud lha rgyal gyi dpyad pa〈mnyes gshin 'char yan gyi snyan ngag〉sogs las tshan pa tshan pa byas nas bshus 'dug go/da dung gzhung 'dir lung khungs mchan du btab yod pa dag kyang thod mi thug pa dang mi gsal ba sogs gnad don shin tu mang drags pas/ re re bzhin bris te skyon rnams dmar rjen du gdon dgos tshe/ma mtha' yang mthug tshad la〈blo gsar dgyes pa'i dga' ston〉zhes pa'i deb 'di 'dra zhig cis kyang 'bri dgos 'dug pas/ kho bos ngal ba de phrag tu len pa'i dgos pa med par 'dod la/ dus tshod mang po zhig kyang 'phro brlag tu 'gro bar dogs pa sogs rgyu rkyen gang mang la gzhigs nas re zhig btang snyoms su bskyur pa lags/gong gi 'di ni sku zhabs rnam sras lags la springs pa'i mngon bsgrags yi ge(yitsha༈zlo)zhig gam/ yang na shes yon la dungs pa'i na gzhon zhig gis rigs gzhung rul sungs la bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur yin/gnas tshul 'di las nga tshos mthong thub pa ni/ grags skam gnyer 'dod kyi‘‘dge rgan chen mo’’dang‘‘shes yon can’’rnams kyis rang rang gi las thob dang khe phan kho nar dmigs nas spyi tshogs dang klog pa por 'gan mi khur zhing / rgyu 'bras blo mig skyag lud bzhin 'dor ba/— 110 —

ri sa nga ba 'ju la lam dang dgra bo/rang mgo rang gis g.yogs pa sogs kyi skyug bro ba'i snang tshul dag red/‘‘dbor skyel gla ba'i dpyad brjod’’('di'i skor2006lo'i〈sbrang char〉deb gsum pa'i steng kha byang la〈da lta'i dpyad brjod pa ngan pa rul sungs su gyur pa'i rtags brgyad〉ces par zhib mor bkod 'dug)'di lta bur 'phrad dus bdag gi sems la dran pa ni/ nga tsho'i rigs gzhung zhib 'jug thad 'bras bu chen po 'di zhes ston rin yod pa zhig da dung smin mi 'dug la/ smin yang ga la srid ces pa'o/ /de'i phyir nga tsho su yin kyang phan tshun la lta skul byed pa'i 'gan khur bdog la de ltar na da gzod kyong kha 'bur gso thub cing yar rgyas gong 'phel yong ba'i re ba yod pa red/ de las ldog tshe snang tshul 'di rigs ngan pa rgyun 'byams su song nas rang gzhan kun la phan mi thogs par ma zad rigs gzhung zhib 'jug gi kha phyogs gol lam du khrid srid pas/ kho bos 'di'i rigs la rigs gzhung zhib 'jug gi dgra bo zhes brjod pa yin no/ /rtsom 'di bris nas mtshams 'dir bslebs dus nyin mo zhig phar 'das shing nyin mo gsar pa zhig gi skya rengs shar ri'i rgyab nas yar 'phags la nye bas/ kho bo'i lus sems nyis cha nas ngal zhing dub pa'i tshor ba zhig kyang skyes yong / ma rtsom dang bshus rtsom gnyis zhib bsdur byed par mkho ba'i deb dang tshags par sogs mdun cog tu spangs shing zed zed long long du gyur 'dug pa'i rnam par gcig bltas rjes/— 111 —

9pa lhas/zum/ :sdo/rang nyid kyi ngal rtsol 'di ngal rtsol lhag ma zhig e yin gyi bsam tshul skyes pa dang / dus mtshungs su 'dis gzhan la phog thug 'dra bzo ba las don dam gyi byed nus 'dra e thon skor la bsam blo gtong dgos byung / rgya'i kha dper yang‘‘khyi yis skyag pa za ba'i goms srol bsgyur mi thub’’zer ba min nam/ gang ltar/ tshegs lji ba'i las ka 'di re zhig rdzogs khul byas pa yin la/ nyin mo gsar pa 'dis nga tsho'i rigs gzhung zhib 'jug dang phyogs gang ci'i thad la mdun ljongs gsar pa zhig bsus yong ba'i smon 'dun snying nas zhu/khri sems dpa' nas/2007lo'i zla5pa'i tshes13nyin/

gros 'debs yang 'debs/gros 'debs yang 'debs/sku zhabs a sngags tshe ring bkra shis lags kyis brtsams pa'i〈dge 'dun chos 'phel〉(si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 2005lo'i zla12pa'i par)zhes par〈mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi rig gnas 'dzugs skrun thad kyi bsam blo rags brjod blang dor gsal ba'i me long〉zhes pa'i dpyad rtsom zhig bsdus yod 'dug la/dpyad rtsom de bklags rjes kho bos yun ring sems la brnags pa'i bsam tshul gang zhig brjod 'dod kyi 'dun pa zhig drag tu bslangs yong /dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog ni rang re'i nye rabs lo rgyus steng byung ba'i snyan ngag smra pa dang bsam blo smra pa/ mtshan nyid smra pa/ lo rgyus smra pa sogs rig pa'i gnas mang por byang ba'i mkhas pa chen po zhig yin pa'i cha nas/ nga tshor khong lta bu'i skyes bu chen po byung ba ni rang re'i kun gyi gces nor du mthong nas khong gi mdzad rjes la rjes su yi rang 'bul ba dang / de dar spel dang rgyud 'dzin byed pa ni 'u bu cag gi las skal yin no/ /de'i thad nas a sngags tshe ring bkra shis kyis deb 'di lta bu zhig brtsams nas gtor ma lha 'dang dang mi mi 'dang du bzhag par kho bos lhag bsam dag pa'i sgo nas gong bkur gyi bsam — 113 —

rngabathas/can/ :sbyo/'dun bstan pa yin/ yin na'ang dpyad rtsom 'dir bkod pa'i lta tshul re gnyis la kho bo cung mi 'thad pa'ang yod de/ gsham nas nga rang gi lta tshul re gnyis yig phreng du bstar nas gros 'debs su dbul rgyu yin/gcig rtsom pa pos‘‘lar rig gnas gsar snon las gsar 'dzugs zhes brjod pa ni bod rang la mtshon na dgos pa med de/ 'od stong 'bar ba'i srol rgyun yod pa la rbad de bskyur nas gsar pa zhig 'dzugs dgos she na dgongs gzhi dgos pa gzhan med na 'du shes sor na mi gnas pa'i rang mtshang du zad do’’zhes nga tsho bod la rig gnas gsar 'dzugs byed pa'i dgos pa med ces brjod 'dug la/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni rang rer 'od stong 'bar ba'i srol rgyun yod ces gting snon byas yod/kho bos bltas na/ nga tshor‘‘rig gnas gsar 'dzugs’’(yang na rig gnas 'dzugs skrun)byed pa'i dgos pa chen po yod la/ de ni rang mtshang min par nga tsho nges par du kha gtad dgos shing cis kyang g.yol thabs bral ba'i gleng gzhi zhig kyang yin par bsams/ rgyu mtshan gang lags she na/ nga tshos brjod kyin pa'i‘‘'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas’’zhes pa yang gtso bo ni lha chos rig gnas la go ba yin pas/ nga tshor mi chos rig gnas mkho zhing / mi kha gso spyad dang‘‘mi bu’’slong — 114 —

gros 'debs yang 'debs/byed kyi rig gnas lhag tu mkho bas/ nga tsho'i mi tshe lta tshul dang rin thang lta tshul/ mdzes dpyod lta tshul/ mdor dril na bag chags rnying rul gyi rigs la gsar du dogs slong byas nas‘‘gsar 'dzugs’’byed par rigs/ rtsom mkhan nas kyang deb kyi mjug tu‘‘nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di la yod pa ni gang zhig yin pa dang med pa gang dag yin/ nga tshor dgos rgyu ni gang dang med dgos rgyu ni gang sogs blo la nges shes shig kha min don du skyed dgos gda'’’zhes‘‘yod pa’’yod la‘‘med pa'ang’’yod par khas 'ches na/ nga tshor yod pa las med pa mang zhing / mkho ba las mi mkho ba mang bas‘‘rig gnas gsar 'dzugs’’gang der kha snon tsam gyis gtan nas mi chog par 'dod do/ /de yang rgya nag gi‘‘lnga bzhi las 'gul’’lta bur dpe re blangs na'ang / gtso bo rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam/ khe dbang / mang gtso sogs kyi bsam blo'ang 'du shes gsar pa‘‘gsar 'dzugs’’byas pa yin te/ kho tsho'i srol rgyun gyi rig gnas khrod du 'du shes de'i rigs yod pa ma red/ de min nub gling gi‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’dang‘‘blo 'byed las 'gul’’sogs la mtshon na yang‘‘mi yi rig gnas’’gsar 'dzugs byas nas yong ba zhig yin 'dug des na/ rang re'i rnams kyis‘‘'od stong 'bar ba'i srol rgyun yod’’ces‘‘rig gnas gsar 'dzugs’’byed pa de rang mtshang du brtsi ba yin na kho bos nor 'khrul zhig da 115 da

2pa//sa/can/ :sdo/tu sems/ nga tshor mtshon na‘‘rig gnas gsar 'dzugs’’kyi dgos pa bla lhag gis che ste/ 'dzam gling gong bu can du 'gyur mus kyi dus da lta nga tshor 'di yod dang gan yod ces sgrog pa de gtso bo ma yin par/med pa de 'tshol ba dang yod pa de blang dor yod pa'i sgo nas dar spel dang rgyud 'dzin byed dgos/ de la thog mar 'du shes‘‘gsar 'dzugs’’byung na da gzod spyi tshogs gong 'phel dang rig gnas 'thus tshang can du 'phel bar nus pa thon pa yin/ don rtsa sgril na/ mi nyid rnyed pa dang / bsam blo bcings 'grol byed pa/ mang gtso dang tshan rig sogs deng rabs rig gnas‘‘gsar 'dzugs’’byed dgos so/ /‘‘rig gnas gsar 'dzugs’’kyi ma lag chags pa dang mi bu sngar bas mang po las 'dir 'jug pa de mthar gtugs na‘‘mi yi rig gnas’’chags thub min dang / mi bu sad rtogs 'byung thub min/ mi bu 'greng tshugs su 'tsho thub min bcas la thad kar rag las pas/ kho bos 'di ni gtso bo'i nang gi gtso bor mthong ngo / /gnyis/ rtsom pa pos sku zhabs zhogs dung gis brtsams pa'i〈〈bag chags dong sprugs〉dang〈rmongs skran 'joms pa'i gtar kha〉(〈'phag tshag gi nga ro〉)gnyis la bltas rjes lta tshul zhig gleng yod de/‘‘khong gis 'bad pa brgya yis 'tshol ba'i rgyu mtshan dang rgyu mtshan de las byung ba'i ngos 'dzin ni byis chung klad med kyi gtam du zad’’ces dang /— 116 —

gros 'debs yang 'debs/‘‘khyed kyis rig gnas gsar skrun gyi khungs lung ni nyes kun phung bo ste bcings 'grol byas phyin rgyal nang du byung ba'i ‘ngo rgol bzhi'i las 'gul’dang ‘rig gnas gsar brje chen mo’ la bcol ba ma yin nam/thams cad gtor brlag byas rjes shul du ci zhig 'jog thun min rang gi rig gnas mi dgos pa'i mi rigs spyir btang ba zhig byed 'dod pa yin nam’’ ‘‘lta tshul de rigs spyir mkhas brgya 'gran gleng dang me tog mnyam bzhad kyi byed phyogs ltar dgag gzhag spong gsum sgos brgal lan zhig bris chog mod/ zhib tu dpyad na lta tshul de dang de'i sgrub byed kyi rigs pa ni 'ol spyi tsam las dpyad bzod du ma grub rung 'dab brgya dgod pa'i tshal du rtswa ldum re yang yod mi chog pa min snyam zhing mthun sgril gyi gshed du 'gyur ba las gzhan du med par/ ri bong dang spyang ki gzan rtsod du 'gyur bar dogs te btang snyoms su bzhag go’’zhes mi 'thad pa'i rnam 'gyur ci yang bstan 'dugakho bos dpyad na/ sku zhabs zhogs dung gis bcoms pa'i〈bag chags dong sprugs〉dang〈rmongs skran 'joms pa'i gtar kha〉gang yin kyang / deb 'dir 'khod pa'i‘‘mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel dang khong gi rig gnas 'dzugs skrun thad kyi bsam blo mngon par mtshon pa'i tshab mtshon rang bzhin gyi brtsams chos’’de dag gi gras su brtsi chog chog gi bsam tshul bdog 'ongs/ rgyu mtshan ni zhogs dung sogs kyis — 117 —

rngubapes/:ma/ :sdo/nga tshor sngon goms kyi bsam gzhig gtong tshul bsgyur bcos dang /rnying zhen gyi bsam blo la dpyod shes kyi sgo nas yin min brtag dpyad gtong ba las rmongs tshod du mi 'jug pa'i lam gsar pa zhig btod dang gtod bzhin 'dug pas/ nga tshos gtan 'jags ngang gnas pa'i bsam blo'i mtsho mor g.yo skyom thebs te bsam gzhig gi yo lang drag tu 'khrugs pa'i bar skabs 'dir/ ‘‘gzhan gyi ngo bsrungs drags te gtam bden pa yang smra ba'i spobs pa med par’’(dge chos kyi tshig)sgam tshugs ston mdog dang / grung bor rlom mdog gis‘‘byis chung klad med kyi gtam du zad’’ces mtha' gcig tu sdom tshig 'god pa ni ci 'dra'i mi rung ba zhig red ang / lhag par du dge chos mchog la zhib 'jug gnang mkhan gyi shes yon can zhig gi ngos nas bshad na de ltar ro/ /'di nas deng rabs dang srol rgyun gyi 'gal 'brel skor nas bsam tshul phran tsam brjod na/ deng rabs can gyi bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun mtho ru 'phyur pa'i dus 'dir/ deng rabs rig gnas kyis srol rgyun gyi goms srol dang bag chags rnying rul la tsha 'dri dang dogs slong sna tshogs bgyid srid pa ni chos nyid kyis thag bcad yod pa red la/mi rigs gang yin kyang gnad 'gag gi 'dam ga 'di lta bu'i mdun du som nyi'i dra bar tshud de mgo 'thom par byed pa'ang rgyun ldan zhig yin/— 118 —

gros 'debs yang 'debs/rgyu mtshan ni kha shas kyis srol rgyun gyi spyi tshogs sgrig srol dang rig gnas ma lag rgyun bsrings nas dbul phongs dang rjes lus dang len byed pa dang / kha shas kyis sems khams dang kun spyod/ 'jig rten lta tshul bcas bcos sgyur byas te sngar yod kyi srol rgyun dang bag chags rnying rul gtor bar byed pa red/ 'dir brjod pa'i bag chags rnying rul zhes pa de yang tshong las dang tshan rig tshod ltar mthong chung byed pa dang /rmongs 'thom gyi chos lugs dad mos kyis tshan rig dang drang bden gyi tshab byed pa/ bud med rnams spyi tshogs kyi las sgo so sor zhugs par dma' 'beb byed pa/ srol rgyun gyi lta ba dang‘‘tshad ma'i skyes bus’’yo/da tshad kyi tshad 'jal ba sogs gna' bo'i rig gnas kyi cha shas su grub pa'i lta tshul de dag gis nga tsho deng rabs can du skyod par gegs rkyen zab mo thebs pas/ deng rabs kyi spyi tshogs sgrig srol dang 'gal ba gang yin rung bstod pa'i dbyings su spur don med la/ bag chags rnying rul de dag‘‘shor’’bar phangs sems skyes don yang ci la yod/ de dag ma gzhi nas‘‘'gro mi'i rnam shes dang bde skyid kyi btson khang’’du nges pa red/ des na yin pa ni‘‘srol rgyun’’zer ba'i seng ras shig g.yogs yod pas lan pa dang / des nga tshos yid sems bslus drags

/pa//sa/can/ :sdo/pas red/du 'gro mi'i lo rgyus la bltas tshe shes thub pa ni/ srol rgyun dar spel dang rgyun 'dzin byed kyang / de las kyang gal che ba ni gsar gtod dang bcos sgyur rab dang rim par brten nas 'gro mi'i dpal yon de snga na med pa'i mtho tshad cig tu bskyal ba de red la/ rmongs pa'i sgo nas srol rgyun la dang rten dang dad mos byed pa dang / yang na ngan pa goms lobs su song ba'i cha gang de bcom brlag dang rtsa med du btang nas yong ba zhig yin 'dugade bas/ ‘‘gna' bo'i srol rgyun yod dgu gong du bkur zhing /su zhig gis yab mes kyi blo gros la yin dgag byed na/ tshul dang ldan pa rnams kyis ma rangs ngan dmod byed par 'gyur’’(h+phan lung gi tshig)ba'i nga tsho'i‘‘shes rmongs grog rong’’du lus pa'i‘‘mi 'di rnams sngar bzhin sos dal bag yangs kyis nye bar 'tsho’’zhing / su zhig‘‘shes yon rgan po’’tsho'i thugs dgongs dang 'gal na tshe srog gi rgyu ba yang dgag par byed pa red/ 'di ni ches che ba'i skyo gar zhig tu mngon par mthong ste/ de dpyod shes rgan po so khi ra thedhisogs rtogs sad pa gang mang dang / rang re'i dge chos dang don grub rgyal sogs skyes bu dam r+shaspyu zlodhī/ khasna/ljaphroṃ /ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃd+dhisdi rākhrit+t+waṃ da k+ṣiṃrme //snyish+lau dhidz+nyo sne snyu kauṭ+wāṃ zhi sni ṭ+wāṃtram̐ sgyigami py-isdu kā&s+dza pro zlo dase ñtsha'u matsār+sha hā t+na — 120 —

gros 'debs yang 'debs/pa dag gi steng nas kyang gsal bor rtogs thub bo/ /de la bod rang gi shes yon can kha cig gis kyang‘‘bod kyi nang du phyogs gang thad nas sngon du thon pa zhig yod na/ tshang mas de'i spyod bzang dang grub 'bras khas len zhing / rang gis kyang 'bad brtson lhod med byas pa la brten nas gzhan las rgyal bar mi byed par/ de la kha ming sna ming btags nas zur za byed mkhan ha cang mang / bod la phan thogs che ba'i mi bsam blo can dang rnam dpyod can zhig yod na/ de la yi rang dang rgyab skyor byas te/ de'i bsam blo je rgyas dang / de'i lta ba je zab tu gtong e thub la lta mkhan med par/ phrag dog gi me dpung sbar nas 'gal rkyen bzo mkhan mang’’nizhes brjod yod pa ni dngos gnas brtag pa'i gtam drang gzhag cig red 'dod do/ /mjug tu‘‘'dab brgya dgod pa'i tshal du rtswa ldum’’skyes yod pa 'di dag gis nam zhig sngar med kyi 'bras bu zhim po zhig nga tsho'i gsos su smin par byed kyang srid pas/ nga tsho su yin kyang phan tshun dkyel yangs dang brtsi bkur gyi rnam 'gyur bzung nas gzhogs 'degs mi byed kyang /da lta nyid du 'bur 'jom mi byed par/ ‘‘spyang ki sha gzan ri bong rtswa gzan gnyis/ /zas kyi don du gros kha bsdur ba las/ /re zhig rang dhi khro bo rgyal mtshan gyi〈'gran rtsod kyi lta ba dang mi gshis〉2006lo'i sbrang char〉deb dang por gsal/— 121 —
rigs mthun pa'i 'khor nang du/ /rang rang so so'i spyod pa bskyangs na legs/ /’’zhes gros 'debs su phul ba lags na nongs pa ci mchis dgongs dogs mdzod rogs zhes kyang zhu'o/ /

bskozan kun rngad pa casdobasdo ces skyon gsar 'god pa zhig gi ngos len yi gegasar 'gyur ni gsar du byung ba'i don dngos la zer zhing / de ni deng rabs lo rgyus kyi zin bris ngo ma yin/ der brten/ kha gsal go bde'i ngang bshad na/ gsar 'gyur ni nges par du bden pa yin dgos/ rdzun bzo byas pa'i gsar 'gyur la rin thang ci yang med pa ma zad spyi tshogs thad la gnod pa chen po thebs srid do/ /da wa〈gsar 'gyur rtsom 'bri'i rnam bshad〉ces pa las drangs/kho bo tshags par khang gi las byed mi sna zhig yin pa'i cha nas gsar 'god kyi bya bar dngos su zhugs myong la/ gsar 'gyur rtsom yig mi nyung ba zhig tshags par steng bkod myong bas las 'dir cha rgyus nges can zhig yod ces bshad kyang mi chog pa med do/ /de bas/ gsham nas rang gi brgyud rim dang sbrel te gnas tshul phran tsam zhus na/2003lo'i lo mjug tu gzhung don zhig gi ched du lan grur lan gcig 'gro dgos byung / stabs legs pa zhig la reb der lan gru nas nub byang mi rigs slob chen gyi‘‘rang mos gleng stegs’’steng phyin nas de ga'i dge slob tsho'i gtam la nyan pa'i go skabs shig kyang thob/ tshogs thog tu 'gro rogs nas nga rang tshos sgrub bzhin pa'i tshags par skor ngo

rngarnga/ཿsa/zu / :sdo/sprod mdor tsam byas pas/ kho rang tshos rang rang gi bsam 'char yang 'ga' re brjod byung / da lta de dag re re bzhin yi ger 'god dgos tshe brjed ngas rkun pos snga mo nas brkus zin pas yid na gsal bor med mod/ 'on kyang / pha yul mtsho lho'i phyogs nas yin pa'i slob grogs shig gis‘‘khyed tshos rdzun bshad kyin 'dug’’zer ba'i gtam de da lta da dung kho bo'i rna lam du meched kyin 'dug slob grogs de ltar na nga tsho'i tshags par steng kho tsho'i sde ba'i gnas tshul zhig bkod yod la/gnas tshul der kho tsho'i sde ba'i dud khyim re'i lo re'i yong sgo cha snyoms byas na ga tshod ga tshod yod pa dang / sde mi cig cig nyig nyig tshang gi cha rkyen ga 'dra zhig la bslebs yod pa sogs don dngos dang mi mthun pa'i gnas tshul ha cang mang po yod pa red zer/ phyir las gnas su 'byor rjes sngar gyi tshags par skor zhig bslogs pa na/ gnas tshul de ni kho bo mtsho skor sa khul du bcar 'drir skyod skabs bris pa'i rgyas 'phrin thung ngu zhig yin pas/ skyon la ngos len zhus tshe rdzun gtam mkhan ni nga rang las 'chor sa med cing / nag nyes de nga rang gis 'khur pa las 'os med do/ /gong gi rgyas 'phrin thung ngu skor la kho bos gsal bshad cig byed pa'i dgos pa'ang yod de/ de snga mtsho skor sa khul gyi chab cha dang mda' bzhi/ rkang tsha sogs su skyod dus‘‘gshis 'jam gzhung drang gi — 124 —

sar 'god pa ngos len yi 'brog pa’’rnams kyis gtam 'di 'dra zhig bshad myong / ‘‘khyed tsho ni zhing chen rim pa nas yong ba'i las byed pa red mod/ khyed tshoratsho lo (bya dga'i dpang yig)zhig ster ba'i dbang cha los yod/ nged tshang ni sde ba 'di'i nang cha rkyen dang phyogs gang ci'i thad nas legs gras yin’’zhes rang tshang gi lo re'i yong sgo 'di mo dang gan mo yin pa bshad 'ongs la/ de'i zhor du ma 'ongs 'char gzhi yang 'od stong 'bar ba zhig lab yong / de min bcar 'dri byed skabs sa gnas de'i shang srid gzhung dang sde dmangs u yon lhan tshogs kyi bkod sgrig ltar bcar 'dri byed pa las rang rang gi 'dod mos ltar su tshang la 'gro 'dod na de tshang la 'gro ba min pas/ nga tsho'i gsar 'god pa dag gi smyu gu de‘‘dbul khyim’’dag dang las 'phro med par gyur/ des na/ rgyas 'phrin der 'khod pa'i lo re'i yong sgo sogs ni khong rnam pas bshad pa ji bzhin bris pa yin tsang / rdzun bshad mkhan ni gsar 'god pa nga the ba'i 'brog pa de dag dang / las byed mi sna de rnams kyang ngo / /'di las ci zhig shes thub zer na/ nga tsho'i nang mi spun zla rnams ni ci 'dra'i tshul 'chos dang gsog gsob cig yin ang / kho tshor dgos pa ni‘‘kun la ngom rung ba'i bya dga'i dpang rtags’’(kho tshos bya dga'i dpang yig gzhan la ngom spyad cig tu rtsi bzhin yod)de dang / kho tshor dgos pa ni ming don mi mthun pa'i gzi brjid(kho tshos bya dga'i dpang yig rang khyim gyi tsig — 125 —

rngarnga thas/zu / :sbyo/ngos su 'gel rgyu byung na gzi brjid cig tu rlom bzhin 'dug)de yin/ de'i ched du kho tshos rdzun bshad don ni/ ru kha khyim mtshes bar la khog dbang rtsod ched yin pa dang / rang nyid phyug po dang 'jon thang can yin pa ra sprod pa'i ched du yin/ rang nyid kyis nga'o dang bcas mu mthud du rdzun bshad par ma rtsa 'tshol ba'ang yin no/ /de min rgyas 'phrin de dag 'bri ba'i go rim khrod nga rang gis‘‘dgos mkho’’ltar las snon mi nyung ba zhig byas yod pa'ang don dngos yin pas/ gnas tshul de dag ni bcar 'dri byed mkhan nga dang bya yul sogs kyis thun mong du 'khrab pa'i skyug bro ba'i zlos gar zhig dang / lo rgyus kyi deb ther dkar po'i ngos su phab pa'i nag thig re re yin/ 'di ltar bsam blo btang tshe/ rang gi nyes skyon gyi gal chen rang bzhin ngang gis rtogs 'ongs shing / phyin chad rdzun bshad mi nyan pa'i gnas lugs dang nges shes kyang rgyud la 'drongs srid/ yang gcig bshad na/ gsar 'gyur rtsom yig gi ma mtha'i cha rkyen ni bden pa yin dgos tsang / nga rang gis shes bzhin du ma mtha'i cha rkyen de tsam yang brtsi srung byed ma thub par ched du 'gyod bshags byas pa yin/ gzhan yang nga dang 'dra ba'i gsar 'god pa gang mang zhig gis da dung mu mthud du rdzun bshad kyin par bsams na‘‘ma mtha'i cha rkyen’’de brtsi srung byed rgyu ni ha cang dka' mo zhig yin pa rtogs shing yid sems skyo bar 'gyur ro/ /— 126 —

bskozad /ra rngad nga 21bsko :sgo skyob 'di ni ngas rang nyid la thar lam btsal ba gtan nas min par don dngos bshad na 'di 'dra red/skad cha drang mor bshad dgos pa'i thad la/ rgya nag gi rgyu 'bras srung mkhan du brtsi ba'i pa cin lags kyis kyang tshe smad du spyi sdom 'di 'dra byas 'dug ste/ ‘‘mis skad cha drang mor bshad tshe da gzod tan tan tig tig sgos 'tsho bar rol thub’’ces dang / ‘‘me tog stan du btang rung rdzun gtam ni nam yang bden don du 'gyur mi srid’’ces bstan 'dug la/ khong gis da dung‘‘ngas 'dod pa'i skad cha drang mo ni drang bden la bstan pa min la/ skad cha yang dag la bstan pa'ang min par/ rang gis ji ltar dran pa de ltar brjod pa dang / rang gis ji ltar bshad 'dod na de ltar bshad pa ni skad cha drang mo yin’’rjo zhes zer/'di ltar gsungs yod par gzhigs na/ ‘‘rang gis ji ltar dran na de ltar brjod pa’’dang / ‘‘rang gis ji ltar bshad 'dod na de ltar bshad pa ’’de yang sla mo zhig gtan nas min pa shes thub la/ 'di ni bgres po shes yon can zhig gis sems khong nas brdol ba'i drang gtam yang yin srid/ de lta na'ang rgya nag gi mkhas pa kha shas kyis‘‘khong gis da lta de ltar bsams na'ang yang bskyar gnas tshul de 'drar 'phrad tshe du tram̐༅ 〈loṣ+yom+mu7r+sā 〉tshoṣā 1tsho.oṃ sosangu0oṃṣā2003lho12(glo

rngabazlas casta/ :sdo/rdzun mi gtam pa'i nges pa ga la yod’’ces pa cin la the tshom za ba'ang gnas lugs dang mi mthun pa zhig min/ rgyu mtshan ni gnad don de 'drar nga tsho dus rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod du yang rnam kun tu 'phrad kyin yod pa ma yin nam/drang gtam bshad pa ni dngos gnas dka' ang /de ring gi gsar 'gyur ni sgrub byed khungs btsun po'i sang nyin gyi lo rgyus yin tsang / nga tshos de ring rdzun bshad pa ni lo rgyus rdzun bzo byed pa dang / de ring la khag ma 'khur pa yin pas/ rdzun bshad pa las lci ba'i nag nyes shig gang du yod/med na da dung rdzun bshad don ci yin nam/rang gi gnas skabs kyi dgos mkho dang / rang gi mig mdun gyi khe phan gyi ched du pha ma yin kyang ngo log byed na rdzun bshad pa ni rgyun ldan zhig ma yin nam 'gal bar snang ba'i dri ba'i mda' mo 'di dag re re bzhin rang gi snying la gtad tshe/ sems khong du tsag shed rgyug ste tsha ber ber gyi tshor ba dang bcas da nas bzung mi bu ngo ma zhig byas te gtam drang mo zhig bshad dgos pa'i sems 'dun 'gog thabs bral/gsar 'god pa'i 'gan 'khri gang yin zhe na/ yul dngos su phyin nas mang tshogs kyi bde sdug dang 'tsho ba ngo mar rgyus lon dang brtag ge 128 —

ba tshad khun rngad pa carngobasdo ces skyon dpyad byed pa dang / spyi tshogs khrod gnas pa'i mi bzang don bzang dang grub 'bras ngo mar bstod pa byed pa dang / mi ngan bya ngan dang skyug bro'i gnas tshul la skyon brjod dang sun 'byin byed rgyu sogs ni gal che ba red/ yin na'ang mig snga'i gnas bab la gzhigs na/ nga tsho'i gsar 'god pa mang shos shig ni‘‘bstod glu rkyang rkyang len mkhan’’du gyur nas/ bzang bo las ngan pa mi mthong ba dang / yang na ngan pa bzang bor bsgyur pa'i thabs rtsal la byang cha nges can ldan 'dug pas/ da gzod mi rnams kyis‘‘khyed tshos rdzun bshad kyin 'dug’’ces kha rdung btang ba red/ da dung yang gtong srid/'di las 'phros te gnas tshul gzhan zhig yod pa ni/ de sngon grogs po gsar 'god pa zhig gis kho rang tsho mtsho sngon por bcar 'drir phyin pa dang / thengs de'i bcar 'dri byed pa'i nang don ni mtsho sngon po'i gser nya lkog 'tshong byed pa'i skor gyi gnad don yin zer/ yin na'ang kho'i 'gro rogs de dag ma gzhi nas gser nya rig na 'gram chu ldang mkhan tag tag yin pas/ nya sha rgyags chad pa zhig zos shing /phyir zi ling du log rjes bden cog cog gi tshor snang sbyin zhing gser nya'i 'jigs nyen la gdung sems 'ching khul gyis gsar 'gyur spel bar brel 'dug ces brjod/ mjug tu khos gsal bshad kyi tshul du kho'i 'gro rogs dag ni rgya rigs yin pa dang / de ni khos nya sha ma zas — 129 —

rngapa/thas/can/ :sdo/zer/snang tshul 'di'i rigs ni sa khyab rdo khyab yin la/ 'di'i ltag rgyab tu bskungs nas kha bkod 'then mkhan ni gzhan ma yin par gsar 'god pa dag red la/ las rigs kun spyod snang med du bskyur ba'i ngan pa rul sungs kyi gsar 'god pa dag red do/ /'di ltar na/ nga tsho ni lo rgyus kyi nyes can du mi 'gyur grang /〈krung go'i gsar 'gyur bya ba sgrub mkhan gyi las rigs kun spyod tshad gzhi〉zhes par gtso bo gsham gyi blang bya drug bton 'dug ste/gcig blo gcig sems gcig gis mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos pa/gnyis/ yang dag pa'i gleng phyogs rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos pa/gsum/ rtsa khrims dang bca' khrims/ sgrig lam bcas brtsi srung byed dgos pa/bzhi/ gsar 'gyur gyi bden dngos rang bzhin la srung skyong byed dgos pa/lnga/ tang srol srid gtsang gi nus pa srung 'dzin byed dgos pa/drug mthun sgril mnyam las kyi snying stobs dar spel du gtong dgos pa bcas so/ /2006lo'i zla12pa'i tshes20nyin zi ling du/

yon tan spyong byed yag sa rang gi sad yi yin/‘‘phru gu gso sprud yag shos a ma'i 'o ma yin/yon tan smyong byed yag shos rang gi skad yig yin’’da wa mtho 'bring slob ma zhig gis bod yig la bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur las 'phros pa/khyed tshos bod skad bshad par ngo tsha na/ ma bshad na chog la/ bod lwa gyon par ngo tsha na de yang ma gon na chog 'on kyang khyed tsho'i sha dang rus pa ji ltar byed rgyu/da wakun gzigs paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/dri ba/ khyed la bod yig slob pa'i 'dun pa e yod/dris lan/ med/dri ba/ rgyu mtshan ci/dris lan/ rgyu mtshan ni bod yig la brten nas sgrub thub pa'i bya ba ha cang nyung la/ bod yig gis chos 'don byed tsam las ci yang mi nyan/dri ba/ des na slob chen la rgyugs sprod dus ji ltar bya/dris lan/ rgyugs sprod dus rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus tsam dang / slob tshan gyi mjug gi sbyangs gzhi tsam shes pas chog— 131 —

rngapa/spras/zu / ::rdodri ba/ da thengs kyi slob skabs 'di'i nang bod yig gi zur lta'i dpe cha gang dag la bltas myong /dris lan/ da thengs kyi slob skabs 'di'i gnang ba byin rjes kyi nyin gcig dang phyed la slob grwas〈bka' 'gyur〉'don klog byed du bcug pa de las gzhan par bltas ma myong /dri ba/ slob ma tshor dngos gnas bod yig sbyong ba'i 'dun pa med dam/dris lan/ slob ma tshor bod yig sbyong 'dod kyi 'dun pa med ces bshad dka' mod/ gang ltar ha cang zhan/dri ba/ slob ma tshos klog 'dod pa'i dpe deb rigs gang dag yin/dris lan/ rtsom yig gi brjod bya brtse dungs las 'da' tshe klog pa'i spro ba med/dri ba/ slob ma tsho ches dga' ba'i rtsom lus gang yin/dris lan/ ches dga' ba'i rtsom lus ni rang mos snyan ngag yin/dri ba/ slob ma tsho'i khrod du slob deb phud dpe cha gzhan pa nyo mkhan e yod/dris lan/ re gnyis tsam las med/dri ba/ dge rgan tshos bod yig sbyong ba'i gal chen rang bzhin mi — 132 —

yon tan spyong byed ya sa rang da yig yin/gleng ngam/dris lan/ dge rgan tshos slob ma tshor rgyun du bod yig sbyong ba'i gal chen rang bzhin skor gleng na'ang / rang rang gi bu bu mo bod yig gi slob grwar skyel mkhan re gnyis tsam las med pa red/dri ba/ slob grwas bya 'gul sogs spel dus bod yig bkol spyod byed bzhin e yod/dris lan/ brda sbyor 'bri dus kyang bod yig gi lam nas bris pa ha cang nyung /dri ba/ khyed slob grwa'i slob ma'i khrod dus deb dang tshags par sogs kyi steng du rtsom yig bkod myong mkhan e yod/dris lan/ dus deb dang tshags par steng rtsom yig bkod yod pa'i slob ma brgya cha'i gcig tsam las med/gong gi bcar 'dri thang thang 'di ni na ning gi lags rnying lo gsar ra༅ dbye ༄shiskabs su kho bo pha yul du log dus mtho 'bring slob ma zhig la bcar 'dri byas pa de zin bris su ji bzhin bkod pa yin la/ bcar 'dri dang len byed mkhan gyi slob ma de'i ming la sangs rgyas don grub zer/ nye sngon kho bo pha yul du 'khor zhag la skyod skabs yang bskyar slob grogs de dang 'phrad cing / 'phrad nas kyang gleng mo phran tsam byas pa na bod — 133 —

rngabathas/zum/ ::/yig gi skar grangs ma longs pa'am ci yin gsal bor ma dris mod/yid phangs pa zhig la kho rang slob chen du rgyugs ma 'phrod par lus 'dug la/ kho dang 'phrad pa des bdag la gong gi bcar 'dri thung thung 'di dran du bcug cing / de 'brel gyi rang gi bsam tshul phran tsam brjod pa'i 'dun pa yang bstsal byung /slob ma tshor bod yig sbyong 'dod med zer ba de ni dngos gnas bden pa yin 'dug la/ de bzhin du khyim bdag rnams la'ang rang gi byis par bod yig sbyong du 'jug 'dod med pa red/ nye sngon pha yul du log dus rgyus lon phran tsam byas pa ltar na/ da lta nga rang gi ma yum slob chung der slob ma je nyung nas je nyung du gyur 'dug de'i rgyu mtshan ni spyir pha yul du byis pa je nyung du song ba ma yin par/ cha rkyen 'dzoms pa'i khyim tshang dag gis rdzong mkhar du khang pa glas te rang rang gi byis pa rnams‘‘slob khrid kyi spus tshad mtho ba'i’’(yul mi rnams kyis de ltar lab)rgya yig gi slob grwar bskyal bas red/ 'di las shes thub pa ni/gcig nas rgya yig gi slob grwa de dag dngos gnas‘‘slob khrid kyi spus tshad mtho ba'i’’rtags yin kyang srid mod/ mang che shos kyis bod yig sbyangs na phan pa med zer/ gang ltar khyim bdag dang slob ma gnyis kar thun mong gi lta tshul zhig yod pa ni slob grogs sangs rgyas don grub kyis bshad pa bzhin bod yig la brten nas sgrub thub pa'i bya ba ha cang — 134 —

yon tan spyong byed ya sa rang sad yi yin/nyung la/ bod yig gis chos 'don byed tsam las ci yang mi nyan zhes pa de'o/ /kun gzigs paṇa chen mchog nas‘‘slob grwa pa'i da lta'i bsam blo dang / spyod tshul/ kun spyod/ bsam 'dun bcas ni bod kyi 'byung 'gyur gyi tshab yin pas/ da lta nas bzung kho tshor gso skyong yag po byas na ma gtogs bod la re ba yod pa ma red’’ces gsungs myong la/don du yang de lta yin te/ me tog lta bu'i slob ma 'di dag gso skyong gang legs ma byas na ma 'ongs pa na g.yur du za ba'i 'bras bu smin ga la srid de/ mi srid do/ /des na ji ltar gso skyong byed dgos she na/ nga tsho bod kyi dge rgan rnam pa'i phrag tu 'os 'gan lci mo 'di babs yod pa red/ kho tsho'i kha ta slob gso dang bca' srol las srol la 'brel ba dam po yod de/ gong du slob grogs sangs rgyas don grub kyis bshad pa bzhin‘‘dge rgan tshos slob ma tshor rgyun du bod yig sbyong ba'i gal chen rang bzhin skor gleng na'ang / rang rang gi bu bu mo bod yig gi slob grwar skyel mkhan re gnyis tsam las med pa red’’ces pa ltar/ thog mar dge rgan rang gis sne khrid pa mi legs pas slob mar bshad tshe nus pa thon srid pa ma red/ de bzhin bod yig slob grwa so sos brda sbyor sogs spel dus kyang bod yig gi lam nas 'bri ba dang tshogs 'du bsdu skabs bod skad kyi lam nas bshad rgyu sogs ni gal chen nang gi 'gangs ge 135 —
