rngapa thas/:mi/ :sdo/chen zhig tu 'khums pas snang chung khur med gtan nas byed mi rung ngo / /kho bos go tshul la pe cin du sdod pa'i bod kyi shes yon can che ge mos rang gi byis pa grong khyer chen mo pe cin gyi khor yug de 'dra bzang bo nas slob gnyer byed du mi 'jug par ched du chab char mngags nas bod yig sbyong du bcug pa red zer/ khong gis rgya yig gi slob grwa'i slob khrid kyi spus ka dang cha rkyen sogs phyogs gang thad nas gleng na pe cin ni chab cha dang bsdur na ldab 'gyur gyis legs pa ma shes pa gtan nas ma red/ 'di las khong gis rang mi rigs kyi skad dang yi ge la bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur rtogs thub pas/ nga tsho'i dpe ston bzang po zhig tu cis mi rung /nga tsho'i rgyud du mi rigs kyi la rgya yod med dang bod kyi rig gnas la dungs pa yod med kyang 'di'i steng nas gsal bor mtshon thub pas/nga tshos khong lta bur yi rang dang slob sbyong byed pa'i dgos pa shin tu che snyam/gzhan zhig ni na ning do tshigs slob chen khag gi bod yig sde khag nas thon pa'i stag 'dra gzigs 'dra'i slob ma dag spyi tshogs steng zhugs pa'i tshe na/ gzhung gi bya ba reg dka' ba dang / khe las sogs su rang gi ched las dang thod thug pa'i las ka ha cang nyung phyir pha yul du— 136 —

yon ta spyong byed ya sa rang da yi yin/‘‘mi lhag’’tu gyur 'dug pa'i snang tshul ga sa gang du mthong thub/ des mi rnams kyis mu mthud du slob gso myong 'dod kyi 'dun pa bcom brlag tu gtong bzhin yod la/ ‘‘bod yig la brten nas sgrub thub pa'i bya ba ha cang nyung la/ bod yig gis chos 'don byed trem las ci yang mi nyan’’zhes pa'i bsam tshul skyes pa red/ yul mi rnams la mtshon na lo tog 'debs pa bzhin dpyid kar sran ma btab tshe ston khar sran ma thogs dgos pa red/ de ltar min tshe sang lo mu mthud du sran ma 'debs srid kyi ma red/ kho tshos slob gso la'ang de lta bu'i lta stangs bzung yod pas sen mgo khrag dang sen rting snag byas nas btsal pa'i sgor mo yod tshad byis pa'i slob yon du phul rjes/ rang nyid la thob pa ni las ka las par mi dga' zhing / gzhung gi zla phog kyang len mi thub pa/ bya byad rgya min bod min gyi rigs phung gsum pa ste‘‘mi lhag’’dag dag yin tshe dngos gnas yid skyo bor 'gyur ba red la/ bod yig sbyong ba'i sems shugs kyang chung du phyin nas cha rkyen legs pa dag gis rang rang gi bu bu mo rdzong mkhar gyi rgya yig sbyong sa'i slob grwar skyel zhing / cha rkyen zhan pa rnams kyis slob grwar btang nas bod yig 'don pa las las ka las na bzang zhes bsam pa dang / tha na‘‘slob grwa chen mo pa zhig ma mo nyi shu la'ang mi do’’zhes pa'i gtam yan yang byung ba red/ mang tshogs kyi slob gso'i 'du shes ha cang dman pa'i yul gru 'dir mtshon na — 137 —

rngapa//sa/zu / :sdo/lta tshul der 'gyur ldog 'byung dgos tshe da dung dus yun ring mo zhig 'gor dgos kyang srid mod/ nga tshos mig gis rgyang ring la bltas tshe/bod cig yin pa'i cha nas bod yig cis kyang spyong dgos pa dang blo kha 'dzam gling la phyogs na yang bod yig la brten pa las 'os med pa shes na'ang / la shas shig gis da dung bod skad bshad par ngo tsha ba red zer ba'i gtam yang thos 'dzin gyi bu gar lhung bas na yid sems 'khyag sib sib tu 'gyur ro/ /deng gi dus 'di ni rig gnas shes bya rgya khyab tu dar ba'i dus skabs shig yin tsang gang gis rig gnas shes bya ma sbyang na de rjes su lus 'gro ba red/ rang nyid bod pa zhig yin na rig gnas shes bya gang zhig sbyong yang thog mar bod skad dang bod kyi yi ge spyong rgyu ni shin tu gal che ste/ der mkhas pa chen mo nyan shul mkhyen rab 'od gsal lags nas‘‘mi rigs gzhan gyi skad yig slob pa'i dgos pa ni shes rgya che ru gtong ba dang / bod kyi skad yig phun sum je tshogs su gtong ba las bod kyi skad yig rtsa med du gtong ba'am yang na nyams dmas su gtong ba'i rkyen du 'gro mi rung ba ni rtsa ba'i rtsa don yin pas thugs la nges gal che’’zhes pa ni lhag bsam dag pa'i gsung rma med pa'o/ /de min bod kyi las khungs so so na yang bod yig la snang med dang mthong chung byed pa'i snang tshul mchis pa ma zad/ dus rgyun gyi 'tsho ba'i — 138 —

rngapa/thas/can/ :sdo/gcig las med tshe a mdo pa dang khams pa'i bar bod skad kyi lam nas bshad na mi go ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas rgya skad rkyang rkyang rgyag pa de goms srol zhig tu gyur 'dug de bzhin de dag gi byis pa rnams kyi khrod du bod ming tsam btags yod pa las bod yig bod skad shes mkhan ni re gnyis tsam yod med kyi tshod du 'dug go/ bod kyi dril bsgrags las khungs so so na bod skad la 'di 'dra'i gtsigs 'dzin zhig mi byed tsang /zhib tu bsams na slob ma rnams la khag 'gel ba'i zhor du rang nyid kyi skyon yang skyon du mthong ste yo bsrang byed rgyu gal chen po yin la/ de ltar min tshe ma 'ongs pa na bod skad bod yig ni ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur te gzhan gyi mdun nas ngo gnongs dgos pa zhig tu gyur tshe 'phyis 'dug pa red/ khe sngon ngas‘‘man ju'i dra tshigs’’zhes pa zhig las man ju'i skad yig slob thabs zhes ngo mi shes pa'i yi ge 'ga' bris yod pa mthong / de ni man ju'i skad yig slar gso byed 'dod pa yin las che mod/ 'on kyang 'jig zin pa gang zhig la bskyar du tshe srog rgyas rgyu de las khag po zhig gang du yod/ der ma zad nub phyogs rig gnas kyi brdab gsig chen po'i 'og rgya nag gi skad yig la'ang shan shugs thebs shing / slob grwa so so nas dbyin yig sbyong ba'i tsha rlabs 'phyur te rgya yig la dang dod cher byed kyin mi 'dug ces rgya'i mkhas pa dag gis gsungs bzhin 'dug la/ 〈rgya yig gi 'jigs nyen〉zhes pa'i deb — 140 —

yon ta ljong byed ya sa rang sad yi yin/cig kyang bsgrigs nas rgya yig sbyong bar shugs snon byed dgos tshul lab 'dug pa kho bos mthong myong / des na rang re la ni smos ci dgos ang /de bas/ gsar 'gyur las khungs khag dang bod yig dus deb kyi rtsom sgrig khang so so nas 'di'i ched du rang shugs 'bul dgos te/brnyan 'phrin khang dang / tshags par khang / bod skad rlung 'phrin khang sogs dang / lhag par du〈bod kyi slob gso〉rtsom sgrig khang lta bur mtshon na bod kyi slob gso la dngos gnas phan pa'i bya ba zhig sgrub na legs shing / de min bod khul gyi slob deb rtsom sgrig khang so so nas kyang slob deb gra dag spus legs bsgrig pa dang zur lta'i lta klog deb yag shos re bsgrig thub na ci ma rung snyam 'ongs/ ('dir kho bos dmigs bsal du gleng 'dod pa zhig ni/ gangs ljongs mdo smad kha gya bla srog rtsom sgrig khang gis bsgrubs pa'i slob gso'i dus deb〈bla srog〉gi skor te/ dus deb de ni nga tsho'i bshad srol ltar na dus deb‘‘mgo rdo’’zhig yin na'ang / der bkod pa'i brtsams chos dag las nga tsho'i mi rigs kyi‘‘bla srog’’ste skad dang yi ge skor la mno bsam gnad du things pa btang yod pas/ dus deb de ga'i rtsom sgrig pa lhan rgyas la thugs rje che zhu ba dang chabs cig bod kyi skad dang yi ge nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel du 'gro bar phyar ba gru 'degs kyi nus pa thon pa'i smon 'dun zhus pa yin)gzhan yang mtho 'bring slob mas dpe char lta min dang dpe cha nyo mi — 141 —

rngabalhas/can/ ::rdonyo'i thad nas tshig gcig bshad na/ de dag phar zhog bdag gi g.yas g.yon gyi‘‘rgyal khab kyi las byed pa’’de dag gi khrod du yang las thob sogs rgyugs len par nges par du mkho ba'i dpe cha nyo ba dang lta ba las de las gzhan pa'i phyogs kyi dpe cha bya ba'i steng zhugs pa nas gcig kyang nyos ma myong ba mdzub mo nang du bkug nas brtsi rgyu mang po 'dug pas su yis su la slob gso gtong ang /ji skad du/ phru gu gso spyad yag shos a ma'i 'o ma yin/ yon tan sbyong byed yag shos rang gi skad yig yin ces pa'i bden pa'i gtam 'di kun gyis thugs la 'jags par 'tshal zhes bsam pa'i tshul rma med pa dang gsong bo'i tshig yig ngor bkod de nan gyis skul to/ /2006lo'i zla9pa'i tshes25nyin zi ling du/

‘‘dpe cha nga tsho'i sa rabs 'di'i che sro yin’’‘‘dpe cha ni nga tsho'i dus rabs 'di'i che srog yin’’da wa‘‘'dzam gling dpe klog nyin mo’’bsleb la nye ba'i snga rol du/dpe cha klog pa de ni srol bzang po zhig ste/ dpe klog gis nga tsho'i bsam pa'i 'jig rten phun sum tshogs par gtong ba dang / rig gnas shes bya khong du chud pa/ 'jig rten lta tshul dang rin thang lta tshul legs po zhig chags pa sogs la dge mtshan ldan pa'i nus pa 'don thub par ma zad/ rang rgyud kyi rmongs pa'i mun pa mthar skrod pa sogs la'ang shin tu sman pa ni kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar lags/ de bas/ zla4pa'i tshes23nyin te‘‘'dzam gling dpe klog nyin mo’’bsleb la nye ba'i skabs 'dir/ dpe klog gi nus pa 'don spel dang / dpe klog gi yo lang drag tu rgyas par phyar ba gru 'degs kyi nus pa tsam 'don par dmigs nas rtsom 'di bris pa yin la/ 'di yang nga tsho'i dpe klog gi me kha gso ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur bar smon/da rtsom pa po'i gtam/nub phyogs rgyal khab khag tu dpe cha klog pa de goms srol zhig tu chags yod pas/ mi mang che bas gnas skor du 'gro ba dang yar mar la khams gseng du skyod dus kyang dpe cha 'ga' re bzung nas 'gro ba dang / kho tsho'i khyim du phyin tshe thab tshang dang gzim khang / 'grul — 143 —

2spragalhas/::/ :sdo/khang / tha na spyod khang sogs su'ang dpe cha bzhag yod cing / khom long re byung na ci 'dod du blangs nas bklag chog pas ha cang stabs bde yin pa red zer/ kho tsho'i dpe cha yang rgya nag pa'i khyim du rgyun du mthong ba'i dpe cha dang khyad par chen po zhig yod pa ni/ tshal tho dang sman bcos 'phrod bsten skor gyi gsal bshad yi ge gnas skor lam yig sogs kho na tsam ma yin par 'dzam gling na skad grags che ba'i brtsams chos mang po zhig yod skad/ dpe cha de dag kyang pha mas rang gi bu rabs tsha rgyud la brgyud cing / des kyang rang gi phyi rabs par brgyud pas rig gnas kyi gzung thag de mtshams ma chad par gcig nas gcig la mthud pa dang / goms srol bzang po 'di yang mu nas mu ru bsrings pa yin 'dugade lta na'ang / rang re'i gzhi rim gyi rong 'brog mang tshogs la mtshon na yig ngo chod pa las yig rmongs pa mang zhing / 'grim 'grul dang cha 'phrin sogs phyogs gang thad nas stabs bde min pa sogs kyi dbang gis re zhig btang snyoms su bskyur kyang rung mod/ yid skyo ba dang blo kha gtan du bde thabs bral ba zhig ni/ grong khyer dang grong rdal so so na bya ba sgrub bzhin pa'i las byed pa dang slob ma rnams te/las byed pa de dag las mang che shos shig slob grwa che 'bring chung gsum gyi sgo them las phyir thon pa nas dpe cha yongs su 'dor ba dang / slob ma — 144 —

‘‘dpe cha nga cho'i sa rabs 'di'i che sro yi ’’mang che ba ni slob deb kho na tsam dang yang na zang zing gi dngos por mgo 'khor nas 'dug pa las/ 'gro mi'i bsam pa'i thon khungs su rtsi zhing /mi rabs nas mi rabs bar gser bzhin yang yang btso sbyang byas nas byung ba'i brtsams chos grags can khag la lta mkhan ni nyung tsam las med pa'i tshod du gda'/mi rigs shig gi 'byung spus dang / mi rigs shig gong 'phel dang yar rgyas yong min de mi rigs de'i dpe klog chu tshad dang / dpe klog la bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur las rtogs thub pa yin la/ mi gzhi bzang po zhig chags thub min yang mthar gtugs na dpe cha klog mi klog dang 'brel ba dam po yod pa red/ rgyu mtshan ni rlabs chen gyi skyes bu gang mang gi rin chen gser las lhag pa'i rnam dpyod kyi nying khu de dpe cha'i bar gseng du 'thim nas yod pa dang / kho tsho'i bsam pa'i khang bzang nas bskrun pa'i ches bla ru 'phags pa'i bsam blo'i thon rdzas kyang dpe cha'i steng du mngon par gsal la/ kho tsho'i lag len dngos las byung ba'i bden thub kyi gnas lugs dag kyang dpe cha'i yig 'bru re re'i khong du sbas yod pa red/ de bas/ dpe cha legs po de rigs ni nga tsho'i lam ston gyi sgron me ru 'gyur srid la/ dpe cha de rigs bklags pa'i tshe na nga tsho'i bsam blo 'thus tshang can du 'gyur ba dang / nga tsho'i shes rgya yangs por bskyed pa/ nga tshos rang nyid la ngos zin 'thob pa/— 145 —

rnga balhas ji / ::/nga tsho'i blo sgo che ru 'byed pa/ nga tsho'i mi gzhi je legs su 'gro ba/ nga tsho'i rin thang lta tshul legs par bsgyur pa sogs kyi rgyu ru 'gyur ba red/dpe cha bklags na mi yi tshe yun ring du sring mi thub kyang / mi tshe yi mdun lam je yangs dang / dngos po'i 'tsho ba dang bsam pa'i 'tsho ba gra je rgyas dang phun sum je tshogs su gtong bar rngo thogs srid pas/dpe cha 'dor ba ni shes yon 'dor ba kho na tsam min par/ mi rigs gang de 'phel rgyas dang dpal yon ldan pa'i lam du skyod pa'i gegs rkyen yin no/ /rang re'i mes po dag gis kyang‘‘rig pa nangs par 'chi yang bslab’’ces rig pa'i gnas la sbyong ba lhod med byed dgos pa'i bslab bya gnang 'dug pa red la/ 'gran rtsod kyi char rlung drag tu 'khrigs pa'i dus da lta dpe cha klog pa'i dgos pa lhag tu che ste/ dpe cha klog min dang slob sbyong byed min de chung sa nas bshad na/ nga tsho'i mi re re'i 'tsho gnas dang rgyal pham gyi dbye ba 'byed pa'i 'gag rtsar thug yod pa red/ ‘‘dpe cha klog par spro ba mi ldan tshe/ nyid kyi bsam blo'i bzhur rgyun 'chad par 'gyur’’zhes pa ltar/ mi zhig gi bsam blo'i bzhur rgyun chad pa'i tshe na/ bya gzhag gang zhig bsgrub kyang gsar skrun gyi nus pa gang yang 'don mi thub cing / rang gzhan kun la sman pa zhig yong ba ni de bas kyang dpe mi srid pas/ nga tsho 'tsho ba don ldan da 146 da

‘‘dpe cha nga cho'i sa rabs 'di'i che srog yin’’zhig byed na cis kyang dpe cha bklag dgos shing / dpe cha klog pa'i go rim khrod nas bsam gzhig gnad smin btang ste lag len dngos dang zung 'brel byed dgos/dra ba dang brnyan 'phrin sogs rgya khyab tu dar ba dang bstun nas/mi mang shos shig gis dra ba dang brnyan 'phrin sogs kyi steng nas shes bya bsdu len byed pa de thabs legs po zhig tu rtsi bzhin 'dug pas/ la shas kyis dpe klog gi dus rabs mjug rdzogs song zhes dang / deng gi dus rabs ni 'dra ris(tso༈myu)kyi dus rabs te/ 'dra ris kyis yi ge'i tshab byed pa dang / yi ge'i tshe srog la 'jigs nyen bzo bzhin yod ces smra na'ang / tshad nges can zhig nas bshad na/ dra ba dang brnyan 'phrin sogs ni dpe cha dang cis kyang bsdur thabs mi 'dug ste/ 'dra ris la skad cha bzhin go brda sprod pa'i dka' khag med par thad ka thad kar go ba len bde zhing / tha na lo tsā dang 'grel pa sogs kyang zhib mo byed mi dgos par kha ngo sems ngo 'phrod sla na'ang / de dag ni skad cig gi‘‘longs spyod’’dang yang na cha 'phrin brgyud sgrog gi yo byad tsam las slob sbyong dang bsam pa'i rgyags phye gya nom pa zhig tu 'gyur mi srid la/ 'dzam gling rig gnas kun la go ba bskon pa'i thabs lam mchog gyur zhig tu'ang ye nas rlom thabs bral/ ‘‘rig gnas 'phral zas’’(spra6‘lnga0)kyi rnam pa de rigs kyis nam yang skabs thog gi bde ba tsam — 147 bhe

/pa/tha /casta/ :sdo/las dpe cha nang bzhin yun ring gi bsam blo'i zab tshad dang shes bya'i ma lag 'thus tshang zhig theg mi thub pas/ nga tshos don gyi 'bras bu khur du dud pa'i dpe cha gang mang la yang lta bskyar lta dang / de las rig gnas shes bya dang bsam pa'i thon khungs 'tshol ba ni ches legs par mthong / dpe cha klog na'ang gdam gses yod pa dang dmigs yul yod pa'i sgo nas bklag rgyu ni gal chen yin pa red/ de min par dpe cha'i steng gi brda khyab la bltas nas dar srol('i.oṃlo)gyi rjes bsnyegs pa ni ngal ba 'bras med yin/ kho bor mtshon na dpe cha nyo dus dpe stegs steng gi brin che'i dpe cha'i(/memiwaṃ)skor de la spro ba cher med de/de dag ni gnas skabs su dar che ba'i glu gzhas dang 'dra bar dus kyi nyams tshod las thar thub gi ma red/ der brten dpe cha klog mkhan rnal ma'am shes yon can zhig la mtshon na/ mang mang gis tsha tsha 'ur 'ur ngang klog bzhin pa'i dpe cha de dag la lta ba'i dgos pa yod med bshad dka' ste/ de dag las mang che shos ni dge mtshan chung zhing phan nus zhan pa'i rigs yin pa ni nyams myong gis ra sprod thub pas/ ngas 'dod pa'i dpe cha ni bsam blo'i shugs che la/ mi tshe'i lta tshul dang rin thang lta tshul la shugs rkyen chen po bzo zhing bklags brgyas mi ngoms pa de rigs yin pa las/ mar nang gi spu tsam yang rgyas spros dang 'ud shob kyis bsgrags pa'i dpe cha chung ngu'i rigs de ni ma yin no/ /— 148 —

‘‘dpe cha 6 nga cho'i dus rabs 'di'i che sro yin’’bsam gzhig gtong bar mos shing mi tshe'i 'dun ma shes rig gi klong la sring mkhan zhig dang / phugs bsam gyis brtas shing lang tsho'i 'dab lag rig pa'i dbyings su brkyangs pa'i mi bu zhig la mtshon na/dpe cha ni kho'i lam gyi rgyags phye dang ring nas brtse ba'i grogs po lta bu zhig yin srid la/ nam yang slob sbyong gi khrod nas gong nas gong du snyeg pa dang rang la re ba nan bcangs kyis 'bad pa lhod med byed mkhan zhig yin pa'ang gdon mi za/ ‘‘ma bslab mkhas pa gling na med’’ces pa bzhin/ nga tshos 'gro mi'i shes rig gi lo rgyus la bltas na shes thub pa ni/ sngon byon gyi mkhas pa dang rtsom mkhan grags chen sogs skyes bu dam pa rnams ni thog mar dpe cha pa yin te/ kho tshos dpe cha'i steng nas bsam blo'i 'tsho bcud gzhib cing / de dag khong du chud pa dang rang gi lta ba dang myong ba ci rigs la brten nas rig gnas kyi ma lag 'thus tshang dang bsam blo'i sgrig gzhi mtha' ru bskyed pas phyi rabs pa yongs la shugs rkyen zab mo thebs pa dang / shes rig sgron me'i 'od snang gis rmongs pa'i skye bo khri phrag gi mdun lam gsal bar byas pa red/'on kyang / nga tshos rang gi nye 'khor la gzhigs tshe/ zang zing gi dngos po dang 'ur zing gi mi tshogs khrod blo sems rnal la phab nas dpe cha klog mkhan gyi mi bu ga tsam yod ang / rgya nag la dpe re blangs — 149 —

‘‘dpe cha nga cho'i sa rabs 'di'i che sro yin’’rang rkya 'pher ba'i mi rigs shig yin pa'i cha nas/ lhag tu nga tsho mi re re nas dpe klog gi 'dun pa kun nas bslangs te rig gnas shes byas rang nyid la drag chas spra dgos pa ni gnad kyi don po lags/ mi rigs gang de 'tsho gzhes kyi rig gnas khor yug bye thang can du gyur pa yin na/ mi rigs de'i mdun lam yang skya thang thang zhig tu 'gyur srid pas/ nga tsho rig gnas pa re re'i phrag tu babs pa'i 'gan khur ni gzhan kun las kyang lci'o/ /shes rig dar ba'i rmang gzhi ni rig gnas shes bya yin pa bsnyon du med/ dpe cha ni rig gnas shes bya'i khur 'degs(chikre.oṃ)gtso bo zhig yin pa'i cha nas/ nga tshos dpe cha mang du klog pa ni don du shes rig ldan pa'i spyi tshogs nang skyod par bgrod lam btings pa yin la/ mi rigs shig 'jigs nyen las thar thub min dang / mi rigs shig la re ba yod med kyang dpe klog dang 'bral thabs med pas/ nga tshos mnyam du don snying ldan pa'i nyin mo de lta bu yid la bcags nas/ nyin mo de ma tshad par dus rgyun du dpe cha mang du klog pa dang / dpe cha legs po dang dpe cha rin thang can bklags te 'gan 'khri can gyi mi bu zhig byed pa ni bshol med kyi 'dam ga yin/mjug tu grogs po yongs la 'dzam gling dpe klog nyin mor legs skyes su dbul rgyu ni‘‘dpe cha ni nga tsho'i dus rabs 'di'i tshe srog yin’’(pe ge 151 —
lin si khe'i gsung)ces pa de'o/ /2007 4 12nyin zi ling du bris/

thag zadarngabathag shā: rngapa /dus rabs shig gi lha sgrungad don grubargyal dang khong gi mi che'i rin thang /da wasku zhabs don grub rgyal lags sku gshegs nas lo 'khor20lon par rjes dran du/don grub rgyal lags ni bod kyi deng rabs rtsom 'byung lo rgyus steng sngar byung ma myong ba'i mi sna gal chen zhig yin la/ khong gi grub 'bras dang mdzad rjes kyis nga tshor rtsom rig gi bgrod lam gsar pa zhig mngon par btod yod pas/ nga tshos ja kha chang khar yin na'ang 'dra/ nga tshos 'gro zhor 'dug zhor du yin na'ang 'dra/ bod kyi rtsom rig gsar pa'i skor gyi gleng mol phran tsam byed dus kyang / thog mar dran pa'i mkha' ngogs su bya rgyal rgod po bzhin rang dbang gis 'phur yong ba ni rtsom mkhan don grub rgyal khong nyid lags/ der brten nga tshos bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la zhib 'jug byed dus khong nyid ni nam yang g.yol mi rung ba'i brjod gzhi nyag gcig go/ da lta rtsom mkhan khong nyid 'jig rten mi yul dang kha bral nas lo 'khor20lon pa'i skabs 'dir khong la rjes dran zhu ba ni ha cang gis dgos gal che ste/ 'di ni nga tshos khong nyid kyi mdzad rjes la rjes su yi rang dang brtsi 'jog gnang ba'i — 155 —

rngarnga/thas can/ ::shematshon rtags shig kyang yin no/ /don grub rgyal lags gleng dus nga tshos lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i na gzhon tsho'i snying stobs dang spobs pa wa ler dran 'ongs te/ kho tsho ni bod kyi deng rabs shes rig lo rgyus steng gi dkyogs mtshams ches che ba dang / rang nyid kyi bde sdug dang las dbang gzhan la mi brten par rang nyid kyis kha lo bsgyur ci thub byed par 'bad pa'i dpung sde dang po red/ lo rabs de'i nang don grub rgyal las shes yon gyis phyug cing lta rgya mthong rgya che ba'i shes yon can med ces kho bo nam yang dogs pa mi za/yin na'ang don grub rgyal bzhin gsar gtod dang dogs slong /dgag sgrub bcas kyi snying stobs ldan pa'i shes yon can med pa ni lo rgyus kyis nga tshor ra sprod byas yod pa dang / rgyu rkyen de'i dbang gis don grub rgyal khong nyid rig gnas gsar pa'i dar cha mkha' la 'phyar mkhan ang dang po red la/ lo rabs brgyad cu pa ni‘‘don grub rgyal gyi dus rabs’’zhes brjod cing 'gal ba med snyam/ khong nyid sha dar khrag dar gyi dpung sde de'i khrod ches sngon du 'greng ba'i gdong mchong pa zhig yin pa'i ngos nas/ khong gis bton pa'i nus pa ni gzhan dag las kyang khyad du 'phags pa yin te/ brtsams sgrung gsar pa dang lhug rtsom gsar pa/ snyan ngag gsar pa/ kha shags/ gzhas tshig sogs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi phyogs sgo mo kun dang / da dung rigs gzhung zhib — 156 —

thag rtsadarngabathab :: jing /'jug bcas kyi thad du'ang gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i grub 'bras chen po blangs yod pa red/ de'ang mthar gtugs na khong la gsar gtod kyi snying stobs chen po zhig ldan pas red/ don grub rgyal khong gis kyang‘‘gsar gtod kyi stobs med na/ drang bden zer ba yang med la/rgyu 'bras zer ba yang skyag rdzun red’’ces gsar gtod kyi snying stobs ni yod tshad kyi gzhi rtsa lta bu yin cing nges par du mkho ba'i 'bod skul btang 'dugartsom mkhan zhig yin na khong gi mi tshe lta tshul dang 'jig rten lta tshul gyis rang gi gsar rtsom gyi kha phyogs thag gis bcad yod de/ nga tshos don grub rgyal gyi gsar rtsom bshul lam la phyir lta zhig bgyis na don grub rgyal yang de lta red/ khong gi smyu gu'i mdung kha gtod yul ni gtso bo bod kyi spyi tshogs steng gi tshul min gyi bya spyod dang / rmongs mun gyi rnam pa/ brtse dungs la rang dbang med pa bcas kyi rnam pa sdug po de red/ der dkar po gyen 'ded dang nag po thur 'ded kyi dpe ltar dgag rgyag dang sun 'byin byed rgyur khong gis rang nyid kyi 'gan khur lta bu'i 'du shes bzung 'dug khong gi brtsams chos〈sprul sku〉〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉〈sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog〉〈rkang lam phra mo〉sogs gang la bltas kyang thun mong gi myong ba 'di tsam rgyud la 'drongs thub/ lhag par du khong gi〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉de dung brda zhig yin pa'i dbang du — 157 —

rtsaḥ//sa can/ :sdo/btang na/ lha la bstod pa byed pa ma yin la/ 'dre la dmod mo byed pa'ang min par gangs can gyi gzhon nu rnams la bsgrags pa'i lang tsho'i bsgrags gtam yin la/ kho tshor bstod tshig phul pa dang 'bod skul btang ba'ang yin pas/ gangs ljongs hril bor g.yo 'gul chen po thebs shing / de ma thag rang re'i rtsom rig gsar pa'i zhing sa kun la gson shugs drag tu rgyas pa dang dpal 'bar bar gyur cing / snyan ngag ces pa'i rtsom lus 'dir shi 'tham ro 'tham byed pa'i dpung sde rab dang rim pa byung nas/ snyan ngag gsar pa 'bri ba ni mi rigs kyi la rgya brjod pa dang de 'bri mkhan ni mi rigs la brtse dungs yod mkhan zhig tu rtsi bzhin yod/ don ngo ma de lta yin kyang chog la min kyang rung /gang ltar don grub rgyal khong nyid kyis nga tshor de lta bu'i khor yug gsar pa zhig bskrun par su yis kyang bsgrun mi nus/ rtsom rig dpyad brjod spel mkhan kha shas kyis〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉yis thon pa'i nus pa ni brtsams chos rang steng las brgal 'dug ces brjod cing / la shas kyis rtsom lus 'di la da dung rang grol snyan ngag ces 'bod pas kyang yod tshad ra sprod byas 'dug de bzhin khong gi brtsams sgrung〈sprul sku〉lta bur mtshon na thad kar spyi tshogs steng gnas pa'i don rkyen ngo mar gzhi bcol nas ther 'don dang dgag gzhag spros yod pas(don du sprul sku rdzun ma zhig yin)lo rabs der khong nyid mi nas‘‘'dre’’ru bsgyur mkhan — 158 —

sa rabs shig lha nga /yang gcig min gnyis min du byung skad/ don dam du sgrung gtam gyis do khur bya yul ni mi yin la/ rtsom pa pos rtsom 'bri'i dmigs yul ni byung rim rags rgyas gang rung la brten nas dpe mtshon mi sna zhig bzhengs bskrun byed pa dang / klog pa por spyi tshogs dang 'tsho bar ngos 'dzin 'thob par rogs ram byed pa dang / klog pa por nyams myong 'don sprod byas te kun spyod dang bsam blo gang thad nas dge mtshan ldan pa'i bag chags shig 'jog rgyu de lags/ don grub rgyal khong nyid kyi kun slong yang de las ma 'das mod/ yin na yang khong gi sems kyi sgra dbyangs la rna ba blags nas nyan mkhan mang bo med par de las ldog ste ku co sna tshogs bton cing / da dung khong nyid la 'jigs skul gtong ba'i sbyor ba yang bshams grabs skad/ rtsom mkhan zhig la mtshon na gzhan gyis rang gi brtsams chos la go ba yang dag mi lon pa'i khar ldog phyogs nas log 'grel rgyag pa dang / da dung dus rabs kyi nyes can du bgrangs tshe/ de ni bzod dka' ba'i na zug cig yin pa gdon mi za mod/ 'on kyang skabs de'i spyi tshogs de la mtshon na na zug tsam yang med par 'thom sbrid du gyur 'dug pas lhag tu skyo ang / khong gi〈rkang lam phra mor〉〉mtshon na bgrod lam che chung gnyis kyi gtam rgyud brgyud nas 'jig rten lta tshul gnyis gsed 'grol byas 'dug la/khong gi 'dam ga dang khong gi lta ba/ khong gi bsam blo sogs kyang — 159 —

2pa//sa/cam/ :sdo/bgrod lam che chung gnyis kyi steng nas mngon par bstan 'dug pa red/dpyad brjod pa'i sde na da lta da dung khong gi〈rkang lam phra mo〉las lhag pa'i lhug rtsom yag shos shig byung med ces brjod pa yang‘‘gser zhing nor bus spras pa’’ma yin par don dngos so/ /dogs slong mkhan zhig gi ngos nas bshad na/ lo rgyus skor gyi dpyad rtsom dang sku zhabs zla ba blo gros sogs la springs pa'i 'phrin yig dag las khong ni them pa'i sgang gi ril ma lta bu zhig ma yin par yid kyi dpyod pa brgyud nas rang gi lta tshul gsong bor brjod yod pa las kyang dogs slong pa zhig yin pa gsal bor shes thub la/ khong nyid rtsom mkhan zhig nas‘‘snang tshul’’rigs shig tu gyur pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo yang gong gi 'di dag gi steng nas mtshon pa yin las che/ngo ma/ dus tshod kyi 'gros ni ci 'dra'i mgyogs pa la ang /mig rdeb dbang tsam gyis ring la rang gi rigs la zhen pa dkar zhing /sems khong na la rgya'i shwa 'od drag tu brdol ba'i rig pa'i dpa' bo zhig dang / rtsom rig las don la sha thang thang du 'bad pa byed pa'i rtsom mkhan zhig mtho sgang ma ma'i pang dang bral te lo yi 'khor mo nyi shu 'das song / khong gis tshad yod kyi mi tshe thung ngu'i nang rang gi lang tsho'i 'od snang yod tshad gangs ri'i ljongs su gtor cing / tha na rang gi tshe srog kyang gnas 'dir‘‘dmar mchod’’byas tshar bas khong gi rin thang de yang bhe 160 —

thag chodarngababasko :: rngung /rtsom rig gi khyab khongs tsam las 'da' ste mi gshis kyi mtho tshad cig tu bzhengs skrun byas yod/ de yang don grub rgyal khong nyid gshegs pa'i rjes su/ khong gi brtsams chos la lad zlos byed mkhan rgyun ma chad la/slob grwa che 'bring khag tu khong la rjes dran zhu ba'i mdzad sgo rgya che chung gang mang bsdus shing / rjes dran deb kyang snum dpar lcags dpar sna tshogs byung myong ba ma zad/ khong gi 'das rkyen yang kun gyi brjod gzhir gyur nas bshad rgyun mi gcig pa mang du 'dug kha shas kyis don grub rgyal gshegs mi 'dug rgya gar na yod pa mi che ge mos dngos su mthong myong zer zhes bshad pa'ang kho bos thos myong la/ da dung kha shas kyis don grub rgyal ni nga'i grogs po yin ces brjod pa dang /ngas khong dang mnyam du a rag 'thung myong zhes ngom so byed cing rang gi gzi brjid cig tu rtsi bzhin yod pa red/ gang ltar don grub rgyal khong nyid nga rgyal dang skyo gdung / kher rkyang dang na zug bcas kyi sgo nas nga tsho dang gtan du bral song mod/ mi bu ci 'dra'i mang po zhig gis khong nyid la bstod glu 'bul zhing / brtsi bkur byed la/ dang rten byed mkhan yang yod pa 'dis kyang khong gi rin thang gi cha shas tsam cis kyang rtogs yong la/ don grub rgyal sku gshegs pa de khong nyid sku gshegs pa tsam ma yin par de dang lhan du nga tsho'i rang nyid kyi cha shas mang po zhig kyang shor song ba'i nges shes rnyed thub tshe/ de ring da dung‘‘'tsho zhing — 161 —

rdo sprothas/can/ ::/gzhes pa'i nga tshos’’rang nyid la zhib lta dang / mig zung ches cher gdangs nas tshe srog la go ba gsar du rnyed thub ang /don grub rgyal lags la zhib 'jug byed pa de rig tshan zhig tu bkod nas zhib 'jug byed pa'i dge ba chen po yod de/ don grub rgyal khong nyid yin na'ang 'dra/ khong gi brtsams chos yin na'ang 'dra/nga tsho'i deng rabs rtsom 'byung lo rgyus dang spyi tshogs steng bzhag pa'i don snying dang bag chags de su yis kyang bsgrun du med de/ ‘‘rang grol zhib 'jug’’gi gleng slong mkhan sku zhabs a bu lags nas kyang‘‘don grub rgyal la zhib 'jug dang khong gi rin thang sngog 'don byed rgyu de khos mi tshe gang bor sgrub kyang 'grub dka'’’zer/ de bas nga tsho mi mang po dpung sde 'di'i khrod du zhugs nas rang grol zhib 'jug gi ma lag 'thus je tshang dang gya je nom du gtong ba'i 'gan khur yod pa red/ nga tshos khong nyid gshegs nyin te zla11pa'i tshes30(tshes29dang tshes31la ngos 'dzin mkhan yang yod)nyin rang re'i bod kyi rtsom rig gi dus chen zhig tu gtan khel byed thub pa byung tshe rtsom mkhan khong la mar me stong phrag sgron pa las kyang don snying che bar bsams/don grub rgyal lags kyi brtsams chos las mi 'dang sa dang zhan cha med pa'ang ma yin te/ dper na/ khong gi brtsams chos mang che shos su bsam blo ston pa las tshor 'du brjod pa shugs drag cing / khong gi — 162 —

sa rabs shi gi lha nga /smyug 'og gi mi sna mang che shos tshon sna gcig gis bris pa'i ri mo zhig dang 'dra bar rang rang la thun min gyi khyad chos chen po med par chig rkyang pa'i tshul du mngon/ yin na yang skyon cha 'di tsam gyis nga tsho khong gi brtsams chos klog par dga' ba dang / khong gi lag rjes la brtsi bkur byed pa/ khong la rjes dran zhu ba sogs kyi sems 'dun la bkag 'gog thebs mi srid pas/ kho bos sems khong rus pa'i gting nas don grub rgyal mchog la gus 'dud zhus pa yin/2005lo'i zla11pa'i tshes26nyin/(rtsom yig 'di ni sku zhabs don grub rgyal lags 'jig rten mi yul dang zhal gyes nas lo 'khor20lon par bsdus pa'i rjes dran tshogs 'du zhig gi steng du spel ba'i yig thog gtam bshad yin)

rngapa//sa com/ :sdo/bud med rang gi‘‘skad’’da wa〈za ma mo'i skyid sdug gangs ma char〉gyi sngon 'gro'i gtam/lar bdag ni bud med kyi khe dbang la zhib 'jug byed mkhan zhig min/yin kyang rang nyid bud med cig yin pas/ gangs can bud med kyi las sdug po 'di dag mig gis mthong thengs rer skyur skyur ba'i tshor pa rnon po zhig ngang gis byin yong ste/ rang tshod kyis 'di'i phyogs la bsam gzhig phra mo re mi gtong ka med byung /da 'jam dbyangs skyid/spyir na dpe cha zhig gi sngon 'gro'i gtam blo dman nga 'dras 'bri ba ni gser gyi ka bar 'jag mas lhan pa rgyag pa'i dpe ru 'gro srid mod/'on kyang kho bo mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur khang gi rtsom sgrig pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas rtsom mkhan 'jam dbyangs skyid la rtsom skul byas myong la/mo'i rtsom la rtsom sgrig kyang byas myong bas cha rgyus cung zab mo yod ces bshad kyang mi chog pa med/ 'di ni mos nga la sngon 'gro'i gtam 'di 'bri ru bcug pa'i rgyu mtshan yang yin srid/lo rgyus la phyir rtog byas na/ rang re'i gangs can yul du ma gcig lab sgron dang / myang tsha dkar rgyan sogs kun gyis khas len — 164 —

bud med rang ‘‘ da’’pa'i mdzangs ma skor zhig byon myong na'ang / de dag ni lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i khrod thim zin pas kho mo tsho re zhig gleng mtshams bzhag ste de ring gi dngos yod la gzhigs tshe/ rang re'i gras su phugs bsam gyis brtas shing shes yon gyis phyug pa dang / smyu gur brten nas rang gi khe dbang srung ba'i bud med ni dngos gnas nyung shas las med pas/kho mo tsho ni nam yang nga tsho'i spyi chogs khrod kyi nus med gnyom chung gi tshogs par gyur 'dug cing / srol rgyun gyi tshad bkag sna tshogs kyi dbang gis‘‘ngag lkugs’’nas yun ring la lus/ yin na'ang deb 'di'i byed po 'jam dbyangs skyid ni de las ldog ste‘‘gangs can bud med kyi las sdug po 'di mthong thengs rer bsam gzhig phra mo re mi gtong ka med byung’’la/ mu mthud du kha rog ger sdod thabs med pas dka' tshegs che la‘‘rang la goms lobs su song ba'i khyim las tsag tsig dang gtan nas mi 'dra ba'i’’las 'dir hur brtson gyis zhugs pa red/bud med rtsom mkhan zhig yin pa'i cha nas/ na ning do tshigs mos bris pa'i 'bol rtsom gyi grangs ka ltos bcas kyis mang zhing / bsam gzhig gnad du things pa/ bsam blo rno ngar che ba sogs dge mtshan du mas phyug pas nga tshor bud med rang gis rang gi‘‘skad’’sgrog par nyan pa'i go skabs bstsal par ma zad/ tshur snang lan cha drag po 'khor ba ni dga' 'os pa'i gnas so/ /

sprepa/thas/:mi/ ::rdodeng gi dus 'di la kun gyis kha na pho mo 'dra mnyam gyi kha g.yang mthon por sgrog cing pho mchog mo dman gyi 'du shes ring du 'dor dgos pa'i lta ba ci dgar spel na'ang / nga tsho'i 'tsho ba dngos kyi khrod du de lta min pa gzhir byas/ kha g.yang dang lta ba de dag spel mkhan rang rang gis kyang de ltar sgrub min rang rang sems na khrigs khrigs yin/ bud med kyi thob thang la brtsi bkur mi byed cing / bud med kyi khe dbang la khag theg mi byed pa'i dus rabs shig gi nang du pho mo 'dra mnyam gyi skal pa ni nam yang yod re skan/ des na/ bud med kyi khe dbang dang bud med kyi thob thang de bud med rang gis brtson len byed pa'i dgos pa che la don snying ldan/ de las ldog ste bud med tsho ni‘‘go kha'i 'jig rten’’chung ngu tsam las mi brgal cing / yag las tsag tsig las mi brtson pa/pha ma'i lag gi tshong rdzas lta bu zhig tu gyur tshe/ (khe nyin chung ma'i pha yul gyi mi zhig gis sngon tag tag la kho tsho'i sde ba'i bu mo zhig sgor khri gcig dang stong bdun la bkugs nas‘‘btsongs’’song zer ba'i gtam zhig thos pas gnas tshul da dung dza drag yin pa shes) bud med rnams ni dus nam yang nga tsho'i bag chags rnying pa'i khrod kyi‘‘skra ring blo thung’’sogs snang chung dang dma' 'bebs byed pa'i yul las thar thub yod pa ma red/'di'i thad nas bshad na/ bud med rtsom mkhan 'jam dbyangs skyid kyis bud med rnams kyi yun ring por‘‘ngag mi smra ba'i’’brtul zhugs — 166 —

bud med rang sadaspangs te/ lam bu gsar pa zhig btod dang gtod bzhin yod cing /bud med rang gi‘‘skad’’kyis nga tshor kho mo tsho'i 'jon thang dang rang dbang brtson len bgyi ba'i cong brda gsal po zhig bsgrags pa red la/nga tshos skyes pa shes yon can re rer‘‘gzhung lugs sra mo’kho nar mi 'ju ba dang / ‘‘rtog bzo dang 'phrul snang gi tshor pa skyid po’’kho na 'tshol snyeg mi byed pa'i re ba'ang bton yod pa red/a ri'i bud med kyi khe dbang brtson len byed mkhan su'u zan an thon nedhiyis‘‘da lta thag gcod dgos pa'i gnad don nyag gcig ni/nga tshor rgol ba byed pa'i mi rnams kyi khrod du su zhig gis kho mo tsho mi ma red zer phod dam/ bud med kyi khe dbang 'phrog pa'i dbang cha gtan nas med’’du ces bud med kyi khe dbang brtson len byas shing 'bod skul btang yod pa dang / dbyin ji'i bud med rtsom mkhan shar lo te pi ron thimeyi sgrung ring〈can er〉zhes pa'i mi sna gtso bos rang gi dga' grogs la gson nyams ldan pa'i gtam 'di 'dra zhig brjod yod de/ ‘‘nga'i rnam shes khyed kyi rnam shes dang gcig 'dra yin la/ nga'i sems pa'ang khyed kyi sems pa dang gcig 'dra yin te/ ngas da lta khyed dbang bhing r+sha| ṭ+wāṃ/sna sti //rmi ram̐t+t+waṃsh+lau sdi ṭ+wāṃ//ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃṭī sdin+dha snru swā2dhī~X dz+nyā mi k+ṣiṃk+ṣiṃ trebye sdusduṭ+wāṃgau tram̐ ne+e/ shu/ bud med kyi khe sgrung mahān grashes swān+ni/pi roshā byem/sa ts+tshasgo'idṛt+na sdurnoḍāgidzi khriḍā༈paṃstsa 7khrithaṅger+ha1816—1855)dbyin ji'i brtsams

rngapa/thas (5/ :sdo/la gleng mo byed pa 'di ni yul srol goms gshis brgyud pa min la/ tha na mi phal pa'i sha khrag brgyud pa'ang min par/ bdag gi sems pa dang khyed kyi sems pa'i bar gyi gleng mo yin la/ 'u gnyis dur khung du 'dzul ba'i tshe na/ nga tsho dkon mchog gi zhabs zung mtha' ru 'greng yod pas 'dra mnyam yin/’’ gong gi gtam 'di gnyis gang yin kyang pho mo 'dra mnyam yin pa'i gnas lugs de gsed 'grol byed kyin yod la/'jam dbyangs skyid kyis kyang‘‘spyir mi rigs shig 'phel rgyas su 'gro dgos na/ pho dang mo ni bya gcig gi gshog zung lta bu red/ dpe chung chung zhig gi sgo nas bshad na/ khyim 'khos bzang zhan gyi gnad don de pho mo re re la rag las pa bzhin no’’zhes brjod pa'ang 'dra mnyam rtsod pa red/ 'dra mnyam med sa na 'phel rgyas yod mi srid la/ 'gro mi'i thob thang sogs kyang skyag rdzun kho na'o/ /de bas/ nga tsho mi re re nas bsam blo zhib tu btang ste bud med ni gzhan brten srin 'bu yin pa dang skyes pa ni da gzod yod tshad yin snyam pa'i nor 'khrul gyi bsam tshul spang dgos shing / bud med rnams la'ang kho tshor thob 'os pa'i khe dbang ster ba dang / 'dra mnyam gyi khor yug bskrun te mnyam du bya ba ci rigs la 'bad 'bungs byed pa ni yid la 'jags dgos shing de bzhin lag tu bstar dgos so/ /bud med rtsom mkhan 'jam dbyangs skyid kyi〈skad yig nyams pa 'u — 168 —

bud med rang ‘‘ da’’tsho rang nyid lan〉 〈grong khyer gyi a ma zhig gi sems gcong〉 〈slob ma'i rang rlom la ci nas kyang brtsi 'jog byed rogs〉sogs gang la bltas kyang thun mong gi myong ba zhig ster ba ni/ bod kyi skad dang yi ge'i mdun du lhags pa'i nyam nyes dang / byis pa tsho'i ma 'ongs mdun lam thad la sems khral tshad med gnang bzhin pa'i kun slong gtsang ma dang /lhag par du〈bu mo kha shas bslus 'tshong byas pa las 'phros pa'i gtam thor bu〉dang / 〈bod kyi bud med gzhan yul du phyin pa'i gnas tshul〉〈gnas tshul dang gnas lugs〉〉 〈bud med kyi gnya' bcag pa'i mtha' 'bras〉 〈a ri'i mthong thos than thun〉sogs las mo rang‘‘bud med kyi khe dbang la zhib 'jug byed mkhan zhig min’’na'ang mos bud med kyi las dbang la nam yang sems khral byed pa dang / bud med kyi bde sdug nam yang sems khong du nyar ba/ bud med kyi khe dbang nam yang brtson len byed pa/ bud med kyi rtsis thang nam yang mi 'bor ba snying stobs 'di'i rigs kyi kho bo'i rgyud du bag la zha ba'i 'gan 'khri gang zhig gyen du bslangs shing / bsam pa'i bar snang hril por g.yo 'gul gcig min du bslangs pas/ rtsom sgrig pa zhig gi ngos nas yang nas yang du mor rtsom skul bgyis te mo'i bsam blo kun la dril bsgrags zer yang chog gang ltar kun gyi gzigs mor phul ba'i cha rkyen 'don ci thub byas myong / mos bris pa'i〈bod kyi bud med gzhan yul du phyin — 169 —

2ཿbaspras/zu / 15/pa'i gnas tshul〉 〈〈bu mo kha shas bslus 'tshong byas pa las 'phros pa'i gtam thor bu〉lta bur mtshon na/ ‘‘bod rigs klog pa po yod do cog gi snying la na zug gi tshor pa zhig gam bsam gzhigs kyi bro ba zab mo re cis kyang ster’’du bas/ dus skabs shig gi nang du kun gyi gleng gzhir gyur cing / rgyal khab phyi nang gi tshags par 'ga' re'i steng 'dren 'god byas te grags 'gul cung chen po byung / der brten/ 〈phun tshogs 'tsho ba〉'don thengs brgya dang zhe brgyad pa'i steng du ched du par ngos bkod sgrig byas te bgro gleng gi bar snang sngar las je yangs su btang / skabs de'i gnas tshul rags tsam gsham gyi kho bos bris pa'i‘‘sgrig pa po'i gtam’’'di las kyang rtogs thub/‘‘'jam dbyangs skyid kyis bris pa'i rtsom yig〈bod kyi bud med gzhan yul du phyin pa'i gnas tshul〉dang〈bu mo kha shas bslus 'tshong byas pa las 'phros pa'i gtam thor bu〉gnyis spel rjes/ klog pa po mi nyung ba zhig gis kha par dang 'phrin yig gi lam nas rang rang gi lta tshul lhugs por brjod byung / der gzhigs na/ rtsom yig 'dis klog pa po'i khrod g.yo 'gul chung chung zhig cis kyang thebs yod tshod 'dugadon du yang rang re'i bod rigs bud med rnams kyi las dbang de pho 'gyurazhwa/ 00tā) shupya0 snyisna rnyi kāk+to ṭ+wāṃspros sdi rtsaswā ṣ+pe/ ltar byed dus/ nga tshos ci zhig byed dgos〉〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar bhe 170 —

bud med rang ‘‘sad’’mchog mo dman gyi 'du shes rnying pa las thar thub med de/ ltos bcas kyis slob gso myong skal med pa dang / gnyen sgrig rang dbang med pa sogs kun gyis shes gsal ltar lags pas/ snang tshul 'di'i rigs la do snang dang mthong chen byed rgyu ni nga tsho'i gzur du med pa'i 'os 'gan yin/ der dmigs nas par ngos 'di ched du bsgrubs pa yin la/ par ngos tshad bkag sogs kyi dbang gis klog pa pos bskur yong ba'i rtsom yig khrod legs shos gcig las 'god ma thub par dgongs dag zhus pa yin/ slad mar yang 'di'i phyogs la thugs khur mdzad mkhan yongs nas 'di'i skor gyi ljags rtsom bskur gnang yong rgyu ni rtsom sgrig pa'i re ba yin/’’zhes kho bos ci lcogs kyis mor rgyab skyor byas pa ni/ gnas lugs la dad pa'i ches skyir btang gi sems 'dun tsam bstan pa yin la/rang gi langs phyogs kyang mtshon khul byas pa yin/ 'jam dbyangs skyid kyis bris pa'i〈bu mo de tsho ci'i phyir gzhan yul du 'bro dgos song〉zhes pa'i rtsom du/ ‘‘bu mo tsho gzhan rigs dang gnyen bsgrig rgyur dga' ba de yang bu mo rnams rang khyim du sdod pa'i goms srol chags med pa dang rang yul du mna' mar go sa med pa sogs kyi dbang gis mjug 'bras 'di byung ba red snyam/ 'di yang mdor dril na/ bu mo de tsho'i skyo gar rkyang rkyang tsam ma yin par/ 'u tsho'i mi rigs kyi skyo gar — 171 —

rnga guthas ::/ rngorngo/red 'dod’’ces nga tshor‘‘skyo gar’’de'i tshabs chen rang bzhin bstan pa red/ mo'i sems gtam 'di dag kha cig la bsam blo gsar pa zhig gi tshod du yang mi slebs par da dung skyon gyi gong bur gyur tshe nga dang nga 'dra ba dag gis de dag la gtan du gu yangs gtong thabs bral/ rgyu mtshan ni skyo gar skyo gar du mi mthong ba'i mi rigs shig gi mdun lam de ga 'dra zhig yin srid dam/ dri ba 'dir nga tsho su yin kyang lag pa brang la bzhag ste bsam blo gtong rgyu dang / rnam 'gyur drang mo'i sgo nas kha gtod rgyu ni gnad dam par mthong / dus mtshungs su gsal 'debs byed rgyu zhig la/ nga tsho bod kyi bud med yongs nas kyang shes yon sbyang rgyu dang bca' khrims la brten nas rang rang gi khe dbang bsrung ci thub byas te/ ma 'ongs pa na su'u zan an thon ni dang han na' a ren dulta bu'i mdzangs ma mang du 'byung ba dang / gangs can bud med rnams‘‘mi bu’’re rer 'gyur rgyu ni kho bo'i mthar thug gi re ba'ang yin no/ /de lta na'ang / mig snga'i gnas bab da dung nyams dga' ba zhig tu mi mthong ste/ nga tsho mang shos shig gis bud med kyi‘‘gnad don’’de gnad don zhig tu brtsis nas bsgrub 'os pa'i 'gan ci yang mi sgrub par ma zad/ da dung gnas lugs kyi ldog phyogs su 'greng ste gtam cha ma mkhas hā/ haspyartsanākā sdinān /tu/shārdi dṛlnga wīngashā ṅgiṭā kyi l+līspya rtsa ṭāl+lī'o dukau06—1975)a me ri kha'i chab srid rig pa'i — 172 —

bud med rang da’cho rigs smra ba ni ci 'dra'i yid phangs ang / dper na/ dra ba'i gleng stegs kha shas steng bud med la gang 'dod du dma' 'bebs dang khyad gsod byed pa'i gtam gang mang spel ba dang / nis charjodang zho phen ha wuradusogs dar cha ru bsgrengs te/ de dag gis kyang bud med la‘‘glen ma’’dang‘‘nus med’’ces sdig dmod byas yod pa ma yin nam zhes ldog 'dri byed la/ rang re'i srol rgyun gyi lta bar yang‘‘bud med kyi kha la mi nyan pa’’ ‘‘bud med ni g.yo sgyu can yin’’zhes brjod yod ces srol rgyun gyi srol ngan pa'i kha gtad du mi 'greng bar de mkhregs 'dzin byed pa'i bsam tshul bdog mkhan ni/ tag tag gzhan ma yin par rang re'i shes yon can du rlom mkhan('di'i gras su grwa btsun yang 'dus)dang slob grwa chen mo pa kha shas yin pa shes dus/ rgyu 'bras blo mig gsal zhing /'gan 'khri'i 'du shes drag pa/ mi rigs 'di'i las dbang la mno bsam gtong mkhan yongs kyi sems pa phugs nas phugs su sdug srid do/ /go la hril po shes yon dus rabs su sleb kyin pa'i skabs 'dir/shes rig gis rang la drag chas spra ba dang / rang gi klad par byi dor brtsamahri chosaṭ+wāṃsmurno spyo/da blo sngu lasna rnasra 4ram̐ snushāsnabaṃ pawīlhas shād+dhini—1900)'jar man gyi mtshanagyinyidarikā pa ṭ+wāṃkhan/mkhanaX/ babyezloshā sh+laus wur+shatsho/ garnokli snyihā 'i0 d+dhalda6 be+e ṣā khrikhuṣāg/ṭ+wāṃ tshwadhī1788—1860)'jar man — mtshan —da —ga pa

rngaspro/ཿsa ::/ :sdo/byed rgyu ni ci 'dra'i gal che ba la/ de ltar na da gzod srol ngan rgyun 'byams su 'gro ba mtshams gcod thub pa dang / rang dbang dang /'dra mnyam/ mang gtso sogs kyi sa bon yang rang re'i gangs can yul du 'khrungs pa'i skal pa bzang po smin srid/ngas da bar du go ba'i ches snyan pa'i bud med kyi‘‘skad’’ni glu ma skad grags can tshe brtan sgrol ma'i ngag nas thon pa'i〈pe cing gser gyi ri〉min la/ bud med rtsom mkhan me sgron gyi smyug rtse nas 'bus pa'i〈nyi ma'i tsho ba〉〉dang bde skyid 'tsho'i〈snyan ngag pa la 'gyod pa med〉〉sogs kyang min par/ bod skad bod yig gi lam nas 'khrungs pa'i bod kyi bud med rang gi‘‘skad’’rnal ma ste rtsom mkhan 'jam dbyangs skyid kyi〈za ma mo'i skyid sdug gangs ma char〉yin no/ /2006lo'i zla12pa'i tshes19nyin zi ling du bris/

〈rang grol ba 'jug〉bkla sa rjes kyi tam/〈rang grol zhib 'jug〉bklags rjes kyi gtam/kho bos sku zhabs chos skyong lags kyis brtsams pa'i〈rang grol zhib 'jug〉ces pa'i ched rtsom 'di ma gleng gong du/ ‘‘rang grol zhib 'jug’’gi gnas bab thad nas lta tshul phran tsam brjod par 'dod do/ /sku zhabs don grub rgyal lam rang grol lags ni kun la ha cang gsal cha yod de/ mang shos kyis sku zhabs rang grol lags ni skyes chen dam pa zhig la ngos 'dzin pa ma zad/ snyan ngag gi brjod byar 'god pa dang / sku par shog thang du bzhengs nas sngas 'gram du 'gel ba/de min khong gi bcoms chos la bstod bsngags kyi me tog mtshams med du gtor bzhin 'dug yin na'ang sku zhabs rang grol khong nyid sku grongs nas lo ngo20lhag 'gor ba'i ring la rig tshan zhig tu phyes nas zhib 'jug gi ma lag tsam yang chags med pa ni gser gser 'dang du ma bzhag pa yin pas dngos gnas yid phangs pa zhig red/ dus mtshungs su sku zhabs khong gi grogs po dang yang na rang nyid the ba'i phyi rabs pa yongs kyi ngo tsha zhig tu'ang mi bgrang thabs med do/ /lhag par du nye ba'i char/ kho bos dra ba'i gleng stegs kha shas su gtam 'di 'dra mthong ste/

9bathas/casta/ :sdo/mdung na re/ don grub rgyal ni gzhan zhen ring lugs pa zhig dang lad zlos ring lugs pa zhig red/ kho rang gi pha mes dag gi lo rgyus kyi lam chen ring mo 'di'i thog 'tshar longs byung zhing 'dab lag rgyas rjes/ de rkang lam phra mo dang lam phran zhig tu brtsis nas bshig mgo brtsams/ khos lo rgyus kyi lam bu gzhan gyis bshig bzhin pa la rogs ram byas te bshigs pa ma zad/ kho dang 'dra bar de'i thog nas 'tshar longs byung zhing rang mgo thon pa'i rang rigs kyi klad med 'gar skul nas bshig tu bcug kho tshos lam bu de da dung mu mthud du bshig gin yod/ kho tshos rkang lam phra mo de bshig ma tshar na sems mi bde/kho tsho'i nang gi mi la las rkang lam phra mo bskyur nas gzhan gyi gzhung lam chen mo bsnyegs zin/ la las rkang lam phra mo dor nas me 'khor la bsdad zin/ la la ni gzhan gyis bzos zin pa'i myur mgyogs lam bur zhugs pa'i sta gon byed bzhin 'dug yin na yang kho tshos pha mes kyi rkang lam phra mo de bshig dgos don ci yin nam/dpyi sa dpal bzang na re/ kho shi song ba ni bod pa tshang la dgra bo zhig tshar bcad song ba red/mdung na re/ don grub rgyal ni bod kyi rig gnas la sdang sems ldan mkhan zhig dang / bod la rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam/ khe dbang bcas thob na mi dga' mkhan zhig yin pa kho'i bya spyod las mthong

〈rang grol ba 'ju 〉bkla sa rjes kyi tam/thub/mdung na re/ rig gnas gsar brje sogs lo ngo nyi shu lhag gi ring la bod mi rigs la rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam/ khe dbang bcas ma thob pa ma zad/ bod kyi chos srid yod tshad nyams rgud du btang ba red/ de'i rjes kyi srid jus yag tsam byung nas/ bod la rang nyid kyi dad pa byed dbang yod pa dang / yul srol goms gshis sogs rgyud 'dzin byed pa'i khe dbang thob pa dang / skad cha dang yi ge sogs rig gnas nyams pa slar gso byed thub pa tsam byung zhing / bde skyid kyi nyi ma cung tsam shar ba dang mnyam du kho der yid ma rangs nas de dag yod tshad la dgag gzhag byas pa red/ ltas ngan de'i ring nas bod mi rigs la kla klo dang mun 'thom/ rnying zhen/ blo gyong / mkhregs 'dzin/ rig pa rtul bo/ phyogs zhen/ rmongs dad/ blun rmongs bcas kyi ming ngan btags byung ba red/ nis cha yis〈tsa ra tshe'u se khras 'di bzhin smra〉zhes pa'i gzhung du‘‘khyod kyis dug sbrul re gnyis kyis dug lce g.yug nas g.yu 'brug sngon mo zhig bsad song zer pa go myong ngam’’zhes brjod pa nang bzhin/ de ni dpe mi srid pa zhig yin na'ang / ‘‘dug sbrul’’de dag gis rang gi smra lce gang 'dod du g.yugs pa mthong tshe/ kho bo ni skyo snang gi 'jig rten zhig tu ngang gis drangs shing / sad dka' ba'i mi rigs 'di dang /— 177 —

sprepa//sa/can/ ::/shes rmongs kyi spun zla 'di dag gi 'gal zlar langs 'dod kyi sems tshor zhig kyang skyes/ nga tshos lo rgyus kyi mi sna zhig la nam yang gzur gnas kyi lta bas mi mthong bar/ da dung nyes can zhig tu bgrang tshe mtha' mjug gi pham kha myong mkhan ni rang nyid yin te/ 'di ni lo rgyus kyis 'gro mi la bstsal pa'i nyams myong lags na/ kho bo ni nam yang kha rog ger gtan nas 'dug thabs med la/ mi de rigs la bzod sgom dang gu yangs kyang gtan nas gtong thabs bral/don grub rgyal khong nyid ni lo rgyus kyi skyo gar zhig tu ngos bzung chog tshe/ 'di lta bu'i skyo gar yang nas bskyar du mi 'khrab pa'i phyir du nga tshor nges shes zab mo 'di 'dra 'byung dgos te/ rig pa'i dpa' bo gang zhig pha gzhis dang nga tsho'i rmongs mun gyi khor yug 'di dang gtan du bral ba ni/ nga tsho mi re re'i gyong gud yin la nga tshos blun rmongs kyis bskrun pa'i mjug 'bras ya nga ba zhig kyang yin/ sku zhabs don grub rgyal khong gi rnam thar(〈rang grol zhib 'jug〉)la mjal rjes bdag gi sems la dran yong ba ni/ ‘‘ngas da lta nyi ma re re bzhin yid la dran pa dang rmi lam du rmi ba ni ji ltar dngos yod 'tsho ba dang 'thab rtsod rgyag rgyu de yin’’(pe lin si khe'i gsung)zhes pa 'di'o/ /'di ni skyes chen dag la thun mong du mnga' ba'i snying stobs shig kyang red/ don grub rgyal la mtshon na yang de las ma 'das/ kho'i blo gros kyi mda' mo de nam yang — 178 —

〈rang grol ba 'ju 〉bklags rjes kyi gtam/dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod gtad nas 'dug bla med kyi spobs pa 'di rigs kyis mi rigs kyi yar rgyas gong 'phel thad byas rjes mi dman pa bzhag yod pas/ rjes rabs pa zhig la mtshon na/ nga tshor don grub rgyal sogs kyi snying stobs 'di rgyud 'dzin dang dar spel byed pa'i 'os 'gan bdog pa red/nga tsho su la'ang gsal ba ni/ bod kyi‘‘mkhas pa’’tsho'i khrod du‘‘ge sar sgrung’’zhes pa'i rus pa skam po de mur mur nas bcud med ro med zhig tu gyur 'dug na'ang / mu mthud du der shi 'tham ro 'tham byas nas‘‘ched mkhas pa’’sogs thob thang chen po de rigs la brtson mkhan yod du srid mod/ nga tshor‘‘nyi 'od kyi zer ma’’'dren mkhan dang snying stobs kyi go cha sbran mkhan sku zhabs khong nyid rigs gzhung zhib 'jug gi stegs bur bskyal nas mi‘‘mi bu’’ru btang ste‘‘dpa' dar’’'then mkhan re gnyis tsam las med pa ni ci 'dra'i skyo zhing skyo ang /'di'i thad nas bshad na/ sku zhabs chos skyong lags kyis brtsams pa'i ched rtsom 'di ni yar sngon nang bzhin khong gi rnam thar mdor bsdus tsam dang / yang na bye brag gi brtsams chos re gnyis la dpyad brjod spel ba tsam ma yin par rtsom mkhan gyis rnam 'gyur drang mo'i sgo nas zhib 'jug byed pa'i dgos pa dang / zhib 'jug gi gnas bab/ brtsams chos khrod kyi skyon yon dang / bsam blo pa yin min/— 179 —

rngapa/lhas/can :sdo/khong gi snying stobs de ji lta bu zhig yin pa sogs phyogs mang po nas gleng 'dug pas/ ‘‘rang grol zhib 'jug’’'di rig tshan zhig tu 'gyur bar rmang gzhi cung brtan po btings pa ma zad/ sku zhabs rang grol khong nyid zhib 'jug gi stegs bu mthon po zhig gi steng du bskyal yod pa red/de la rtsom mkhan gyis kyang‘‘ ‘don grub rgyal zhib 'jug’ ces pa nas ‘rang grol zhib 'jug’tu gyur pa'i lo ngo gang mang gi ring ni/ na gzhon rtsom dga' zhig nor 'khrul dang mdzes sdug gi 'tshar longs byung ba'i go rim dang / dpa' gtam dang lag len gyi bar thag cig dka' tshegs sems kyis bgrod pa'i go rim zhig yin par ma zad/ bod yig deng rtsom zhib 'jug gi bye thang du snying stobs dang sngangs 'tshab kyis bskyod pa'i go rim zhig kyang ngo / /’’(〈sngon 'gro'i gtam〉du gsal)zhes rang grol zhib 'jug gi las la rang gi rngul khrag gi dka' ba bskyed pa'i myong snang dngos brjod 'dug da lta kho'i ngal ba'i 'bras rtags su〈rang grol zhib 'jug〉ces pa'i ched rtsom zhig klog mkhan yongs kyi mig gi dga' ston du bstar dus/ kho bos rang ngos nas yi rang 'bul zhing rten 'brel gyi kha btags gzhung 'di'i rtsom mkhan la phul ba lags/deng gi dus la na gzhon re 'gas/ don grub rgyal gyi brtsams chos gang mang zhig la sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang med tshul dang / lhag par du〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉ni gyer 'don snyan ngag cig las snyan ngag ngo ma zhig — 180 —

〈rang grol ba 'ju 〉bkla sa rjes kyi tam/tu bgrang thabs med tshul/ de da lta chu rka phra mo zhig tu gyur nas tshe srog gi bzhur rgyun chad la nye ba sogs lab te rang gis sgyu rtsal zhes par nges shes gsar pa zhig 'drongs yod tshul sogs smra dus/ kho bos brjod 'dod pa yang gzhung 'di'i rtsom mkhan gyis brjod pa nang bzhin/don grub rgyal gyi brtsams chos la dpyad pa gtong dus brtsams chos de dag lo rgyus spyi dang lhag par du rtsom 'byung lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i khrod du bzhag ste/ snang tshul tho re ba'i bar gseng nas thun mong du snang ba'i khyad chos shig phyogs sdom byed rgyu ni gtso bo zhig tu 'khums(shog ngos176par gsal)zhes pa ltar/ nga tshos mi su dang gang zhig la dpyad pa gtong dus khong nyid 'tsho gzhes kyi khor yug nges can de'i nang du bzhag ste dpyad pa btang na da gzod dpyad pa gnad du things shing /dgos med kyi rnyog dra dang rtsod gleng rnams kyang zhi bar 'gyur ba red/〈rang grol zhib 'jug〉ces par gtso bo sku zhabs rang grol lags kyi mi tshe rnam thar dang deng rabs rtsom rig gi ngos thad nas yin 'jog byas 'dug la/ de'i thad kyi mi 'dang sa dang zhan cha yang gleng 'dug pa red/ spyir na sku zhabs rang grol lags kyi mi tshe ni rtsom rig gi mi tshe tsam min te/ khong gis rigs gzhung zhib 'jug thad nas kyang grub 'bras 'bur thon blangs yod pa red/ khong gi zhib 'jug gi khyab khongs de lo rgyus dang / lo tsā/ gna' rabs rtsom rig sogs ha cang — 181 bhe

rngapa/spras/zu / :sdo/yangs pas/ sa bcad du bgar nas dpyad pa btang ba yin na nga tshos sngar bas kyang don grub rgyal ngo ma zhig shes rtogs 'byung thub mod/deb 'di'i byed pos rtsom rig brtsams chos sam sgyu rtsal brtsams chos gtso bor gleng don ni sku zhabs khong gi bsam blo dang snying stobs sogs mngon par mtshon zhing / nga tshor shan shugs zab mo thebs pa yang 'di'i ngos nas yin pas yin rgyu red/ des na nga tsho su yin kyang〈rang grol zhib 'jug〉la kha gsab byas te don grub rgyal‘‘cha tshang’’zhig bzhengs skrun byed pa'i dbang cha bdog pas tshad 'di las 'da' 'gongs byed thub na rab yin no/ /'di ni deb 'di'i byed pos bsam tshul yang yin par 'dod de/ khos‘‘don grub rgyal zhib 'jug la thog ma 'di nyid las mtha' ma med cing / khyab rgya'ang ji ltar bskyed na de tsam gyis yong bar snyam mo’’zhes brjod 'dugasku zhabs rang grol khong nyid rtsom rig gi bslu brid mngar mos bzi zhing khong gis rtsom rig ni lag cha lta bur ngos bzung ste/ des ni nga tsho'i srol rgyun gyi rngams mthug pa'i btsan rdzong gas gtor byed bsam pa ni 'phrul snang zhig min na'ang / smag rum gyis btum pa'i bod spyi tshogs la mtshon na de'i‘‘phog thug’’bzod ma thub par mdung kha yod tshad phyir khong nyid kyi steng du gtad pas tshe srog gi sgo nga rdo la brdab ste chag grum byung ba red/ khong gis kha chems yi ger‘‘ kho bos kyang rtsom — 182 —

〈rang grol ba 'ju 〉bkla sa rjes kyi tam/yig kha grangs longs pa zhig bris te kho pa tsho'i go rtogs de sad na snyam yang / pham kha ni rang gis nyo dgos byung rkyen/ ngas rang nyid kyi nyam chung ba'i tshe srog gis mchod sbyin byas te dung brda gsal bo zhig bsgrags pa tsam mo’’(shog ngos56par gsal)zhes gsal bor bkod 'dugached rtsom 'di sku zhabs rang grol gyi zhib 'jug 'bras rtags shig yin pa'i cha nas/ nga tshor sku zhabs khong nyid kyi mi tshe dang lhag don sgyu rtsal brtsams chos thad la nges shes gsar pa bskyed la/ dus mtshungs su deb 'dir 'khod pa'i brjod don kha shas ni‘‘gnad don rnying pa’’yin mod/ 'on kyang sngar yod rgyu cha bshu 'bri byas pa min par rang gi rigs pas yang yang brtag cing 'brel yod mi snar bcar ci thub kyis 'thus tshang dang legs sgrig gang legs byas yod pas/ deb 'di'i rin thang je mthor btang 'dugartsom rig gi ngos thad nas/ sku zhabs khong gi 'thus tshab rang bzhin gyi brtsams chos ni brtsams sgrung las〈〈sprul sku〉〉dang / lhug rtsom las〈〈rkang lam phra mo〉〉 snyan ngag las〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉bcas yin la/de'i khrod du'ang〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉〉lta bur mtshon na/ mi rabs shig gi sems kyi sgra dbyangs gsang mthor bsgrags pa yin la/ srol rgyun gyi kha gtad du bzhengs pa'i snyan ngag gi mchod rten gsar pa zhig kyang yin pas/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom 'byung lo rgyus steng gi bzo bkod ches ge 183 —

rngabathas/:ma/ ::rdomatho shos su ngos 'dzin pa red/ 〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉ni dngos gnas rbab chu zhig dang 'dra bar gzhon nu gang mang zhig gi ra ri dang mi gtsang ba rnams ring du khur cing/ lus sems dang bcas par byabs khrus thob te phyi gsal nang gsal gyi phugs bsam dang dmigs 'ben 'tshol bar phyar ba gru 'degs kyi nus pa thon pa ma zad/ des phyi rabs pa yongs la rang dbang gi smyug rtse bsam gzhig gi shog ngos su gar du bsgyur pa'i lam bu zhig kyang gsar du btod pa red/gzhung 'di'i byed pos‘‘snyan rtsom 'di'i rin thang snyan rtsom rang steng du med par de las brgal 'dug pa zhig ste/ 'dam bzo 'dam las grub rung 'dam du mi lta ba'i dpe bzhin/ de ni lta grub kyi rgya las brgal ba'i rang gshis kyi bcings 'grol thengs gcig red ces pa'am/yang na phyi'i rnam pa las brtsams te shugs su gab cing sbas pa'i 'gyur med rtag brtan gyi sgrig srol gang zhig la 'phangs pa'i gtor brlag gi mda' mo zhig ’’(shog ngos237par gsal)zhes par kho bo yang 'thad do/ /de min/ 〈rkang lam phra mo〉zhes par don grub rgyal gyi sngon thon bsam blo dang gsar gtod kyi snying stobs sogs gcig bsdus kyis mtshon 'dug la/ kho'i brtsams chos khag las 'bur du thon cing go sa gal chen zin yod pas rtsom mkhan gyis kyang 'dir 'bab cing 'os pa'i gdeng 'jog mthon po gnang 'dug— 184 —

〈rang grol ba 'ju 〉bklags rjes kyi gtam/rtsom mkhan gyis‘‘da snga brgya cha'i dgu bcu'i yan ni bstod pa kho nar snang ste/ don du lo rgyus kyi go gnas sprad zin pa las/ dus kyi zhan cha sogs 'don thub kyi med/ dpyad brjod pas brtsams chos klog 'don dang rol myong byed pa'i gnas skabs su/ der bstan gyi brjod bya gang rung ji ma ji bzhin gyis bskyar dpar 'debs pa ma yin te/ brtsams chos de nyid kyis rang bzhin shugs su bskyur pa'i bar glags nas/ dpyad brjod pas rang rang gi blo gros kyi rtsal la brten te sngog 'don bya yul ci rigs mchis’’(shog ngos39par gsal)zhes da snga yan chod kyi dpyad 'bras la yid mi tshim zhing mi 'thad pa'i rnam 'gyur kyang bstan 'dug 〈sprul sku〉gtsos pa'i brtsams sgrung skor gyi sa bcad gsum du dbye nas zhib mo rnam 'thag cig byas 'dug cing /gdeng 'jog gi zhor du bstod pa'i dbyings las mar phab ste de dag gi skyon cha yang bgrang 'dug ste/ 'di ni mthong sne gsar pa zhig tu 'dod la kho bo spro ba rgyas pa'i gnad cig kyang ngo / /khong gi brtsams sgrung gi skyon cha bshad pa la sa bcad lnga par/brtsams sgrung gis mi sna de dag lha 'dre'i khams nas 'jig rten mi yul la drangs te mi'i rang zhen dang rang dbang gi go gnas cung tsam po sprad pa las/ mi sna de dag gson shugs dang skye stobs 'bar ba'i‘‘'tsho ba'i bdag po’’zhig tu gyur med pa dang / brtsams sgrung gis byung rim ge 185 —

rdopa/thas/zudzi :sdo/sogs gtsigs su bzung drags pas spyir btang mi sna de nyid bzhengs skrun byas pa dpe gzhi can gyi tshad la bsleb med pa/ brtsams sgrung de dag ther 'don gyi ched du ther 'don byed pa las sgyu rtsal gyi cha la dang dod chen po byas med pa/ mi sna dag la mtshon na gshis ka'i steng nas bzang ngan gnyis kyi mtha' ru lhung ste/ bzang ba bzang sha stag dang ngan pa ngan sha stag tu byas pa mang po mthong rgyu yod pa/ mi sna rang la mi mdza' ba'i skad cha shod pa sogs kyi snang tshul rgyun du 'byung ba/ khor yug zhib 'bri'i cha nas mtshams mtshams su dgos med don gzhan dang 'brel med gtos che ba'i snang ba'ang sbyin par byed pa sogs sna sgo mang po nas rgyu mtshan lung dang bcas pa gsal kha chod pa zhig bkod 'dugam zad/ 〈don grub rgyal bsam blo pa yin min gyi skor〉zhes par yang dngos shugs gang rung du dgag sgrub kyi lta tshul bton cing / skyon skyon du mthong ba ni mdor na sku zhabs‘‘khong nyid kyi zhal ras ji bzhin pa’’de gsal bor mtshon par byas pa yin pas/ skyon sngog pa de yang rang grol zhib 'jug gi thabs shes bzang bo zhig dang / nga tsho sku zhabs khong nyid la gcar thabs legs shos shig yin/ de min lo rgyus la phyir rtog drang gzhag byed pa/ zhib 'jug rigs lam sngar las je gsal dang / kha phyogs sngar las je yangs su 'gro bar yang phan thogs che'o/ /— 186 —

〈rang grol ba 'ju 〉bkla sa rjes kyi tam/gzhan yang nga rang gi bsam tshul la/ 〈don grub rgyal gyi snying stobs〉zhes pa'i le'u 'di ni rtsom mkhan gyis‘‘dka' tshegs sems kyis btus pa'i rde'u yin pa’’dang / gzhung hril bo'i‘‘mtho rlabs’’su nges na'ang / ‘‘rang rkya 'pher ba'i zhib 'jug 'bras rtags’’shig gi tshad nas bshad na/ le'u 'dir le'u sngon ma dag las‘‘zhun thar chod drags pa'am’’'phros don rgya bskyed drags pas/ gzhung hril bo cung do mi mnyam pa dang / yang na don grub rgyal ngo ma de cung rgyang ring sar bskyal 'dug pa'i nyams snang yang sbyin/ nga tshos don grub rgyal ngo ma zhig bzhengs skrun byed na/ ‘‘rang grol’’zhes pa'i mthon po khri 'di rkang stegs byas nas rgyang ring gi gnam mthar cer pa ma yin la/ mthong thos myong gsum yod tshad gzhi gcig tu spungs nas khri 'dir mi 'os pa'i rgyan cha btsan gyis 'dogs pa yang ma yin par/ phyir 'khor zhing dma' sar babs nas gleng gzhir bkod pa'i rang grol 'tshol rtog byed pa de gtso bo yin pas/ 'di'i thad nas rtsom mkhan gyis rang grol zhib 'jug gi‘‘rang grol’’'di rang gi‘‘chu tshad’’dril bsgrags byed pa'i stegs bu lta bu zhig tu bsgyur 'dug snyam pa'i yid phangs pa'i cha'ang re gnyis yod do/ /gang ltar/ ‘‘rang grol’’zhes pa'i tsha tsha 'ur 'ur du gyur pa'i gleng gzhi 'di da lta‘‘mi’’ru btang ste/ dpyod shes kyi sgo nas gdeng 'jog dang dgag sgrub byed pa ni nga tsho'i zhib 'jug gi chu tshad gsar pa — 187 —

rngab/sa/zu / ::rdozhig tu bslebs pa'i mtshon rtags yin cing / nga tsho'i rigs gzhung zhib 'jug gi kha phyogs yang dag gi lam du bskyod pa'i sta gon yin la/da dung tshad nges can zhig nas bshad na/ deb 'dir 'khod pa'i lta tshul mang shos shig ni thog mar bton pa yin 'dug la/ sku zhabs rang grol gleng ba'i zhor du dus rabs sngon ma'i nang gi deng rabs rtsom rig gi lo rgyus sam gsar rtsom spyi la bkod pa'i sdom tshig lta bur yang mthong bas/ rabs de'i rtsom mkhan yongs kyi blo kha dang gnas bab thad la‘‘tshang rtsis’’zhib mo zhig brgyab 'dug ces brjod kyang 'gal ba med pas/zur 'di nas bltas tshe deb 'di'i brtsegs rim rang bzhin gyi zab tshad kyang rtogs la/ sgog shun bzhin shun pa re re ltar bshus te rtsom mkhan gyi gzhung lugs kyi blo sbyong dang lta ba'i nang snying hril bo mthong lam du 'char 'ongs so/ /

dpe klo zin bris zin zi /dpe klog zin bris sna zin spu zin/bsam pa'i longs spyod ni dngos po'i longs spyod brgya phrag las kyang lhag go/da ho zhungaspre/dpe cha klog pa de ni 'jig rten 'dir ches spro skyid ldan pa'i las ka zhig go zhe na dpe cha pa rnal ma zhig gis khas len mod/ gzhan rnams kyis ni de la gtan nas bden kha ster mi srid la don du yang phyogs ris kyi bshad yan zhig las ma 'das so/ /'on kyang dpe cha bklags pa des bsam pa'i longs spyod gya nom pa zhig sbyin srid pa gna' deng krung phyi'i mkhas pa dag gi gsung sgros sam don dngos kyis nga tshor ra sprad zin pas/ gsham nas rang gi dpe klog nyams myong dang sbrags te myong tshor rags tsam brjod par bya'o/ /〈war ton mtshe'u〉〉(〈ṣ+pepoṣ+ṭhalo〉)zhes pa'i rgya 'gyur ma'i deb de ni kho bos de snga rgya nag gi snyan ngag pa grags chen he tsiduyi rnam thar zhig la lta skabs he tsis rang srog gcod dus lcags lam gyi 'gram du dpe cha sogs l+liduganyetsi/ (oṃcha 1964—1989)krung go'i deng rabs kyi snyan ngag mkhan/ brtsams chosasgyuhe tsi'i snyan ngag— 189 —

rngarnga zlas/ji / ::shebazhi legs par thang la bshams yod par smra la/ de'i khrod kyi deb cig ni tag tag la〈war ton mtshe'u〉zhes pa'i deb de yin par bshad 'dugahe tsi'i snyan ngag la dga' ba rkyen byas te khong gis bklags myong ba'i deb dag kyang klog thub na snyam nas phyogs yar mar la yun ring bor btsal pa yin/ stabs legs pa zhig la na ning gi lugs rnying lo gsar bsleb grabs yod dus zi ling gi dpe khang zhig tu 'bri chu rig rtsal dpe skrun khang gis2005lo'i zla5par bskrun pa'i rgyab shog ljang gu can gyi deb de lag son byung /〈war ton mtshe'u〉ni a ri'i rtsom mkhan grags chen so re'uduyis brtsams pa yin la/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i a ri'i rtsom rig gam a ri'i rig gnas skor gleng dus so re'u ni g.yol thabs med pa'i mi sna gal chen zhig ste/ kho'i rang nyid la brtsi 'jog byed pa dang rang kha rang gso'i snying stobs des a ri pa rnams la bag chags zab mo bzhag pas mi tshad a ri'i rig gnas kyi srog shing lta bur grub 'dug 〈war ton mtshe'u〉ni khong gi brtsams chos gal chen zhig yin pa'i cha nas khong gi lta ba dang bsam blo sogs kyang gsal bor mtshon yod de/ nyin tho'i rnam pas grub pa'i deb de war ton mtshe'u'i 'gram du rang nyid kyi rtsol brtse 'ahār ṭ+wāṃ spyos pa/ smra sgokau soyā sahā baṃkaulnga5 ṣ+ṭhaska 1817—1862)a ri'i rtsom mkhan/ brtsams chos〈spyi dmangs kyis — 190 —

dpe klo zin bris zin zin/ba la brten nas 'tsho ba rol pa'i shes yon can zhig gi mi tshe'i brgyud rim tsam yig ngor phab pa yin mod/ 'on kyang spyir btang gi nyin tho tsam las ring du 'gongs te/ bklags pa'i tshe na/ rang byung khams chen mo dang rang dbang / phugs bsam sogs gzhi gcig tu sbrel te mi ni 'jig rten gyi lte bar ngos 'dzin pa'i lta bar dgag pa dang rang byung gi mdzes pa la bstod pa'i mthe bong bsgrengs yod par ma zad/ mi dang rang byung khams mnyam gnas dang gcig la gcig brten gyi 'brel ba dam pa sogs sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pas slong skrun byas yod pas/ rtsom pa po khong nyid ni skye khams rig pa smra ba zhig dang 'dra la/ rang byung tshan rig zhib 'jug mkhan zhig dang yang mtshungs/ de min khong gi 'tsho ba dang brtsams chos khrod nas nga tshos 'char yan ring lugs pa zhig gis ma yum pha gzhis la bcangs pa'i brtse sems rnal ma dang rang dbang brtson len byed pa'i sems shugs kyang zhar du rtogs thub/ khong gis‘‘nga la rang nyid kyi nyi ma dang zla ba/ skar ma bcas yod la/ da dung rang nyid la dbang ba'i 'jig rten chung chung zhig kyang yod’’ces brjod yod la don du'ang de lta yin 'dug go/mdor na/ deb de las rang bkur 'du shes gong du 'phel ba dang dus bzhi'i 'gyur bag gnyis zung du 'brel bas rtsom mkhan gyi sems la dag gtsang thengs shig thob pa dang / de min nga tshor rang sdi 191 —

rngardigaḥs/zu / ::/steng du gnas pa'i gnad don gyi 'byung rtsa mang po zhig rtogs su 'jug la ma 'ongs pa'i re ba'ang mthong thub pas/ deb kyi mdun shog tu‘‘rang byung khams chen mo mngon par gsal ba'i me long dang / 'gro mi spyi'i sems pa mtshon pa'i deb mchog’’ces bsngags pa brjod yod pa'ang don dang mthun par sems/nye ba'i lo 'di dag gi ring la/ snod bcud do mi snyoms pa dang yul gru mang bo bye thang can du 'gyur ba/ rang byung yul ljongs mang bo rmeg med du gtong bzhin pa'i skya zad sngo gtugs kyi dus skabs shig dang khel 'dug pas/ nga tshos rang sems rnal du phab nas gong gi deb der zhib lta thengs shig bgyi thub tshe phan pa lhag tu che snyam pa'i bsam tshul dang bcas kun la 'os sbyor byas pa yin/deb gzhan zhig ni rgya nag gi rtsom rig 'bum rams pa li can cunadugyis brtsams pa'i rtsom rig dpyad brjod dang rtsom rig gzhung lugs skor gyi phyogs bsgrigs kyi deb cig ste/ kha byang la〈dus rabs dang rtsom rig gi dgra bo〉(〈spratshikrer+sā'i༈༈shutshi7rki〉)zhes zer la/ deb de ni krung go bzo pa'i dpe skrun khang gis2004lo'i zla8par par du bskrun pa red/ deb de bklags pas kho bor myong tshor ches zab mo zhig byin rtsom lha datrī d+dhinā snanā/sa kyi sdizhwa n+dhaḍāgashā9 shāṭaṃrgo)krung go'i deng rabs kyi rtsom rig dpyad brjod mkhan/ brtsams chos— 192 —

dpe klo zin bris zi zi /pa ni/ rtsom rig dpyad brjod pa zhig yin na rig gnas shes bya'i rmang gzhi mthug po zhig yod pas mi chog da dung dgag sgrub kyi snying stobs btsan po zhig dang dpa' spobs chen po zhig mnga' dgos la/ dkyel yangs kyi blo khog yangs mo zhig kyang ci nas 'dzoms dgos pa de'o/ /khong gis krung go'i deng rabs rtsom stegs steng gi rtsom mkhan skad grags can skor zhig gi brtsams chos la dge rgan gyis slob ma'i sbyangs rtsom dag bcos byed pa nang bzhin dpyod shes kyi sgo nas shig dang sro mang btsal btsal byas te skyon brjod dang dag bcos byas yod mod/ de ni rtsom la dmigs pa las mi la dmigs pa ma yin pas mi gzhir dma' 'beb dang khyad gsod sogs kyi dri mas gos yod pa ma red/ khong gis rtsom mkhan de dag gi brtsams chos khrod kyi mi 'dang sa dang mi 'grig sa nan gyis bton pa'i dus mtshungs su/ da dung re ba dang lta tshul ci yod gsong bor brjod yod pas bklags pa'i tshe na rtsom rig gi rmang gzhi'i shes bya yin na'ang 'dra/ rtsom rig la bzung ba'i lta tshul yin na'ang 'dra/gsar ba gsar rkyang gi myong ba dang 'thob bya zhig sbyin pa las gzhan/rtsom la 'jug mkhan dang klog pa po yongs kyi blo sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig lta bur yang mthong bas dngos gnas bklags nas mi ngoms pa zheg red/li can cun khong nyid kyis ches gu yangs gtong thabs bral ba ni rig gnas kyi gad snyigs su bgrang ba'i sgyid lug gi rtsom yig dang kun — 193 —

2pa/ཿsa/ca / :sdo/spyod mi legs pa'i cha de red la/ khong gis rtsom mkhan yongs la 'bod skul btang ste rang rang gi rnam shes la tsha 'dri gtong ba dang / mang tshogs kyi bde sdug mngon par mtshon pa'i brtsams chos 'bri bar re ltos bcangs 'dug de dag khong gi〈brtsams sgrung gi sgrig lam〉(〈7/skukālkotshi0k+ṣa〉)dang〈rtsom mkhan gyi rnam 'gyur〉(〈oṃྈtshiṣ+yoṣ+ṭha〉)〈nga rgyal dang mun 'thom gyi rtsom 'bri〉〉(〈rdoṣ+ṭha’roṭhalko7zi.oṃ〉)sogs las gsal bor bstan 'dug deng gi bstod na dga' ba dang smad na mi dga' ba'i rtsom rig dpyad brjod kyi dza drag gi kha dbugs khrod du khong gi drang bden srung ba'i rgyu 'bras blo mig dang 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes drag po des rang re'i yag thog yag rtseg gi dpyad brjod pa'i sde la dpe ston gyi nus pa gal chen zhig 'don sprod byed thub pa gdon mi za'o/ /de yang sngon chad slob gnyer byed skabs rgya nag gi mkhas pa'am dpe skrun tshong pa ho zhung h+pherjoming gzhan la sa'e nyi ya(྾71)dang tshang lang(chaskyogle)du 'bod pas bsgrigs mdzad pa'i〈rtswa thang tsho ba〉(〈sgokhāsgocho〉)zhes pa'i dpe tshogs deb bdun gyi bdag nyid can zhig dang mjal ba de ni dpe klog 'grul bzhud khrod ches brjed du med pa zhig red/ de'i khrod kyi brtsams chos mang bo zhig gis kho bor da dung yang yid 'gul dpe skruldi malam̐zhu/nganā/rtsamashāspya ༈slo hu kau shāwī snyepre sgyudā dz+nyānā r+sha spur+sha n+dhosngu snadhi ༵ dādru ga/ rtsom rig dbyad brjod mkhan/— 194 —

dpe klo zin bris zin zin/thebs shing rdzogs mtha' med pa'i bsam pa'i longs spyod sbyin bzhin yod do/ / yin na'ang thengs 'dir gleng bar bya ba ni yu/na nan mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis2004lo'i zla3par par du bskrun cing ho zhung h+phe sku dngos kyis brtsams pa'i dpe deb gzhan zhig ste/ deb ming la〈ya hu dā pa'i khyim tshang slob gso'i shes rab〉(〈7oṃd+ku7tshistsa 〉)zhes pa de'o/ /mi rigs gang dang gang yin kyang khyim tshang slob gso nges par gtso bor 'dzin dgos te/ rgyu mtshan ni khyim tshang slob gso de mi rigs shig dar rgyas su gtong ba dang spyi dmangs kyi 'byung spus khyon yongs nas mthor 'degs 'byung ba bcas la 'brel ba dam po yod pas red/ na ning do tshigs rang re bod pa rnams kyis kyang khyim tshang slob gso de don chen zhig tu bzung nas mthong chen byed bzhin pa ni dngos gnas dga' 'os pa zhig red/ nga tshor dpal yon ldan zhing shes yon dar ba'i snga ltas shig kyang yin tshod 'dug der gcan rong bstan 'dzin lags kyis‘‘khyim tshang slob gso bzang bo zhig bsgrub rgyu ni byis pa 'jon thang can zhig skyed sring byed pa'i thabs jus nus ldan nyag cig yin pas/khyim tshang slob gsos byis pa'i slob gso la kha phyogs rang bzhin dang thag gcod rang bzhin gyi shan shugs thebs bzhin pa red’’ces brjod yo/da pa de ni dngos gnas gnad dam par mthong / de min sku zhabs zhogs — 195 —

9pa/spras/zu / :sdo/dung sogs kyis khyim tshang slob gso'i skor gyi 'bol rtsom mang du spel nas der gtsigs 'dzin byed dgos pa'i 'bod skul btang 'dug deb der ya hu dā pa'i khyim tshang slob gso'i byed thabs sogs zhib tu bkral nas gsal ston byas yod pa red/ kun la gsal cha yod pa ltar ya hu dā pa ni 'dzam gling mi rigs mang bo'i khrod shes rab kyis phyug cing blo rig rno ba'i mi rigs shig yin la/ kho tsho'i thun mong ma yin pa'i slob gso'i shes rab kyis 'dzam gling rang bzhin gyi mkhas pa chen mo dang /tshong pa chen mo/ rtsom mkhan chen mo sogs 'gro mi'i nyi ma lta bu'i rlabs chen gyi skyes bu gang mang skyed sring byas pa red/deb der tshe srog slob gso dang / mdzes dpyod slob gso/ spyi dmangs slob gso sogs rigs mang du bkar nas bstan 'dug cing gson nyams ldan pa'i tshig gi srad bur brgyus te slob gso'i phan yon dang byed nus zhib tu bkod 'dug deb de bklags pa'i tshe na da lta rgyug che ba'i khyim tshang slob gso'i skor gyi dpe deb gzhan ltar thabs rtsal kho na tsam brjod pa ma yin par/ tshe srog gi rin thang dang kun spyod kyi lta ba sogs gtam rgyud kha mtshar sogs la sbyar yod pas/ bklags pa'i tshe na go bde ba dang klog spro ba sogs kyi khyad chos ldan la nga tsho'i tshe srog gi 'tsho bcud lta bur yang 'gyur srid snyam mo/ /2001lor slob mthar phyin ma thag pa'i dus skabs shig gi nang du/— 196 —

dpe klog zin bris zin zin/kho bos deng rabs brtsams sgrung skor zhig skom pas chu 'dod ltar bklags shing / stes dbang gis yus hwaduzhes pa'i rtsom mkhan zhig gi rtsom dang phrad pa de nga la mtshon na zhing par lo legs smin pa nang bzhi/na dga' ba zad mi shes pa 'phel/ khong gi brtsams chos las thengs dang por mjal ba ni〈bud med kyi rgyal kha〉(〈ṭ+wāṃrkitshi༅lkokye〉)zhes pa'i sgrung thung zhig yin la/ sgrung thung de'i byung rim thung ngu dang spros brjod kyi mdzes pas bdag gi yid sems cig car du phrogs song / de nas bzung /dpe tshong khang re re'i dpe sgrom nas yus hwa zhes pa'i ming de btsal ba na/dka' las chen po myong ma dgos par khong gi〈'tsho bzhin pa〉(〈ṣ+ṭha.oṃ〉)zhes pa'i sgrung ring zhig dang phrad cing / de'i rjes〈shis san kon gyis khrag btsongs pa'i zin tho〉(〈kāñtsaphyoṭ+wāṣātshokhā+ekā2〉)dang〈char zim khrod kyi 'bod pa〉(〈ṣ+ṭhaphremazlatsho0chaphro〉)sogs 'phro rim 'phror bklags/ nye char brtsams grub byung ba'i sgrung ring〈spun mched〉(〈2lko〉)kyis kho bor bzhag pa'i bag chags de 'dra bzang rgyu med na'ang / 〈'tsho bzhin pa〉〉zhes pa'i sgrung ring de ni mu tig zhig dang 'dra bar da dung yang kho bo'i dran pa'i gtsang ngogs su 'od lam mer 'tsher zhing mchis/〈〈'tsho bzhin pa〉zhes pa'i sgrung ring de da lta a ri dang h+pha ran si/'dug() yu sa hwa/ (3stsa 1963—)krung go'i na gzhon brtsams sgrung mkhan/ brtsams chos〈'tsho bcin pa〉sogs

/dri ཿsa/zum/ ::rdodabyi tha li sogs rgyal khab mang po'i yig rigs su bsgyur yod la/ rang rgyal du glog brnyan la 'bebs skrun yang byas yod zer mod bltas ma myong / rgya nag gi rtsom rig dpyad brjod pa mang po zhig gis de ni krung go'i rtsom rig gi tog lta bur bgrangs shing / yus hwa khong nyid kyang no pel rtsom rig bya dga' dang bar thag ha cang nye tshul gleng / de ni tshod dpag gam re ba tsam yin kyang chog mod/ gang ltar yus hwa khong nyid la gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang ste krung go'i deng rabs rtsom rig steng gi lha sgrung lta bu'i mi snar bzhengs pa ni don dngos so/ /yin na'ang der mi 'thad pa'i lta tshul 'don mkhan med pa'ang ma yin te/ dper na/ rgya nag gi na gzhon rtsom rig dpyad brjod mkhan wang pin pinadulags kyis kha byang la〈yus hwa'i smyo gtam〉zhes pa spel te dgag gzhag nan mo spras 'dug〈'tsho bzhin pa〉yi gtam rgyud hril bo tshig gcig gis mtshon dgos tshe/ rgyan po 'gyed mkhan zhig gi mi tshe'i skyo gar zhig go/brtsams sgrung de las kun spyod steng gi mdzes pa dang gdung sems kyi stobs chen pos mi sems kyi skyug mer ba'i ngos dag bsnub par byed cing / yid kyi bar snang hril bor‘‘skyo snang gis zin pa'i bde tshor’’brtsamaṭā chosalhadūtā t+na/ sming/ ba(sgrophroṃ yam̐g1962—)krung go'i na gzhon rtsom mkhan/ rtsom rig dpyad brjod mkhan/— 198 —

dpe klo zin bris zin zin/zhig kyang sbyin par byed/ kun spyod kyi gnad don de mi chos kyi rim pa las brgal pa dang / mtshan nyid rig pa dang tha na lha chos rig pa'i khyab khongs nang du bsrings yod par snyam la/ de ni kun gyis khong gi brtsams chos der bstod pa'i me tog gtor pa'i rgyu mtshan yang yin par 'dod do/ /〈'tsho bzhin pa〉yis mtshon pa ni phyug po nas dbul por gyur pa'am yod pa thams cad med par gyur pa dang / de nas rgas shing 'khogs pa dang / de nas phyi mar 'grims pa/ mthar gtugs na tshe srog rang steng gi sdig nyes dang 'gyod bshags kyi brgyud rim ring mo ste brtsams sgrung khrod kyi mi sna gtso bo'i bde sdug(don du dka' tshegs kyi lo zla)yod tshad skyo gar gyi rnam pas bsdus 'dug la/ yul skad ltar na mi las ngan zer ba ni dngos gnas kho red ang snyam 'ong ba'i mod la/klog pa po'i sems rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i brtse ba'i lo 'dab de gdung sems kyi rlung bus g.yo bar byed pas/ brtsams sgrung de nga tsho'i gtam rgyud byung rim sgrig bzo dang thabs rtsal la 'bad ci thub byed pa'i rtsom pa po dag gi zur ltar rung ngo / /rtsom rig la 'jug mkhan dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan zhig la mtshon na/ rtsom 'byung lo rgyus nges par klog dgos la shes kyang shes dgos/ dmigs yul des sne drangasardo te a rir bzhugs pa'i rgya nag gi

dpe klo zin bris zin zi /bsgribs pa'am khral khrul du bzos yod pa mi 'dug de bas bklags pa'i tshe na 'das pa'i rtsom rig gi dge skyon gsal bor bstan cing ma 'ongs pa'i rtsom rig gi 'grul bzhud ring mo'i khrod gang ni gzab bya dang gang ni rgyun 'dzin byed dgos par gdeng tshod rnyed thub pa dang / rtsom pa po dang klog pa por skul khrid lta bu'i nus pa yang thon yod/thengs 'dir 'os sbyor ram myong tshor tsam spel 'dod kyi deb ches rjes ma ni rgya nag gi na gzhon shes yon can wang kha'e lingadudu 'bod pa'i dpe klog zin bris deb〈〈rtul phod can gyi bsam pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa〉(〈yam̐jolozalkotshiṣeno〉)zhes pa de yin la/ deb de ni kho bo'i grogs po zhig gis 'os sbyor byas pa yin te/ nyos nas bklags pa na rang la phan chen po thogs song snyam pa'i dga' tshor skyes myong / rgyab shog kha dog nag po dang ser pos grub pa'i deb de ni krung go bzo pa'i dpe skrun khang gis2000lo'i zla9par par du bskrun pa zhig ste/ kha byang gtso bo'i 'gram du‘‘bdag gis brjed du med pa'i dpe klog 'grul bzhud’’ces kha byang phal ba zhig kyang bkod 'dug la/ g.yon phyogs kyi zur zhig tu‘‘rtul phod can rnams bdag dang lhan du nang du skyo da rogs/ spobs med gnyom chung rnams snga mor ring du 'gye rogs’’zhes bris yod/brtsamaṭā chosawadṛkliṭā spyi d+nghang/ skyoṣ+ṭṛ〉〈ldu masbyalha69—)krung go'i na gzhon rtsom mkhan dang / rtsom rig dpyad brjod mkhan/

rngabathagasbub khab 2dodeb de'i nang du 'dzam gling gi skar chen lta bu'i rtsom mkhan skor zhig gi brtsams chos dang mdzad pa zhib mo sgos ngo sprod byas 'dug pa las gzhan/rang gi myong ba dang dran tshul rnams lhugs por brjod 'dug de las nga tshos mkhas chen de dag gi drang bden dang rgyu 'bras brtsi ba'i rin chen gser gyi mi gzhi dang bsam blo mngon par mthong zhing / khong tsho'i nang bsam pa'i 'jig rten la'ang myul zhib thengs shig bgyid thub pas dngos gnas bsam pa'i longs spyod gya nom pa zhig 'don sprod byed thub pas kun gyis kyang bklag thub pa zhig byung na snyam mo/ /gong gi dpe deb de dag ni kho bos na ning do tshigs bklags pa'i dpe deb khrod kyi re 'ga'i myong tshor ram lta tshul phran tsam yin la/dpe deb de dag gi dpe skrun khang dang par skrun lo zla sogs 'god don ni/ dpe klog la spro ba'i grogs po tsho'i khrod bklags ma myong mkhan yod na klog rin yod par sems pa'i kun slong gis bskul pa yin gyi/ ci zhig ngom so byed pa'am ma shes shes khul byas pa gtan nas min no/ /

mtho 'bring slob ma la springs pa'i 'phrin lan/mtho 'bring slob ma zhig la springs pa'i 'phrin lan/slob grogs྾ ྾ ྾ ྾lags/bde mo yin nam/khyed kyi 'phrin yig kho bo'i lag tu 'byor dus ni zla3pa'i tshes21nyin gyi snga dro yin/ nga tsho ni cha med rgyus med yin na'ang 'phrin yig gi kha phyes nas tshar gcig bklags rjes kho bor sngar med kyi spro snang zhig rgyas byung / de ni khyed kyis kho bo bstod pa'i dbyings su spur bas ma yin par/ rang nyid kyis bris pa'i snyan ngag gis gzhan la mnyam 'ur bslangs shing da dung 'phrin yig gi lam nas rgyab skyor dang skul 'ded byed na/ de ni dga' 'os pa'i don bya zhig ci la min/ lhag par du dra ba dang kha par sogs deng rabs cha 'phrin gyi gom 'gros glog bzhin 'khyug pa'i dus da lta sems pa rnal la phab nas 'phrin yig cig klog rgyu ni longs spyod cig kyang yin te/ ma mtha' yang kho bos 'di ltar bsams/lo ngo bcu lhag gi sngon gyi slob 'bring gi dus skabs su kho bos kyang khyed kyis slob gnyer byed sa'i slob grwa de'i gru ga gang rung du bye'u bzhin rig pa'i rgum bu rgum bzhin rmi lam sna tshogs rmis myong / da lta — 203 —

rngarnga pes/:ma/ :sdo/bsams na rmi lam gang mang zhig dus kyi 'gros dang bstun nas chu kha'i lba ba bzhin yal ba'am mngon du 'gyur ma thub kyang de ni ci 'dra'i spro ༄skyid kyis khengs pa'i lo zla zhig ang / bdag gi drin can dge rgan dang slob grogs dam pa de dag kho bo'i phyir dran gyi klong na da dung yang mu tig rdog po re re dang 'dra bar 'od du 'tsher zhing gda' ste/ gsog gsob dang tshul 'chos kyis ma bslad pa'i sems pa dang / g.yo dang sgyu mas ma zin pa'i mi gshis/ chu bo bzhin lhung lhung bzhur ba'i dgod sgra/me tog bzhin lham mer bzhad pa'i 'dzum mdangs/ yod tshad kyi yod tshad ni de 'dra'i lhad med rnam dag gi zhing khams shig na 'jam thing nger dang lhod sha ler/ kho bo'i mi tshe gcig gi dran shing du gyur yodakhyed kyi re ba ltar bdag gi myong goms dang gsar rtsom thad kyi bsam tshul phran tsam brjod dgos tshe/ ji ltar gang nas 'go rtsom dgos pa'ang mi shes la/ lhag par du bsam tshul gang zhig yi ger bkod nas khyed dang bgro gleng byed bsam tshe gleng rin yod pa'ang cang mi 'dug ste/ kho bor grub 'bras kyis stong bas na ngom ri ba 'di'o zhes ston rgyu yod pa zhig ci yang med pas/ dngos gnas mi shes shes mdog dang kha chen tshig chen smra ba'i spobs pa ye nas med la/ yod mdog kha bo byed snying med do/ /khyed kyi 'phrin yig la bltas pas lhag tu kho bor — 204 —
