mtho 'bring slob ma la springs pa'i 'phrin lan/'di 'dra'i tshor ba zhig ngang ngam shugs kyis byin 'ongs/drang mor bshad na/ nga rang khyed dang bsdur thabs med de/mtho 'bring skabs su gzhan la kha ngo sems ngo 'phrod pa'i 'phrin yig legs po zhig kyang 'bri mi shes pa ma zad/ rtsom thung cha re rdog re bris pa'ang phyir lta byed rin med pa dag dag yin pa dang / slob ma bzang po zhig yin min yang ha cang bshad dka' ba'i tshod du gda'/ yin na'ang de dus kho bo mtsho lho khul bod yig slob 'bring du yod pas/chab cha'i rtsom rig gi kha dbugs 'khrug cha dod cing smyu gu lag tu 'chang mkhan mang shos kyis snyan ngag zer bzhin‘‘tshig grub’’sna tshogs bzo bar mgo 'khor 'dug kho bo'ang rlabs rgyun drag po de'i khrod du 'thim zhing rtsom rig gi bslu brid mngar mo ma bzod par dus tshod gang mang zhig a gsar tsha bo'i sgo nas de'i don du‘‘chud zos’’su btang myong /phyis su snyan ngag gi gras su tshud min gyi snyan ngag 'bri deb kha shas longs pa bris pa dang / tshags par snum dpar ma kha shas dpar te chab cha'i slob grwa khag tu bkram pa de ni skabs de'i nga'i sems khams dang gnas bab mtshon pa'i zin tho ru gyur 'dug da lta bsams na/ de ni na tshod der yod 'os pa'i tshor ba'am brgyud dgos pa'i go rim zhig yin kyang srid de/ gang ltar kho bos ni bde skyid cig dang gzi brjid cig tu 'dod bzhin yod la/ phyir dran byed rin yod pa zhig tu yang 'dug— 205 —

rngapa/thas zum/ :sdo/rgyu mtshan de tsam gyis khyed kyang kho bo'i lam du zhugs zhes pa'i don ci yang med pa ma zad/ nan gyis bshad dgos pa zhig ni khyed la mtshon na mi 'gyangs par mtho rgyugs la ran pas dus tshod mang po zhig bslab bya'i steng du bkol na/ mdun ljongs sngar bas yangs po zhig rnyed srid snyam mo/ /slob chen gyi skabs ni slob 'bring gi skabs dang mi 'dra bar rang dbang gi bar glags che tsam yod pas/ slob gseng gi dpe cha lta ba dang rtsom yig 'bri ba'i dus tshod mod po zhig bdog pa red/ na tshod kyi dbang gis phugs bsam skor la'ang lta tshul cung zab gsal 'byung nges pas/ snyan ngag 'bri ba'am ched las gzhan zhig gnyer pa sogs kyi 'dam gar yang 'phrad srid/ kho bor mtshon na/ sngar bzhin ldog med kyi lam der zhugs shing dga' phyogs des rang gi mi 'dang sa mang po'i kha gsab ste rang sems rang gso byas shing / rang nyid ci zhig yin mdog gis nga rgyal gyi skra lo ring bo bskyur te snyan ngag pa'am sgyu rtsal pa'i gras su 'tshang thabs byas pa yin/ phyir 'dang zhig brgyab na/de ni bzang ngan gang gi khongs su gtogs min 'grel dka' na'ang(yang na der ma gzhi nas bzang ngan gyi dbye ba med kyang srid)ngo gnongs pa'i cha zhig cis kyang 'dres 'dug snyam pa'i mod la dgod kha 'chor ba zhig kyang red/de dus slob gseng gi dpe cha 'dra bklags zer ba yang don du rang gi — 206 —

mtho 'bring slob ma la springs pa'i 'phrin lan/dga' phyogs tsam las 'da' mi 'dug la/ gzhung lugs sogs nges par du klog dgos shing rang gi thos pa dang shes pa rgya bskyed par sman pa'i dpe cha 'di bklags myong zer ba zhig cang dran rgyu mi 'dug pas da lta da dung nongs 'gyod du gyur 'dug la/ ches che ba'i phangs sems kyang ci la min ang / snyan ngag tu rlom chog min skor zhig dus deb dang tshags par 'ga' re'i steng bkod pa de ni grub 'bras shig tu brtsi rung min mi shes la/ kho bor mtshon na de tsam las gzhan ci yang med/dus deb tu bkod pa re gnyis la gzhan gyis gdeng 'jog byas myong bas gsar rtsom gyi las der dga' ba ma lhod pa zhig byung / 'di dag yod tshad ma gsang drang bor brjod don ni/ ma 'ongs pa na khyed rang yang go rim 'di dag brgyud dgos pas snga mo nas gra sgrig yod pa dang /'char gzhi yod pa zhig byung na snyam pa dang / kho bo bzhin phyis su 'di yang ma 'khyongs/ gan yang ma 'grub ces sdug smre 'don rgyu med pa zhig tu gyur na bsams pa yin/las gnas steng zhugs pa dang lhag par du zi ling gi shes yon can rnams dang mjal rjes/ ‘‘ngag lkugs’’nas lta ba phar zhog rig gnas phyogs kyi bgro gleng 'os mo zhig kyang mi 'khyongs pas na/ da gzod sems pa nang du bsdus nas dpe cha gang mang mi bklags ka med du thug cing / rang gi tshod kyis 'bad pa bla lhag gis brtson pa bskyed — 207 —

rngabathas/cab :sdo/de rtsom rig gi gzhung lugs dang rtsom 'byung lo rgyus/ de min rgyal khab phyi nang gi dpe cha gzhan dang gzhan rnams bklags nas bsam blo'i mthong rgya bskyed khul byas pa yin la/ de dag bklags pa'i tshor ba zin bris su btab pa'am bsam gzhig mang tsam btang ba yin/ dpe mang ji ltar bklags na de tsam gyis shes pa rgyud la 'byor ba'i gnas lugs ches spyir btang ba der yang nges shes zab mo rnyed/ de snga gzhan gyi zer sgros su 'brangs nas gzhung lugs bklags na gsar rtsom la bkag rgya thebs srid ces brjod pa ni glen bshad 'ba' zhig yin pa rtogs la/de ni shes nas smras pa min par shes med col chung dag gi lab brdol yin pa'ang shes/ gang ltar bzhur zin pa'i chu bo ldog tu med pa dang /'das zin pa'i nyin mo slar 'byung med pas sang sang gnangs gnangs med par da lta nas mgo rtsom pa ni ci 'dra'i gal che zhing kha tsha dgos gtugs shig red ang / dpe cha pa zhig la mtshon na don dam gyi bde skyid ni dpe khang du 'dzul nas dpe cha klog pa dang / bsam gzhig gtong ba/ rtsom yig 'bri ba de yin pas/ da lta kho bos bsam tshul 'di 'dra yid la bcags nas 'das zin gyi lo zla la kha gsab rgyag bzhin yod la/ ma 'ongs par yid ches dang dpa' gdeng gis khengs yod par ma zad/ spobs pa cher bdog gis hur brtson chen po byed bzhin yod/— 208 —

mtho 'bring slob ma la sprengs pa'i 'phrin lan/zhol nas snyan ngag gsar rtsom thad kyi dran tshul thar thor zhig cis kyang gleng dgos tshe/ ji skad du tsong kha pa chen mo'i zhal nas/‘‘rigs lam rnam par phyed pa'i rnam dpyod dang / / gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba'i nyams len dang / /tshig sbyor tshul la mkhas pa'i ngag gi dpal/ /sa steng 'di na rin chen rnam gsum snang / /’’zhes snyan ngag ces pa 'di rang re'i mes po gong ma rnams kyis sa steng gi rin chen rnam gsum du bgrang bas na de'i rin thang yang ngang gis rtogs thub/de lta na'ang / khyed kyis brjod pa nang bzhin kho bo ni sgyu rtsal do ra'i pad tshal na rtsom rig gsar pa'i 'dab ma lhug lhug grol ba zhig ga la yin te min no/ / rang gi nye rtsom skor nas gleng na kho bos na ning do tshigs bris dang 'bri bzhin pa ni slob chen skabs kyi pho mo'i brtse dungs skor gyi brjod bya kho na las brgal te/ rang gi nye 'khor du byung dang 'byung mus kyi gnas tshul dngos dang / mi rigs kyi mdun sar lhags pa'i nyam nyes dang / yul mi rnams kyi bde sdug cig la gzhol ba'am smyug 'og tu 'dren ci thub byed bzhin yod/ khyed kyis 'phrin yig tu drangs pa'i kho bo'i snyan rtsom de dag ni tshad gzhi 'di lta bu zhig tshang ci thub kyi phyogs su 'bad pa byas pa yin mod/ 'on kyang don du 'khyol yod med khyed dang khyed 'dra ba'i klog mkhan rnams kyis dpyad pa las kho bor gdeng tshod chen po ci yang med/ skabs dang skabs su ngo shes min — 209 ge

rngarnga/thas/zu / :sdo/gyi grogs po la shas kyis bstod pa'i me tog gtor nas kho bor skul lcag kyang gnang myong / de dag ni tshul 'chos kyi rgya las thar yod med mi shes kyang kho bor mtshon na gegs su ma gyur par grogs su song ba ni don dngos yin/ snyan gzhung la lar snyan ngag pa zhig yin na nam yang byis blo gtsang ma zhig mnga' dgos tshul bshad 'dug ngas rang nyid la snyan ngag pa zhes pa'i cho lo mnga' yod ces brjod pa min mod/ gzhan gyis bstod pa 'dra byas na dga' snang re skyes 'ongs/ de ni byis blo gtsang ma zhig rgyud du yod pa yin nam/ yang na grags skam 'ba' zhig gnyer 'dod pa yin pa kho bos kyang gsal bor brjod dka'/ gang ltar kho bo ni dga' ba skad cig dang khro ba'ang skad cig gi rigs der gtogs pas mi kun dang 'dris bde ba zhig dang 'grogs bde ba zhig min/ de yang la shas kyis snyan ngag pa'i gshis ka yin zer dus/‘‘de 'dra yin na bzang / de 'dra yin na bzang’’zhes kyang ngag nas shor/ don dam du snyan ngag pa ni ji lta bu zhig yin dgos pa kho bos dngos gnas mi shes/nga rang gi bsam tshul la snyan ngag ni tshig gi rol rtsed tsam du nam yang mi 'dod la/ snyan ngag gis 'gan 'khri zhig cis kyang theg dgos pa dang / snyan ngag gis phyi'i rnam pa kho na gtsigs su mi 'dzin par nang gi bsam blo zhig kyang mtshon pa yin na des rang gzhan su la yang — 210 —

mtho 'bring slob ma ga la springs pa'i 'phrin lan/nus pa phran tsam 'don thub par yid ches yod/ de la dor zhi tshang gis kyang‘‘bcos min shugs drags sems snang srog med na/ /tshig sbyor spu mdog mdzes kyang gser mong ro/ /ngo mtshar rtog btags gshog zung ma skyes na/ / sa la 'khyor 'gros byed pa'i bye'u phrug nyid’’ces brjod 'dug go / snyan ngag gi brjod don de yang rang gi nyams myong dngos dang 'brel zhing 'tsho ba'i cha shas las byung ba yin tshe kun gyis bltas na go zhing dran rgyu myong rgyu yod pa zhig yin par snyam/ de min par deng gi snyan ngag la shas ltar tshig gi spros shob tsam las brjod don ngo ma bo 'bri mkhan rang la'ang bshad rgyu med pa zhig yin na lta klog gi rin thang yang de bzhin chung bar 'dod/ snyan ngag gi tshig sbyor thad sbyong ba mang tsam dang btso sbyangs mang tsam byas na snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur yang thon thub pas de ni snyan ngag legs po zhig 'khyongs pa'i rmang gzhi lta bu yin/ snyan ngag gi tshig sbyor zer ba de yang rang skad kyi brda sprod dang mthun pa dang / rang gi mi rigs kyi mdzes dpyod lta ba dang mthun par sbyar ba las/ gzhan dang gzhan gyi sbyor tshul dang bstun drags na rang rigs kyi khyad chos shor 'gro ba ma zad 'gal ba'i cha'ang 'byung srid/ gang ltar snyan ngag ni 'tshol rtog rab dang rim pa'i 'og nas 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba zhig yin no/ /〈snyan ngag me long〉las‘‘rang bzhin gyis grub spobs pa dang / /mang du thos pa dri med dang / /mngon — 211 —

rngarnga//sa/com/ ::/par sbyor ba mi dman pa/ /snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu’’zhes pa ltar/ nga tsho su yin kyang thang lhod med par 'bad pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsten dgos/ gzhan yang 'dir ma bkod pa'i bsam tshul 'ga' re yod pa dus deb dang tshags par sogs kyi steng du spel zin pas 'or bshad du 'gro bar dogs nas tshig tshogs dang ring du bral ba yin la/ khyed la go skabs byung na der bltas pas 'thus so/ /mnyam bzhag ma bzhag gi bar nas 'phrin lan bris te mtshams 'dir bslebs dus tag tag zhogs pa'i chu tshod4par 'khel 'dugadus tshod 'gyangs 'dug pa dang gcig ha cang thal na nyog bshad du 'gyur srid pa dang gnyis sogs rgyu rkyen gang mang gi dbang gis re zhig 'di tsam gyis chog par bya'o/ /gsal bshad byed rgyu zhig la gong du sems la gang brnags pa de de ltar yig ngor phab pa yin la/ yang gcig bshad na gzhan chen po zhig kho bor 'chad rgyu yang mi 'dug pas/ 'phrin lan 'di ni khyed kyis re zhing sgug pa'i lan du song yod med kyang mi shes/ de las gzhan 'dis khyed la rngo phran tsam thogs min yang sas shes/ de lta na'ang kho bos ༄thog mtha' bar gsum du nan tan dang gzab nan gyi rnam 'gyur bzung yod pas/ skyon du mthong ba ci mchis bzod gsol zhu zhes pa dang — 212 —

chabs cig mjug tu khyed kyi slob sbyong gi 'bras bu yar thon 'byung ba dang bsam don gyi ri mo yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i smon 'dun zhu/khri sems dpa' nas/2007lo'i zla3pa'i tshes22nyin gyi zhogs par zi ling du/

jibaspras/zu / :sdo/shes yon can gyi skor gang dran ci dran/da wagrogs me lce lags la springs pa'i 'phrin yigagrogs me lce lags/mtshan bde legs/bdag gis da so ma rgya nag gi na gzhon shes yon can mo lu'odhilags kyis brtsams pa'i〈bdag gi pha yul lha yul khams na yod〉(〈za tshitshitram̐ṣ+ṭhazlo⑫ )ces pa'i khrod kyi rtsom yig kha shas bklags tshar rjes/cis kyang sems pa bde la 'bab thabs mi 'dug la bdag gi gnyid kyi bde ba'ang cig car du phrogs song / rtsom yig de dag ni snying stobs shig gi tshul du kho bo'i snying la tsher ma bzhin zug cing bsam gzhig gi yo lang drag tu rgyas par byed pa ma zad/ des rang gi 'das song la phyir rtog dang rang gi nye 'khor la sems khral mi byed thu med kyi bsam tshor zhig kyang sbyin 'ongs pas/ skabs 'dir bdag gi yid la 'khor 'ongs pa ni nga tshor don dam du shes yon can yod dam med ces pa'i dri ba 'di yin te/ dngos gnas nga tshor shes yon can rnal ma zhig yod dam med/ dri ba 'dis bdag gi sems pa blong blong bor btang song /brtsamahri chosamosna'o da/bang sgorī dz+nyozhas1ṅgilhatshe duglung go'i na gzhon rtsom mkhan dang / rtsom rig dpyad brjod mkhan/— 214 —

sa yon can gyi thor gang dran ci dran/'di 'dra ba'i tshor ba yar sngon wang kha'e ling gi〈rtul phod can gyi bsam pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa〉(〈yam̐ṣ+ṭhalozakhyotshiṣe༄〉)dang / li can cun gyi〈rtsom rig dang dus rabs kyi dgra bo〉〉/ de min wang pin pin dang yus ce/lin zhan kridusogs kyi brtsams chos klog dus kyang skyes myong bas/ da ni yid kyi 'gyur ba gnon thabs bral zhing sems kyi dran tshul gang zhig khyed dang bgro gleng mi byed rang dbang mi 'dug go/nga tshos slob chen khag na bzhugs pa'i dge rgan chen mo de dag la gzigs dang / kho tsho las mang shos kyis rigs gzhung rnam grangs gang zhig 'thob pa'i ched du brel brel zing zing byed cing / ma dngul mod po lag tu son rjes snying bo med pa'i dpe cha re‘‘brtsams’’te ci 'ig yin mdog gis mdun shog steng‘‘rigs gzhung zhib 'jug gi grub 'bras’’zhes mtshan snyan brjid po re 'dogs par byed pa dang / skabs 'gar‘‘rigs gzhung zhib 'jug gi grub 'bras’’kun la ngom par brel nas gzhan rtsom rku 'dren byed pa'i gnas tshul yang gcig min du byung dang 'byung gin 'dug pas/ kho tsho'i‘‘grub 'bras’’kyi mdun du kho bos cis kyang kha rog ger sdod thabs mi 'dug de la kho bos bzod sgom byed thabs bral/ slob chen ni nga tsho'i mtha' mjug gi re ba min nam/yu la gyil+lī 'u zlot+na〉h+phir+sha lbo /'du/r+ṣalta2/sgyud+dha 1948—)krung go'i deng rabs kyi rtsom mkhan dang mkhas pa/ brtsa mas chos 〈mi

rngarngasprozlas zu / :sdododwangs gtsang gi gnam sa min nam da ni kho bos cis kyang yid ches byed thabs bral/ rul sungs kyis sbags pa'i slob chen dang / rigs gzhung zhib 'jug gi gzig lpags gyon pa'i dge rgan chen mo de dag gis me tog 'dra ba'i slob bu rnams la zil char dang nyi 'od ga tsam 'dren nus/ de dag la zhib 'dang zhig brgyab tshe/ rang dbang dang / 'dra mnyam/ mang gtso sogs tha snyad ljid mo de dag gis mtshon pa'i shugs kyi snying stobs ni nga tsho dang ci 'dra'i rgyang thag ring ang / mkhas chen gang zhig gis gsungs pa yid la mi dran yang / ‘‘nga tsho sad pa'i skabs kyi rnam pa dang gnyid la rol ba'i skabs kyi rnam par bar khyad cang mi 'dug’’(nang don phal cher 'di 'dra zhig yin pa 'dra)ces pa ni nga tsho'i steng du sbyar na ci 'dra'i 'byor mo zhig red ang / dge rgan chen mo de dag gis nga tsho skyob mi thub la/ yang gcig bshad na kho tsho ni thob dang go sa/ grags skam gyi bran du gyur nas rang nyid kyang ngo shes yod tshod ma red/ des na de dag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi snod du gyur pa'i‘‘bum pa’’dag gis nga tsho lhag tu skyob thub bam/mi rigs shig dang yang na mi rabs shig 'di ltar 'thom sbrid du gyur dang 'gyur bzhin pa'i dus da lta/ nga tshor bden pa'i skad sgra sgrog mkhan gyi mi bu ga tsam yod/ gal te skad sgra sgrog mkhan yod pa'i — 216 —

sa yon can gyi thor nga dran ci dran/dbang du btang rung de la rna ba blags nas nyan mkhan ga tshod yod/dran tshul 'di dag gis kho bo'i mthong snang yod tshad bsgribs shing / kho bo rang gi lag tu thogs pa'i‘‘'khos chung gi smyu gu’’'dir yid ches kyang ngang gis zhi 'gro/ yang na khyed the ba'i smyu gu thogs mkhan gyi grogs po yongs la yid ches byed thabs bral/ nga tsho'i‘‘ri rgod thang rgod’’du btab dang 'debs bzhin pa'i sa bon de dag la lo legs kyi ston kha zhig 'byung srid dam/ nga dngos gnas the tshom skyes yong / gtam gyi sgo mo rang la bskor na rang gis ci zhig sgrub song / rang nyid kyis rgyu 'bras blo mig cig ci zhig brtsi srung byas song / dbang grags kyi mdun nas ljid tig tig gi skad cha ci zhig bshad song / mo lu'o yis‘‘rang steng gi 'thom sbrid dang smyo ham la thar lam 'tshol ba de min par/ de las ldog ste nga tshos sngar las che ba'i spobs sems kyis 'jig rten dang rang steng gi 'gan 'khri de 'degs dgos’’zer/ de ni ci 'dra'i stobs shugs kyis khengs shing bden pa'i gtam rma med pa zhig yin na'ang / spobs pa 'di lta bu yod mkhan dang lag len du gdab thub mkhan gyi mi bu du yod/ kho bo rang gis brgyud myong ba'i 'das song la ngo gnongs shing / kho bo'i shes rmongs dang kho bo'i ci zhig yin mdog gi sprel lad kyi bzo lta la sdang sems skyes 'ongs/dpe tshong khang du 'gro bar dga' ba dang dpe klog la dga' ba'i mi — 217 —

2pa/thas/(5/ :sbyo/zhig yin na/ dpe sgrom steng gi lo re re'i rgya yig gi rtsom rig brtsams chos(brtsams sgrung / snyan ngag lhug rtsom)dang / 'bol rtsom thol rtsom sogs legs rtsom bsdus deb de dag mthong yod las che/ de nas bod yig dpe tshong khang tag tu song nas ltos dang / nyin re nas nyin rer mthug nas mthug tu 'gro bzhin pa'i‘‘yi ge'i gad snyigs’’de dag mthong tshe/ khyod kyi sems la dran rgyu ci zhig yod/ nga tsho ni‘‘gad snyigs’’bskrun mkhan 'ba' zhig ma yin nam/ 〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug〉dang〈〈krung go'i bod rig pa〉sogs‘‘dus deb grags chen’’steng gi‘‘brtsams chos brjid po’’de dag la gcig bltas na tshor ba ga 'dra red/kho tshos ci zhig brjod kyin 'dug des nus pa ci zhig thon gyin 'dugade las 'gan 'khri ci zhig mthong thub/ de las nga tshos bsam pa'i rgyags phye ci zhig bsdu len byed thub/gzhan yang‘‘dra 'bu’’de dag gi gtam la nyon dang / ‘‘kho(don grub rgyal)shi song ba ni bod pa tshang la dgra bo zhig tshar bcad song ba red’’ces dang / ‘‘'das pa'i dge chos dang don grub rgyal/ deng dus kyi zhogs dung dang de'i rjes 'brangs dang bcas bod nang dkrugs pa la shin tu mkhas ’’zhes‘‘khyi rgan ku co 'don pa na/ /rgyu mtshan med par gzhan dag rgyug’’pa ni yid sems skyo ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur cing / yang gcig bshad na‘‘drang por smra ba skyon bcas dang / 'khyog smra yon tan — 218 —

shes yon ca gyi thor nga dran ci dra /bden pa srid’’(sa pan gyi gsung)ces pa ltar ro/ /'di ni nga tshos dge chos dang don grub rgyal sogs mi bu chen po dag la bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur red la/ bden lugs la rdog brdzis btang ba'ang yin pa red/gtam de dag gi rgyab tu bskungs yod pa ni kho tsho'i shes rmongs dang shes rmongs kyis zin pa'i sems khams ngo ma bo(sems khams ya ma brla)ma yin nam/ de ni yus ce yis‘‘ches skrag pa ni rjes lus min par/ rjes lus de 'phel rgyas su brtsi ba de red/ ches skrag pa ni shes rmongs min par/ shes rmongs de dbang grags su brtsi ba de red’’ces brjod pa nang bzhin no/ /zhib tu bsams na/ srol rgyun gyi bag chags rnying rul dag ni dngos gnas brlan gyis btang ba'i dong chu zhig dang 'dra bar/ des nga tsho phyi rabs pa yongs la mu mthud du bsam pa'i skom gdung sel khag po yin pas da ni lo rgyus la sdom tshig dgod pa'i skabs la babs 'dug cing / lo rgyus kyis gnang ba'i bslab bya yid la dam por bcags nas bsam pa'i thon khungs gsar pa gzhan dang gzhan nas sngog 'don byed dgos 'dug don du yang‘‘lo rgyus la zhib 'jug dang / lo rgyus kyi ngo gdong gsal bor mthong ba/ lo rgyus kyi nyams myong dang bslab byar spyi sdom bcas byas tshe mi rnams kyi rig pa je gsal dang / shes rab 'dzoms pa/ mig rgyang ring bar 'gyur srid la/ de ni ma gzhi nas lo — 219 —

spredri//sa sgyu / 15/rgyus la zhib 'jug byed pa'i don snying yin’’dupar brjod pa bzhin no/ /des na nga tshos lo rgyus la zhib 'jug byed pa'i dmigs yul ci zhig yin/'khyog brjod/ rdzun bzo/ 'ud brjod nga tsho'i lo rgyus gna' nas da bar du 'di ltar las snon byas nas byung ba red la/ deng gi dus la'ang su zhig gis‘‘rig gsar’’sogs lo rgyus kyi nag nyes la‘‘gtsang bsher’’byas myong / su zhig gis skad cha drang mo bshad myong /su zhig gis 'gyod bshags byas myong / de min nga tsho'i g.yas g.yon du byung dang 'byung bzhin pa'am lo rgyus su gyur dang 'gyur bzhin pa'i ya nga ba'i snang tshul dag la gdong gtod mkhan du yod/ med pas mi tshad tshor snang tsam yang med par da dung de la bstod glu 'bul ba dang ram 'degs byed mkhan ni ga sa ga ru khyab nas yod pa red/ ‘‘shes yon can gyis ma 'ongs par phyogs nas da lta'i mi la blta dgos pas/dgag rgyag byed mkhan las dag 'bud byed mkhan min’’dumod/ 'on kyang de dang ldog ste yod pa ni tag tag nga tsho'i‘‘shes yon can’’rnams red/ rul sungs kyi shes yon can rnams red/ ming don mi mtshungs pa'i shes yon can rnams red/'di dag yod tshad kyi yod tshad bsams na/ grogs po lags/8(ñtsā2blotsho྾ 〈lko6rkoṣ+ṭhager+ṣaḍār+sā〉 0k+ṣiṣ+ṭha7 ṣ+ṭhamalhalkoṭ+wāṃrkispraspostsa〉7r+sā.oṃlornyetram̐2005poX oṃṣ+ṭhatsā 〈ṣ+ka.oṃtshitsholko〉ḍaspoṣāskya.oṃstsaltalornyeṭ+wāṃ2005ro11(lo2 22— 220 —

sa yon ca gyi ra nga dran ci dra /khyod kyi sems pa bde la 'bab thub bam/spyir na shes yon can zhes pa ni‘‘tsher ma'i lam’’du skyod mkhan zhig yin dgos te/ dbyi si ral gyi mkhas pa khang h+phe(khong gi lo rgyus mi gsal)yis u ru su'i shes yon can gyi khyad chos la phyogs lnga nas sdom tshig bkod 'dug ste/ gcig spyi tshogs la do khur byed pa/ gnyis/spyi pa'i las don de rang gi 'gan khur du brtsi ba/ gsum/ chab srid dang spyi tshogs kyi gnad don de kun spyod kyi gnad don du brtsi ba/bzhi/ 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes ldan pa/ lnga/ bya dngos kyi lugs mthun min pa'i cha dang de bsgyur bcos byed pa'i dgos nges rang bzhin la yid ches zab mo yod pa bcas so/ /du nga tsho'i shes yon can rdzus ma rnams ni nam yang de dag gi ldog phyogs nas ldog phyogs su skyod mkhan rkyang yin te/ kho tshos bde snyoms kyi lam bu re bdams nas khu sim por rang gi khe phan 'ba' zhig snyeg ste 'gro bar byed cing / mtshams rer tshogs chen 'dra min steng ngag las skad cha sbom po re phyungs te rang nyid ngom/ so byed pa dang / skabs su bab na rang don tsam las ci la'ang bsam blo mi 'khor bar khyod bzang nga bzang tshang ma bzang ba'i rnam thar skyong ba ni nyung nyung tsam ga la yin/ gzhan kho tshor khyad chos dhi oṃṣ+ṭhagā.oṃ 〈ñtsa thu lko〉ḍaskya lo༅rki༈oṃchoṣ+ṭha2005oṃ11za 2 3—4

rngarwa/spras/zum/ :sdo/shig yod pa ni gzhan la phyogs ris kyi mig zung gis blta ba dang skur 'debs dang khyad gsod byed pa goms gshis su grub cing / kho tshos mi nus pa gzhan gyis sgrub par yang bar chad bgyid ci thub byed la/mngon lkog gang rung nas da dung kha ming sna ming btags nas sdigs dmod dang zur za'i tshig mtshon 'debs rkyang byed pa red/ kho tsho las mang che shos ni bstod pa bstod tshogs dang / 'grel ba yang 'grel rtsom par mgo 'khor ba dang / phyogs ris 'then 'khyer/ dogs med bstun thabs byed mkhan 'ba' zhig red pas/ des bskyed pa'i mjug 'bras ni rang re'i ya nga zhing skyug mer ba'i gnas bab la bltas na shes thub ste/ ‘‘spyang bo’’dang‘‘grum po’’mang zhing / ‘‘phor ba’’bskyor bar brel nas‘‘mgo lag pas skyor na rgyag ni med/ kha kha rog bsdad na kha mchu med’’ces kha khu sim por sdod pa'i rgyun ldan min pa'i snang tshul zhig btsog pa 'khor rgyug gi tshul du gnas pa 'di red/ 'di lta bu'i shes yon can rdzus ma khyed kyi g.yas g.yon du phreng du bsgrigs yod pa ma yin nam/ kho bos de rnams ni shes yon can gyi gras su bgrang dka' la shes yon can rnal ma'i rigs su bgrang rgyu ni de bas kyang ngo / /‘‘shes yon can gyi snying stobs nyams pa des shes yon can gyi 'gan nus nyams pa mtshon zhing / dus mtshungs su de ni spyi tshogs kyi shes bya'i nus pa dang kun spyod nus pa nyams pa'am 'jig bzhin pa'i

sa yo can gyi ra nga dra ci dra /mtshon rtags kyang yin’’(lin zhan kri'i tshig)pas/ dus da lta nga tsho'i mdun lam ni kyag kyog gis khengs shing / nga tsho'i mthong lam ni smag rum gyis bzung yod pas/ da dung der rgyun ldan gyi rnam 'gyur 'dzin pa ni lhag tu mi rung ste/ de ni shes yon gyi 'gan nus shor pa dang yang na shes yon can gyi dmigs 'ben dang 'gal ba'i byed thabs shig go/khyed kyis bltas na de 'dra e red/nga tsho 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i gnas bab ni 'di 'dra'i ya nga zhing skyug mer ba dang / yod tshad mgo rting slog pa'i dus skabs shig la khel yod mod/ sku zhabs nyi gzhon gyis bris pa'i 'bol rtsom〈‘‘9 11’’rjes dran dang zhar byung sems khral〉〉dang zhogs dung gis bris pa'i 'bol rtsom〈rgyan lpags sreg sbyor lo rgyus kyis brjed mi srid pa'i las 'gul thengs shig〉sogs kyis kho bor yid ches cung tsam bstsal song la/shes yon can gyi kha phyogs dang dmigs 'ben yang gsal bor bstan byung / yang gcig bshad na/ ‘‘nga tshos bde thang dang mdzes sdug la smon pa ji ltar bcangs na'ang de mngon du bsgyur thub pa'i nges pa med mod/ 'on kyang nga tshos phyir 'khor nas g.yo zol dang skyug bro ba'i bya dngos steng nas skad cig gi bde snang 'tshol ba ni ga la rung ste mi rung’’ba kho bos shes yod/ der brten/ sger tshags kyi bsam blo yod pa ༄— 223 —

2pa/thas/zu / :sbyo/dang / bshad phod sgrub phod pa/ dogs slong gi snying stobs ldan pa/rgyu 'bras blo mig gsal ba/ dbang grags kyi mdun nas mgo mi sgur ba sogs kyi shes yon can rnal ma zhig byed dka' na'ang / nga tshos mnyam du dpung rdang sbrel te mdun nas mdun du skyod rgyu ni khyed kyi phugs 'dun yin la bdag gi phugs 'dun yang de las ma 'das bdag gi grogs po lags/ mtshan mo bslebs thengs re rer kho bos 'di ltar‘bsam gzhig lhag ma’’mi gtong ka med byung / ‘bsam gzhig lhag ma’’'di dag gis kho bor skrag snang dang skyo snang dus gcig tu sbyin par byed pas/ 'di lta bu'i‘smag nag gi mtshan mor’’kho bos ru sodudang / ha weladusol ze nyi chenadulu'u zhun sogs dran 'ongs la/dge chos dang don grub rgyal sogs kyang dran 'ongs/ da dung bdag gi snying nye ba'i grogs po tsho yang snying nas dran 'ongs so/ /khri sems dpa' nas/2007lo'i zla3pa'i tshes29nyin gyi mtshan gzhung du/tshogs lhan r+ṣahūm̐ /rnam baji da/ blok+kayā shāsdulha bloṣ+ṭha 1712—17sdubyiṭā ṭ+wāṃn si'i py-isam blo mkhan/ brtsamaṭ+wāṃ chos〈spyi hūṃkaushā rdodṛnihā2bye lha/ra gyi trī5 khe lta /baṃn 'i rdomi kyi dz+nyardo tār+sā/— tātā matā kyuzlo bye rnyi ṭā khyi nag dūju /rtsom chiṅgi sa dru sna'idi/gling tshohāsosnaswā tādzog chen/ sabya02khyikhubardumoskyab dz+ra7khri2r+ha)mu ru su'i rtsom mkhan/ brtsams chos〈ko la ki —224—

rtsom sgri pa'i zi tho/rtsom sgrig pa'i zin tho/〈myug phran〉le tshan sgrub pa'i 'char gzhi/de ring phyi dro kha par gyi lam nas〈lcug phran〉le tshan sgrub pa'i 'char gzhi'i skor nas grogs me lce lags dang bgro gleng thung ngu zhig byas pa dang / (grogs me lce lags la gros bsdur byed don ni khos de snga 'di ga tshags par khang nas bya ba bsgrubs myong pas yin) rang gis de snga ja kha chang kha nas 'char gzhi gang mang bzos shing rim bzhin brjed ngas rkun por bskur pa yid la dran pas/ de ring gi 'char gzhi 'di yang kha bshad tsam du mi 'gro ba'i ched du dus da lta nyid du yig ngor bkod de lag len du gdab par dran tho tsam bslangs pa yin/bod khul du ljongs dang zhing chen/ sa khul dang khul rim pa'i tshags par kha shas yod na'ang / de dag las che gras ni〈bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par〉dang〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉gnyis red/gzhan〈bod ljongs gzhon nu'i tshags par〉dang mtsho sngon gyi〈khrims lugs tshags par〉〈kan lho'i gsar 'gyur〉〈rnga ba'i gsar 'gyur〉sogs ni tshags par chung gras dang dpar thengs nyung ba'i skor yin pa red/ de dag la rang rang gi khyad chos yod pa ni bsnyon du med mod/— 225 —

rngabathagazub 2dotshags par gyi rtsom rig par ngos thad nas bshad na tshags par gang gis kyang〈〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉gyi do ya mi 'ong ba ni kho bos 'ud brjod byas pa min par klog mkhan mang che ba'i ma gros gcig mthun gyi bsam tshul lags so/ /kho bo ni tshags par 'di'i〈rig rtsal gzhogs bkod〉kyi rtsom sgrig pa'i khongs mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas/ 'di'i nang gses kyi〈lcug phran〉dang〈skar tshom〉gnyis la mgo 'dzin byed bzhin yod la/ le tshan zhig sgrub par phyogs mang po nas cha rkyen 'dzoms dgos na'ang gtso bo ni le tshan gang de'i rtsom sgrig pa'i jus 'god la thug yod pas/ le tshan 'di legs 'grub 'byung min dang klog pa po'i dga' bsu thob min/ spyi tshogs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i nus pa bzang bo zhig thon min sogs ni kho bor 'brel ba dam po yod cing / 'di ni rtsom sgrig pa zhig gis thog mar yid la nges dgos pa'i gnad kyi don po'ang yin pa red/'di ga'i〈rig rtsal gzhogs bkod〉steng bkod pa'i brtsams chos khag la phyir lta zhig byas na/ dang thog gi〈gangs rgyan pad+ma〉nas da lta'i〈rig rtsal gzhogs bkod〉du bsgyur pa'i bar du brtsams chos rigs mi 'dra ba mang po zhig(tshags par skor zhig lag tu son thabs bral bas sdom rtsis byed dka')bkod 'dug ste/ deng rabs rtsom rig gi srol 'byed pa'am rmang 'ding mkhan don grub rgyal lags gtsos pa'i rabs de'i — 226 —

rtsom sgri pa'i zin tho/rtsom mkhan sogs dang gzhon skyes rtsom mkhan skor zhig gi rtsom rig gi thog ma'i sa bon gtor sa'ang tshags par 'di yin 'dug pas/〈rig rtsal gzhogs bkod〉kyi kha sang ni mtshar sdug ldan pa zhig yin pa shes thub/ lhag par du sku zhabs zhogs dung lags kyi 'bol rtsom〈〈rmongs skran 'joms pa'i gtar kha〉〉(〈'phag 'tshag gi nga ro〉)dang〈bag chags dong sprug〉gnyis snga rjes su bkod pa nas lha chos dang mi chos/srol rgyun dang deng rabs/ bsam blo gsar pa dang rnying pa sogs bgro gleng gi bar snang yangs por phyes par ma zad/ spyi tshogs yongs su tshur snang lan cha drag po 'khor zhing de'i skor gyi phyogs so so'i skad sgra dag kyang 'di ga'i tshags par la bltas na gsal bor shes thub/ brgyud rim de dag gi khrod du tshags par 'di la yang drang ldog gnyis kyi tshig gi mda' mo gang mang phog yod tshod red/ de lta na'ang sngon gyi rtsom sgrig pa rnam pas de dag la ma 'dzems par spobs pa cher bdog gis rno dbal tsha ba'i 'bol rtsom mang po zhig bkod pas ltos bcas kyis nus pa gal chen zhig thon 'dug pa ni don dngos so/ /spyir btang du tshags par la rang gi sgrub stangs dang lang phyogs yod na'ang / rtsa ba'i rtsa don la ma 'gal ba'i phan chad nas rtsom sgrig pas phyogs ris kyi lta tshul bzung nas rang nyid 'thad pa zhig yin na 'god pa dang mi 'thad pa zhig yin tshe mi 'god pa sogs byed ga la rung — 227 —

2pagathas sgyu / :sdonaste/ rgyu mtshan ni rtsom sgrig pa gcig pus klog pa po yongs kyi tshab byed ga la thub/ tshags par ni gar stegs shig yin pa'i dbang du btang na glu pa dang bro par rang rang gi 'jon thang ngom par cha rkyen bskrun dgos pa las/ de dag gi lus kyi nyams 'gyur dang skad kyi gdangs dbyangs la sogs pa re re bzhin rang gi 'dod blo dang 'tsham pa zhig tu bsgyur rgyu zer na gzigs mkhan rnams kyis dga' bsu thob mi srid la/ de ni dgod bro ba'i byed thabs shig kyang ci la min/ de'i thad nas kho bos mu mthud du rtsom sgrig pa sngon ma dag gi snying stobs de rgyud 'dzin byed par 'dod/yar sngon ltar na/ 〈rig rtsal gzhogs bkod〉kyi le tshan dbye dus〈lcug phran〉lta bur slob ma dang gsar skyes rtsom pa po'i rtsom 'god pa dang / 〈skar tshom〉lta bur rtsom pa po cung legs shos kyi rtsom 'god pa yin mod/ yar sngon le tshan gsar du dbye dus rtsom lus ltar dbye ba dper na/ 〈skar tshom〉du brtsams sgrung dang zlos gar/ 〈lcug phran〉du snyan ngag dang lhug rtsom 'god pa gtan khel byas yod pas/'bol rtsom dang thol rtsom sogs rang shugs su〈lcug phran〉du 'god pa las thabs med pa byung / kho bos le tshan 'di gnyis dang du blangs ma thag nas sngon dang gcig pa gcig rkyang zhig min pa dang / ‘‘ngo gdong gsar pa’’zhig klog pa po'i mig sngar bstar ched sngar med kyi le tshan chung — 228 —

rtsom sgri pa'i zi tho/ba gsar pa 'ga' kha bsnan pa yin te/ ‘‘ched bsgrigs rtsom mkhan’’(r+haṣ+ṭha.oṃྈ)dang‘‘snyan ngag pa'i rang bdams snyan ngag’’(r+sharkikhye7kārgo)gile tshan gnyis tshod lta'i tshul du bkod pa na klog mkhan 'ga' res gdeng 'jog kyang legs po thob pas/ kho bor sngar bas kyang le tshan 'di je rgyas je legs su gtong ba'i 'dun pa skyes la/ ji ltar sgrub pa'i thad la mno bsam mang tsam gtong dgos byung / der brten/ 〈skar tshom〉ni gtso bo brtsams sgrung dang zlos gar dgod sar gtan 'khel byas yod pas/ le tshan 'di re zhig btang snyoms su bskyur te〈lcug phran〉le tshan ji ltar sgrub pa'i skor nas grogs me lce lags the ba'i klog mkhan yongs la bgro gleng tsam byed pa'i dgos pa chen po 'dug snyam/kho bo ni rgyun du〈lho phyogs gza' mjug tshags par〉(〈smoskretsholko〉)klog par goms yod la/ gong gi le tshan chung ba de gnyis sgrub pa'i blo bskyed kyang don du de las byung ba yin/ 〈lho phyogs gza' mjug tshags par〉ni rgya nag gi shes yon can rnams kyis krung go'i tshags par kun las rtser son yod par smra la/ der‘‘shes yon can gyi tshags par’’zhes pa'i mtshan snyan zhig kyang gsol 'dug pa red/ tshags par de ga'i steng yar sngon rgya'i shes yon can li'u cun nyinadhilags kyis 'go ma8 tsoligā tsūnāhā spya/ba srilha1k+ṣiṃk+todabasdu sbyi'irke rngekru zlol gonā sgoju ṭāṭ+wālha kyi chab srid mkhas pa/ brtsams chosaspyi mthun

2pa/thas/zum/ :sdo/bslangs te krung gor‘‘rig rtsal bskyar dar’’dgos min thad nas rtsod gleng dza drag byas pa dang / de'i 'phror slob chen khag gi slob gtso the ba'i dge rgan dang shes yon can rnams kyis slob chen gyi slob gso'i ngos thad nas rtsod gleng sna tshogs byas dang byed mus su mchis/ 〈lho phyogs gza' mjug tshags par〉dang 'di ga'i tshags par gnyis phyogs gang ci'i thad nas bsdur thabs med na'ang / rtsod gleng che ba'i brtsams chos de dag la bltas rjes kho bos kyang le tshan de lta bu zhig bsgrub thub na ci ma rung snyam zhing / lhug rtsom dang snyan ngag gi skor gzhan dang gzhan du ltos bcas kyis 'god sa mang bas 'dir nyung du gtong ba sogs kyi thad nas thog ma'i ngag thog gi 'char gzhi tsam bzos te g.yas g.yon gyi grogs po 'ga' rer bshad pa na/ bsam tshul de legs tshul bzang tshul gyi gtam mang du bsnyad byung /des na skabs su babs pa ni gleng gzhi ji lta bu zhig bkod sgrig byed rgyu de yin te/ mi rigs shig gi go rtogs sad dgos na thog mar rig gnas pa'i sde yi go rtogs sad dgos shing / rig gnas pa'i sde yi go rtogs ma sad na gzhan rnams ni gleng thabs ye nas bral bas/yang yang brtag kyang dpyad de grogs po rnams dang gros sdur byas rjes‘‘rig gnas snying stobs gsar 'dzugs’’zhes pa'i gleng gzhi zhig bkod sgrig byas te rgya che'i smyug thogs pa rnams la bgro gleng gi stegs bu zhig ge 230 —

rtsom sgri pa'i zi tho/'don sprod byed rgyu'i gros 'cham byung / gleng gzhi 'di lta bu zhig bkod sgrig byed pa'i dmigs yul ni gna' rabs ke ri se dang ro ma sogs kyi dpyod shes dang khrims lugs rig pa'i snying stobs la rgyus lon byed pa dang / de dag gi rig gnas snying stobs tshur len byed pa/ rgya nag gi‘‘lnga bzhi’’rig gnas gsar pa gtso byas pa'i deng rabs rig gnas la dpyod shes kyi sgo nas 'jug pa/ shes yon can rnal ma dag gi dgongs pa dang snying stobs dar spel byed pa/ mi bu rang rgyud kyi shes yon dang kun spyod/ mi gzhi bcas je legs su gtong bar kha phyogs pa de'o/ /des na 'di'i thad nas me lce lags kyis zla3pa'i tshes30nyin gyi 'di ga'i〈rig rtsal gzhogs bkod〉steng spel ba'i〈dang rten dang skur 'debasad dra ngos kyi dge 'dun chos 'phel dang don grub rgyal gyi skor gleng ba〉(gnyis pa)zhes par bod kyi rig gnas snying stobs gsar 'dzugs skor la rang gi lta tshul gsong por brjod 'dug pa dang / lta tshul de ni ma lag dang ldan zhing 'thus tshang ba zhig min na'ang de la dpyad gzhi'i rin thang nges can zhig ldan par sems pas 'di'ang bgro gleng gi rgyu ru 'gyur rgyu'i re ba byed kyi yod/gzhan yang gong gi 'char gzhi de grub rjes/ da dung lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i nang byung ba'i rtsom mkhan yongs nas skabs de'i brgyud rim don snying can rnams phyir dran gyi rnam pas bris pa'i rtsom yig dag — 231 —

rngarnga /sa zu / :sdo/dgod pa'i 'char gzhi yang yod de/ lo rabs brgyad cu pa ni bod ma tshad par rgya nag spyi'i rig gnas dang dpal 'byor sogs phyogs gang thad nas 'pho 'gyur ches che ba'i lo rabs shig dang / don snying ldan zhing dkyogs mtshams chen po zhig tu ngos 'dzin bzhin 'dug la/de'i skor gyi lo rgyus mtshon pa'i dpe deb rgya nang du ha cang mang na'ang /rang rer mtshon na shin tu dkon po yin pas de'i thad nas rtsom thung zhig 'bri dgos kyang yig char rung ba zhig 'tshol dka' ba'i tshod red/de bas/ da lta'i go skabs 'di dam 'dzin byas nas bya ba 'di ma sgrub tshe ma 'ongs pa na lo rgyus kyi stong cha chen po zhig tu mi 'gyur pa'i nges pa med pas/ las rigs so so nas rgyab skyor 'thob par snying nas re ba dang / dus mtshungs su 'di dang 'di lta bu'i cis kyang bsgrub dgos pa'i las ha cang mang po zhig dus deb dang tshags par khang re re nas mig rgyang ring du gtad nas bsgrub rogs zhes kyang zhu'o/ /〈lcug phran〉le tshan gyis nang gses le tshan chung ba 'di dag sgrub don ni/ tshags par gzhan dang gzhan la 'di'i phyogs kyi yon tan dang nus pa med pas ma yin la/ 'gan khur med pas lhag tu ma yin mod/ mig snga'i gnas bab la gzhigs na〈bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par〉dang〈khams pa'i tshags par〉sogs spun zla tshags par khang rnams ni khu sim pos ngang nam yang rtsom sgrig byed stangs rnying pa gang zhig — 232 —

rtsom sgri pa'i zi tho/bskyar zlos nas yang zlos dang nur 'gros byed kyin 'dug pas/ spyi tshogs la don gyis do khur byed pa dang zhabs 'degs zhu ba sogs kyi las 'gan rlabs po che de phrag tu bzhes med pa'am mi 'dang snyam zhing /da dung 'di ltar song na tshags par gyi byed nus shor te‘‘yi ge'i gad snyigs’’su tshud par dogs pa yin la/ de min dus deb khag la mtshon na'ang rtsom rig brtsams chos gtso bor bzung nas 'di lta bu'i le tshan mi sgrub pa dang / yang gcig bshad na le tshan 'di 'dra zhig bsgrub rgyu ni rtsom sgrig pa zhig la mtshon na 'gan 'khri zhig kyang yin pas/ kho bo gom gang mdun spos kyis sngon du skyod de gzhan rnams la‘‘mig dpe’’tsam zhig ston pa'am yang na de'i thad nas go ba cung zab gsal zhig bskon pa gzhir byas/ nga tsho rang steng gi mi 'dang sa dang zhan char kha gsab yo bsrang zhig yong na snyam pa bcas la kha phyogs pa yin gyi dmigs yul gzhan ci yang med do/ /2007lo'i zla4pa'i tshes3nyin gyi mtshan mor/rtsom sgrig dang rtsom skul/ da dung gzhan dgan ning do tshigs〈sbrang char〉sogs kyi steng du bkod pa'i brtsams sgrung la bltas na/ brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom gyi chu tshad gong nas gong du 'phel bzhin pa'i nyams snang zhig sbyin 'ongs mod/ 'on kyang — 233 —

rngapa/zlas can/ :sdo/brtsams sgrung 'bri mkhan nyung la mang shos kyis de ni tshegs ljid pa'i las shig tu rtsi bzhin pa'ang don dngos lags so/ /nga rang gis bya ba sgrub sa'i tshags par khang 'di la dpe re blangs na'ang / bskur yong ba'i brtsams chos kyi mang nyung ang rim bzhin dbye tshe ang dang po ni snyan ngag yin pa dang / de'i rtsom pa po'i khyab khongs ni dge rgan dang slob ma/ grwa btsun sogs smyu gu thogs mkhan yongs kyis zin 'dug la/ang gnyis pa ni dpyad brjod kyi rigs yin/ de'i rtsom pa po'i khyab khongs ni gtso bo slob chen khag gi zhib 'jug slob ma rnams kyis bzung 'dug de'i rgyu mtshan ga re yin pa'i skor la rgyus lon tsam byas te shes rtogs byung ba ni/ deng gi zhib 'jug slob ma rnams la gzhung gnyer dus deb dang tshags par steng dpyad rtsom dgod pa'i 'gan khur yod pa red zer/ ches nyung ba ni brtsams sgrung gi skor yin te/ brtsams sgrung gi skor nas phal cher gcig kyang mi 'dug de snga yin na/ 'di ga'i tshags par du ched du brtsams sgrung gi par ngos bkod sgrig byas med pas/ brtsams sgrung bskur yong mkhan yod na 'god pa dang / med tshe rtsom skul sogs byas nas rtsom pa po dang rtsom sgrig pa gnyis‘‘sdug la sbyar ba'i’’ngal bar zhugs dgos don med/yin na'ang da lta sngon dang gtan nas mi 'dra ste/ de snga'i〈skar tshom〉le tshan de ched du brtsams sgrung gi par ngos su gtan 'khel byas — 234 —

rtsom sgri pa'i zin tho/yod pas spus ka bzang ngan gang yin kyang nges par du par ngos stong bar mi 'jog pa'i phyir du phyogs yar mar nas btsal te dgod dgos/nye char mu 'god byed bzhin pa'i sgrung 'bring〈med gsum skyabs〉lta bur mtshon na'ang / nga rang gis bltas na'ang brtsams sgrung legs po zhig tu cis kyang brtsi thabs mi 'dug la/ de'i thad nas rtsom pa po co ne yum tshe ring dang nged gnyis kyis kha par gyi lam nas bgro gleng yang byas myong / rtsom pa pos dang thog nas de ni kho'i brtsams sgrung thog ma yin pas mi 'dang sa dang zhan cha ha cang mang / de'i phyir tshags par du dgod pa'i rin thang med cing dgod par 'thad pa yang mi 'dug zer mod/ par ngos dgos mkho'i dbang gis nan du skul par khos da gzod grogs po'i ngo ma bzlog pa red/ la shas kyis snang tshul 'di'i rigs la‘‘rtsom yig gi mug skyob’’ces zer la/ ‘‘mug skyob’’'di'i rigs med tshe skabs 'gar rtsom sgrig pa tshor bya thabs zad 'gro/ 'di las rang re'i brtsams sgrung pa'i dpung sde de ha cang gnyom drags pas dus deb dang tshags par sogs kyi dgos mkho skong mi thub kyi med pa de'ang shes thub/par ngos kyi dgos mkho'i dbang gis rtsom yig rnam pa sna tshogs rtsom skul ma byas na bya thabs zad pas/ thog mar rang gi nye 'khor gyi bzang sa rgyan sa dang rtsom grogs tshor 'phrin yig gam kha par sogs — 23du —

2pasprosgos/:mi/ 11/btang ste rtsom skul byed dgos pa'i gnas tshul dang rgyun du 'phrad 'ongs/de ltar byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan zhig ni/ rtsom mkhan rgyus med rnams la rtsom skul byas tshe dang len byed pa'i nges pa mi 'dug la/yang bris pa'i rtsom gal te tshags par steng mi 'tsham pa'am rkyen dbang gis 'god ma thub tshe/ phan tshun bar go 'dzol dang dogs mi bde ba'i snang tshul yang 'byung ngo / /gal te grogs po'i bar yin tshe rtsom skul byed bde ba dang gong gi gnas tshul de 'drar 'phrad na gsal bshad byed bde ba sogs bzang cha ha cang mang po yod/ de lta na'ang / dra ngos sogs kyi steng na kha shas kyis‘‘rtsom sgrig pa de tshos rang gi ngo shes dang bzang sa'i rtsom ma gtogs 'god kyin mi 'dug’’ces gtam gang byung du smra la ngan dmod dang skur ba sogs ci yang 'debs pa yang mthong ngo / /zhib 'dang zhig brgyab tshe/ rang nyid rtsom sgrig pa dang smyu gu 'ching mkhan zhig yin pa'i cha nas/ las gang zhig gnyer ba de la rgyus yod pa'i phyir rtsom mkhan mang shos shig rang gi grogs por gyur dang 'gyur bzhin pas na gzhan dang gzhan nas su la rtsom skul byed ang /bskur yong ba'i rtsom yig dag la lta dus/ kho bo'i sems la nga tshor sgyu rtsal brtsams chos kho nas mi chog par/ da dung spyi tshogs dngos kyi snang tshul ngo ma bo mtshon pa'i dngos bshus rtsom rig dang / yang na snyan zhu'i rtsom rig skor gyi brtsams chos kyang shin tu mkho ste/ de yang — 236 —

rtsom sgri pa'i zin tho/gzhi rim mang tshogs kyi mdun du lhags pa'i dka' ngal sna tshogs te/khrims lugs la rmongs pas gyong reg tshul/ 'brog pa rnams grong rdal du spar rjes 'tsho gnas nyen khar gtad tshul/ e tsi 'gos nad sogs nyen kha che ba'i nad rigs kyi gnod pa/ 'phrod bsten dang gtsang sbra'i thad gnas pa'i gnad don sogs nga tsho dang 'brel ba dam por yo/da pa'i gnas tshul gang mang zhig rtsom mkhan rnam pas smyu gus ma btang bar 'bri thub nga/ byung na snyam 'ongs/ 'di ni kha tsha dgos gtug dang 'phral du bsgrub dgos pa'i don bya chen po zhig kyang yin pa red/gang ltar/ nga tsho la mtshon na da dung bsgrub dgos pa'i bya ba ha cang mang bas na rang res mnyam du brtson pa bskyed dgos par 'dod do/ /2007lo'i zla4pa'i tshes6nyin/

rtsapa pes/zu / ::rdogrub 'bras dang phangs sems/da wa2006lor 'khyug tsam lta ba/de ring ni spyi lo2006lo'i zla12pa'i tshes30nyin red/ dus kyi mgyogs bgrod 'khor los su la'ang dmigs bsal gyi gom kha ma lhod par2007lo'i gnam lo gsar tshes kyi bkra shis dus bzang gi sgo drung du 'byor pas/ dus skabs 'di lta bu la 'das pa'i lo ngo gcig ring la spyi sdom byas nas 'byung 'gyur gyi lo ngo gsar par bsu ma byed pa'i dgos pa ha cang che la/ de ni don snying ldan pa'i bya ba zhig kyang red 'dod/2006lor rang re'i gangs ri'i ra bas bskor pa'i bod kyi yul du gnam sa sgul ba'i don chen po 'di byung song zhes brjod dka' na'ang /rjes dran dang do snang bya rin yod pa re gnyis cis kyang yod pa red/dper na/rgyan gos rig gnas steng gi gsar brje chen mo zhig ste ri dwags kyi pags rigs dang ring du gyes pa/ 'di la phyi nang gi rkyen sna tshogs mchis kyang mang tshogs rang ngos nas bslangs pa'i las 'gul rlabs po che zhig dang / bod mi'i lo rgyus steng gi ches gleng ri ba dang 'dzam gling — 238 —

ba 'bras dang phangs sems/yongs la ngom chog pa'i las don gal chen zhig yin pa ma zad/ nga tsho dang rang byung khams bar mnyam gnas yong ba dang 'gro ba mi ma yin pa'i tshe srog gzhan la brtsi bkur byas pa'i mtshon rtags shig kyang red/nga tshos rang nyid ni byams sems dang snying rje'i bdag po yin zer ba'ang bye brag gi don bya 'di dag gi steng nas mtshon pa yin na da gzod kun gyis khas len cing don snying ldan par sems pas/ nga rang ngos nas rang mi rigs kyis dngos su lag len du btab pa'i bla med bya spyod 'di la gong bkur dang rjes su yi rang 'bul zhing / de min srog ldan de dag gi tshab byas nas(gal te tshab byed thub pa'i dbang du btang na)gus phyag lan gsum 'bul lo/ /bod rang gis phab skrun byas pa'i glog brnyan te〈lhing 'jags kyi ma ṇi rdo 'bum〉 legs 'grub byung zhing rgyal khab phyi nang gi gzigs mo mkhan yongs nas gdeng 'jog tshad med gnang bar yang bskyar 'khrab 'khrid pa pad ma tshe brtan gtso byas pa'i sgrig phab pa rnams la rten 'brel zhus pa yin/ tshad nges can zhig nas des nga tsho bod kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal 'thus tshang dang sna mang can du 'gyur bar nus pa gal chen thon srid pa dang / brnyan ris kyi lam nas bod kyi 'tsho ba 'khyog brjod byed pa'i go 'dzol rnams kyang khong tsho'i 'bad pa brgyud ngang gis zhi 'gro bar yid ches chen po yod/

rngarnga /sa/zu / ::she2006lor/ bsam gzhig gi dga' skyo chags sdang smyug rtse nas lud pa'i rtsom mkhan rnams la mtshon na/ gsar rtsom gyi gom kha mi dal la mi mgyogs shing / grub 'bras kyang mi chung la mi che na'ang / lta rin klog rin yod pa'i brtsams chos kha shas nga tsho'i mig gi longs spyod du gyur/ dper na/ chos skyong lags kyi〈rang grol zhib 'jug〉 (kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 2006lo'i zla5pa'i par)zhogs dung lags kyi〈rgyan lpags sreg sbyor lo rgyus kyis brjed mi srid pa'i las 'gul thengs shig〉(〈shar dung ri〉2006lo'i deb)stag 'bum rgyal lags kyi〈hā pa gsos pa'i zin tho〉(〈sbrang char〉2006lo'i deb gnyis pa)rig ldan rgya mtsho lags kyi〈gna' grong〉(〈sbrang char〉2006lo'i deb gsum pa) gong gi brtsams chos de dag ni ma mtha' yang nga rang ngos nas bsam blo'i rgyags phye gya nom pa zhig tu mthong bas/ kho bo'i lo 'di'i nang gi dpe klog gi grub 'bras che gras su rtsi bzhin yod/2006lor/ smyug thogs pa tsho'i bar rtsod gleng dza drag yin pa dang phan tshun bar mi gzhi dma' 'beb dang khyad gsod byed pa'ang rgyun — 240 —

ba 'bras dang phangs sems/du mthong thub/ de ni gtso bo〈rtsod pa'i rlabs phreng〉sogs dgon grong dus deb steng du mngon gsal dod po red la/ nad yams bzhin gyi snang tshul de'i rigs kyis nga tshor sngar bzhin phan tshun brtsi bkur dang /'dra mnyam/ dkyel yangs bcas kyi bsam blo'i bgro gleng gi kha dbugs dwangs gtsang zhig chags par gegs rkyen thebs dang thebs mus su mchis/gzhan yang / dra ba zhes pa'i rang dbang gi gleng stegs shig dar ba dang bstun nas skye bo ljags yod ljags med kun gyis lta tshul dran tshul drag char bzhin byo bas rgyun ldan min pa'i nga tsho'i rig gnas kyi khor yug de lhag tu khrag bzhin dkrugs byung / ‘‘dra 'bu’’kha shas shig gis gzhan la sdigs dmod dang mtshang 'dru byed pa sogs rang gi longs spyod lta bur brtsis te byung rgyal du smra ba sogs ni khrims ngos nas re zhig btang snyoms su bskyur rung yang kun spyod kyi ngos thad nas thar sa ye nas med do/ /de'i rigs kyis ma 'ongs pa'i lo gsar pa'i nang du rang sems la snyom sgrig byas te 'gan du babs pa'i las don zhig gnyer rgyu ni re ba thog ma lags/de las kyang tshabs che ba zhig ni/ rig gnas kyi gad snyigs su bgrang rung ba'i dus deb dang sger deb mang po zhig da lo yang btsog pa 'khor rgyug gi tshul du shwa 'od bzhin brdol pas/ sun snang dang re chad — 241 —

rngapa/thas can/ :sdo/kyi tshor ba mang du sbyin byung la/ shes yon can du rlom mkhan tsho'i gras su'ang gzhan rtsom bshu 'dren sogs ngan pa rul sungs kyi don rab dang rim pa byung zhing de ni nga tsho'i rig gnas kyi mkha' dbyings su 'khyil ba'i mi sdug pa'i dud smug lta bu red pas/ dud smug 'di dag mkha' lam nas ma yal bar du nam mkha'i mthongs su 'od du 'tsher ba'i shes rig gi nyi ma de nga tsho'i mthong skal du smin pa'i go skabs nam yang yod mi srid do/ /de bas/ gnam lo gsar par nye ba'i skabs 'di la‘‘shes yon can’’de dag gi rna lam du yang bskyar gsal 'debs shig mi byed thu med byung /2006lor/ grogs po zhig gis kho bor snang tshul 'di 'dra zhig kyang bshad myong / da lta bod na mkhas pa(dbang grags mi sna)yod pa ma red/ su la dbang cha yod na de ni mkhas pa yin pa red zer/ khos bshad pa'i gtam de ni zur za'i gtam zhig yin kyang zhib 'dang brgyab tshe rgyu mtshan 'dri mi dgos par de'i phugs kyi nang don gsal bor rtogs 'ongs la/ de ni da lta'i snang tshul ngo ma zhig kyang yin pas/ ‘‘bong bu de dag gi gzig lpags bshus’’te gzhan la bgrod lam yangs por 'byed rgyu dang rang la gang 'tsham pa de sgrub rgyu ni gal che zhing / shes yon can rnal ma'i rigs la brtsi bkur byed pa dang / kho tshor rang dbang gi gar stegs shig bskrun te gsong ba'i tshig dang bden pa'i — 242 —

ba 'bras dang phangs sems/gtam smra bar rgyab rogs byed rgyu ni gnad dam pa'o/ /rang ngos nas lo 'dir dga' ba yod la skyo ba'ang yod de/ thog mar gnam lo gsar tshes kyi rten 'brel brtag phyir dga' ba'i phyogs nas bshad na/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi mkhas chen skor zhig gi ljags rtsom la mjal thub pa byung la/ de dag gi go rim khrod du bsam gzhig gtong ba'i gshis ka gsar pa zhig rang steng du 'byor la ma 'ongs par yid ches je brtan du gyur par ma zad/ mtshan mo mang po zhig 'phro brlag tu ma btang bar rtsom yig kha shas bris shing de rnams mi 'gyangs par deb cig gi tshul du bsgrig nas klog mkhan yongs kyi gzigs mor dbul grabs yod/ skyo ba ni nga rang gi grogs kyi dwangs ma ste/ skyes stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba'i gsar skyes snyan ngag pa 'ba' seng smyon lags kho bo dang dus gtan du zhal gyes pa de yin/ des ni kho bor bzod glags bral ba'i gdung ba drag tu bskyed de da dung yang sos dka' ba'i tshad du gda' 'o/ 'jig rten du tshe srog las gal che ba zhig med na/ rang gi blos thub kyi grogs po gang zhig rang nyid dang gtan du gyes dus su yin kyang yid sems skyo skyo ba zhig bzo srid la/ grogs po khong gi glo bur ba'i gyes bral gyis kho bor yang tshe srog la gces spras dang nyin mo re re bzhin dam 'dzin byed dgos pa'i cong brda zhig kyang brgyab song / mi la shas shig 'jig rten mi yul du yong nas da dung rang gi— 243 —

rngapa/thas zu / ::/‘‘'dug stegs’’tsam yang ma rnyed par 'khang sems dngatshobacas mi yul dang gyes dgos byung ba de ni sdug bsngal zhig dang nongs 'gyod cig mi la min ang / 2006lo ni dga' skyo zung gis grub kyang rung / sdom tshig cig bkod tshe/ nga tshor bzang bo las ngan pa mang zhing yag pa las btsog pa mang / nga tshor don dngos sgrub mkhan las ku co rgyag mkhan mang la/ku co rgyag mkhan las khu sum mer sdod mkhan lhag tu mang bas/2006lo ni yid la 'bab cing‘‘lo legs’’byung ba'i lo zhig tu ngos 'dzin byed dka' bar snyam/ de ni nga tsho smyug thogs pa yongs nas bsam gzhig gtong dgos pa'i gnad cig yin la/ gtong ba'i dgos pa yang ha cang che'o/ /gang ltar/ 2006lo de ltar dus kyi nyin srib brgyud nas 'ja' ltar yal la nye bas/ nga tshos re ltos kyi mig zung bgrad sa ni re bas khengs pa'i2007lo yin pas/ grogs po tsho/ sang lo'i da mtshams ljid tig tig gi 'bras bu bsnams nas shog skyo lhang lhang gi nongs 'gyod skyur la shog 2006lo'i zla12pa'i tshes30nyin zi ling du/

ngas 'gyod dang yid ches ri sa/ nongs 'gyod dang yid ches rigs shigad wamajug byang gi tshab tu bris pa/1slob grwa chen mo ni slob grwa chen mor 'grims myong mkhan rnams la mtshon na ches brjed du med cing / mi tshe'i 'grul bzhud lam gyi dkyogs mtshams shig tu'ang 'khums/spyir btang du slob grwa chen mo ni rig pa'i gnas kun la ris med du sbyang chog pa'i zhing sa gshin po zhig dang / ‘‘rang dbang gis 'phur chog pa'i bar snang’’yangs po zhig yin la/ de nas phugs bsam gyi gshog zung yang rnyed thub pa yin/yin na'ang‘‘go skabs ni nam yang gra sgrig yod pa'i mi la dbang’’zhes pa ltar/ gra sgrig med pa'i mi skor zhig la mtshon na slob grwa chen mo ni rtsed ra lta bu zhig tu gyur te/gser las dkon pa'i dus tshod chud zos su btang zhing / ljang myug lta bu'i lang tsho don med du rnyid par byas/ bsam blo zhib tu btang na 'di ni mi tshe khrod kyi ches che ba'i gyong gud cig yin ang / kho bos 'di ltar brjod don ni rang nyid ni tag tag phyi ma'i rigs su gtogs pas so/ /kho bos de snga dus deb cig las brtag dpyad byas pa'i mjug 'bras 'di 'dra zhig mthong myong / a ri sogs gtso byas pa'i nub phyogs kyi sngon thon rgyal khab mang shos su slob ma rnams slob grwa chen mor rgyugs sprod par gnon shugs dang — 245 —

rtsaḥ/thas/25/ :sdo/dka' las chen po med pas/ slob 'bring gi skabs su rtsed 'jor rol ba'i dus tshod‘‘lhag ma’’yod pa dang / slob grwa chen mor zhugs rjes da gzod rig pa'i gnas kun la sbyong ba bla lhag byed pa dang / de ltar ma byas tshe mthar phyin mi thub cing / slob grwa chen mo'i dngos gzhi 'dzin grwa nas lo ngo drug bdun la lus mkhan yang yod pa red zer/tag tag de dang ldog nas yod pa ni nga tsho'i slob gso dang / nga tsho'i slob ma rnams red/ slob 'bring gi skabs su gnon shugs rab dang rim pa'i 'og 'phag 'tshag rgyag ci thub byed pa las rtsed 'jor rol ba'i dus tshod mod po zhig med pas na/ slob grwa chen mo zhes pa'i rang dbang gi khor yug 'di nas‘‘bcings 'grol’’thob ste‘‘lus ngag yid gsum’’rgya yan du gtong ci thub byed pa red/nga tsho'i slob grwa chen mo pa mang shos shig gis gnas de nas bag g.yeng dang sgyid lug gi khrod du‘‘sngar med kyi bde snang’’'ba' zhig 'tshol bar brel zhing /zang zing gi dngos por blo sems gtod par byed/kho tshor mtshon na/ phugs bsam ni ci zhig mdun lam ni ci zhigade dag ni ci 'dra'i rgyang thag ring ba'i‘‘tha snyad shi bo’’zhig ang slob grwa chen mo'i 'tsho bar kha shas kyis 'di lta bu'i sdom tshig cig kyang bkod 'dug ste/ slob rim dang por ci yang shes 'dod/slob rim gnyis par ci yang brjed song /slob rim gsum par ci yang sbyangs/— 246 —

ngas 'gyod dang yid ches rigs shigaslob rim bzhi par ci yang ma shes/'di ni nga rang gi nongs 'gyod che shos shig kyang yin la/ nga the ba'i deng gi slob grwa chen mo pa gang mang zhig brgyud myong ba dang / slob grwa chen mo pa gang mang zhig da lta da dung brgyud bzhin pa'i gnas bab ngo ma'ang yin pa red/2de ltar kho bo‘‘rdo 'jong dang tsher ma'i khengs pa'i’’spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i lam khar bslebs dus re zhig mgo 'thom nas ci bya gtol med du lus shing / kha phyogs yod tshad smag rum gyis bzung ste gar 'gro 'di 'gro mi shes la/ 'tsho ba'i rlabs ngogs su rang nyid bor ba'i g.yor gru ji bzhin 'phyo 'jags la nges pa med pa zhig tu gyur/yin na'ang dga' 'os pa zhig la/ kho bos‘‘mkhas pa mang ba'i zi ling’’du las ka reg pa de yin/ zi ling gi gru kha gang mang na chu mig bzhin dwangs pa'i mig zung grangs med kyis nga la cer zhing / yid rton rung ba'i lag zung grangs med kyis nga rang bskyor pas/ kho bo‘‘lam’’du zhugs ma thag tsam du zad kyang /mdun phyogs su yangs pa'i lam chen zhig rgyang ring du bsringaspuyod pa mthong lam du mngon byung /zi ling gi ja kha chang kha nas yun ring bor bag la zha ba'i dran tshul mtha' dag dmar rjen du mdun cog steng blangs nas kun la‘‘gsol ston’’du bshams myong /zi ling gi cha bo bzhin shag shag 'jo zhing me dpang bzhin lam lam 'bar ri bye ri ringad 247 da

2pasaḥs ::/ sgyu /ba'i bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun khrod nas bsam gzhig la‘‘byi dor’’byas myong /zi ling gi bden pa 'dra la ku re dang yang mtshungs pa'i‘‘rigs pa'i rtsed mtshar’’khrod du ngag nas‘‘mi skad’’mi smra thabs med byung /zi ling gi 'gran rtsod dang / zi ling gi dkyel yangs/ zi ling gi skul 'ded zi ling nas kho bo lam du chas/ de bas/ zi ling ni nga rang gi‘‘slob grwa chen mo’’gnyis pa yin no/ /da lta kho bor yid ches kyis khengs yod/mdun lam ni kyog kyog che na'ang / kho bo hur thag gis lam du zhugs bzhin yod/ 3mjug tu deb 'di'i gnas tshul mdor tsam zhus na/ 〈bsam gzhig gi kha dog〉'di ni kho bos na ning do tshigs zi ling du‘‘bsam gzhig’’phran tsam btang ba'i‘‘'bras rtags’’tsam yin la/ spyir na kho bo'i deb 'di par skrun byed pa'i dgos pa chen po med de/ dpe tshong khang tag tu bam por spungs pa'i‘‘yi ge'i gad snyigs’’rnams la thengs shig bltas tshe lhag tu 'di ltar bsam 'ongs/ ‘‘gad snyigs’’gi steng du‘‘gad snyigs’’spungs pa ni ma gzhi nas nag nyes shig red 'dod/de lta na'ang / gcig na kho bos dngos gnas rtsom thung re gnyis 'bri ba las gzhan ci yang mi nus pa dang / gnyis na kho bor dga' phyogs 'di tsam po las gzhan ci yang med pa/ gsum na bdag gi g.yas g.yon gyi grogs po tshos dus rgyun du kho bor skul lcag yang yang gtong bas khong rnam pa'i re ba gtong zad du — 248 —

ngas 'gyod dang yid ches ri sa gtong mi rung zhing gtong yang mi phod/ rgyu mtshan 'di dag gis sne drangs te da lan klog pa po(klog mkhan re byung na)rnams kyi mig zung la 'o brgyal gtod dgos byung bas/ kho bos 'di nas khyed rnam par thugs rje che zhus pa yin/dmigs bsal du bka' drin zhu dgos pa ni/ kho bor dus rgyun skyon brjod gnang mkhan dang snying phur brdab mkhan gyi grogs po yongs dang / sgos su mthun rkyen legs tshogs sbyor mkhan gyi drin chen pha ma rnam gnyis dang chung ma bsod nams 'tsho/ deb 'di'i par skrun thad rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gyi grogs mchog me lce bcas yin no/ /khong rnam pa tsho'i lhag bsam dron mo ni kho bo mu mthud du lam 'dir zhugs pa'i sgul shugs dang rgyags phye nyag cig yin pas/ khong rnam pa'i sku khams bde zhing bsam don 'grub pa'i smon 'dun zhu/zhes deb 'di'i byed po sgo me che ring bkra shis dang smyug ming la khri sems dpa' 'am zla gsal du 'bod pas2006lo'i za12par gna' mkhar zi ling du bris pa'o/ /
